tei:div.tei:p: ngatshom/40cu skursā/zhu 47nya sa zu mes sku te
༄༅/ /dpal yul dar thang mchog sprul rin po che 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum legs bshad nor bu'i bum bzang bsdokyigs/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
ja (1

sngon 'gro'i gtam/sngon 'gro'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhig yin/de 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing —/ rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs / nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i khyad chos 1

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par bstsal/gong gsal dgongs don lag star dngos 'bab byed ched/nga tshos rang skyong khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te/ched gnyer las khungs btsugs shing / ched mkhas mi sna skong 'phen dang ci nus sgos mthun rkyen bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng de'i byed nus 'don skul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung snga ba'i sgo nas las 'go brtsams/nga tsho'i thog ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo log sa cha'i gna' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad / brgyud pa ring zhing / rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang / nang gses rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang /rtsom rig lo rgyus/ gso rig mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis gzhung —/ nang don rig pa sogs bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyab khongs phal mo che zin cing / dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i gna' gzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dugade phyir thog ma'i 'tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng /1993lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs kyi tshul du khra 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas kyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs〉sogs snga gzhug tu deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jog legs po byung zhing / bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang gzengs bstod kyi dbugs dbyung thengs du mar gnang /nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis(krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bstun zhing /rang skyong khul gyi srid dbang btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi zang gzhi'i steng rim pa sngaṭa shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lta dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bas/

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub ston la brtsi srung sgos/ mi rigs phul byung rig gnas dar spel dang / mi rigs mthun sgril dang rig gnas brje res la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs gna' rtsom sdog 'don myur skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing /srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rig gnas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin cha tshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang / ched las shes byar gtsigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thogargyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul g.yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang smos ma dgos/4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chags par byas te/ma dngul gyi mthun rkyen cung 'byor ba'i gnas tshul 'og dpe tshogs〉de jus 'god dang / mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye ge'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te/ mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rig gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myur skyob bya ru yod cing / mang po zhig da dung med brlag tu ma song bar 'tshol du yod pa dang de tsho'i rig gnas rin thang gi skor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/ legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i legs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khyu mchog dang /phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang ldan te/ ji skad du 5

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/mkhas pa rnams ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min ces gsungs pa shin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing —/ khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi tshogs la thugs gzhigs yang yang mdzad pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dag yod pa dang / legs skyes de dag dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa dag la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'jog gnang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing / nga tshos bskrun pa'i shes rig la rmang gzhi dang khungs lung yod cing / brgyud pa dang ldan par gyur / mkhas pa de tsho dang rig gzhung de tsho bzhugs pas rang gi rigs rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i thun min rig gnas shig gi bdag por gyur yod la/shes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rim 'phang mi dma' bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dag dang de dag gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dag ni mi rigs shig dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na gzi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug la/ 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dang 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrag rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/'di ltar bsam na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas rjes su yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro'i rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can pa dag la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gtsigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang / skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste sogs kyis mtshon te mkhas pa dag phu dud bya ba'i yul gsum gyi gtso bo'i go gnas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing /khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsung chos dag ni bslab ༷'i

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gnas shig dang / lugs gnyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyim rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsung chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas te/ bu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus 'gyur mang po'i khrod du'ang srog dang bsdos nas srung skyob byas 'dug da lta bsam na 'di ni goms srol legs po tsam du ma zad snying stobs rigs shig gi mtshon byed du'ang rung bar snyam/de dag gi dbang gis sa gnas 'dir yang lo rgyus su mkhas pa mi nyung ba tsam byon cing / da lta'i bar 'tshol du yod pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang tsam bzhugs la/de tsho'i thun min rin thang gi cha nas bshad na'ang lo rgyus su mgo log 'di mdo khams 'brel mtshams su chags yod pas/mdo khams rig gnas ma lag che ba gnyis ka gcig 'dres su song ba'i nyams shig snang la/ bod brgyud nang bstan grub mtha'i dbang du btang na'ang snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge lugs pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa sogs grub mtha' che gras phal mo che zhig yun ring mnyam gnas su chags pas/ dmangs khrod rig gnas tshun gyi rig gnas 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/kun la sa cha gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i sger khyad cig lhag ger snang bar bsten/ rig gnas shul bzhag 'di rigs myur skyob thub pa byung na/ bod spyi'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dar rgyun nam brgyud pa gyes 'phel 'gro tshul dang / sa gnas thun min rig gnas grub stangs sogs zhib 'jug byed par don snying dang rin thang shin tu che bar gdon mi za la/ tha na bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi nang gses phyogs rer mtshon na de phyogs kyi stong cha gsab nus pa'i tshad du son pa'i rin thang yang yod par zhib 'jug mkhas dbang du ma smra/gang ltar da lta nga tshos mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'di nyid par du bskrun te mgo log gna' rtsom gyi spyi bab khyad chos dang ngo mtshar kun gyi spyan sngar bstar thub pa ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'bab byung ba'i bye brag gi mtshon dpe zhig yin la/ mgo log rig gnas khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras chen po zhig yin cing / krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom bya ba'i grub 'bras kyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin pa dang / deng dus la dge ba'i mdzad bzang zhig dang / ma 'ongs par bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig ste/ lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba rlabs che ba zhig yin pa bston du med la/ sa gnas thun min rig 9

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gnas thon khungs sngog 'don sgos khyad thon rig gnas dar spel byed cing / rang skyong khul gyi rig gnas brje res dang phyi phyogs dril sgrog la shugs snon byed par mtshon na don snying chen po tshab byed gzhan du med pa zhig yod par snyam zhing / dus mtshungs su dpe tshogs〉'di nyid kyis rgya che'i klog pa po dang 'brel yod zhib 'jug pa dag la'ang rig pa'i longs spyod gsar ba zhig stob nus pa'i yid ches nga tshor yod/de sngon gyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/ cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen gsar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag gis don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing / kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis yod/'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myur skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che 10

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ba'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mu 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub pa la rag las yod/mjug mthar mgo log gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing / grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu/ /zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1 1la bris/

dkar chagasngon 'gro'i gtam/ (1)gsung chos mdzad pa po'i rnam thar/ (1)byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla sgrub dang gsol 'debs kyi skor/ (25)yon tan gyi rtsa ba zhal gdams sogs kyi skor/ (45)dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/ (65)'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/ (101)phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/ (185)bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ (226)
la mapa'i bzhung

mdzadapa po'i rnam thar shin tu nyung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/༄ga /dar thang mchog sprul rin po che maci'i zhabs kyi rnam par thar ba zhin ngu nyung byar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/༄7/ /thub mchog bstan pa sna tshogs sprul pa'i phreng / /bshad dang sgrub pas skyong mdzad chos kyi zla/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos rgyal ba dgyes pa'i rje/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos 'gro ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /gang gi rnam par thar ba zla bas 'phel/ /byis blo'i yul du ma gyur ku sha'i rtser/ /chags pa'i zil ba brgya ru gsil ba'i char/ /'gran pa'i tshig phreng gser gyi thig le bri/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus pa'i gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi rang gzugs 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa dpal yul mchog sprul rin po che 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rol mo dpal bzang po mchog gi rnam par thar ba'i rgya mtsho pha mtha' dang bral ba las 'dir dgos ched 'ga'i phyir du shin tu nyung ngur bsdus te brjod pa la/ skye phreng snga ma rnams kyi mtshan tsam smos pa dang / sku tshe 'di nyid kyi rnam par 1

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/thar ba brjod pa dang gnyis las/dang po ni/ dag dang ma dag gi gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa chu zla'i snang ba bzhin du mtha' yas pa zhig rim dang cig char du ston pa rnams las snang tshul 'ga' zhig gi dbang du byas na sprul gzhi dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal po badzra ku ma ra dang / rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ sku sras dgra gcan 'dzin/ dgra bcom kun dga' bo/ byang sems rdo rje chos/ gzhon nu bde ba'i ro langs/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa 'od/ slob dpon ār ya de wā/ yig mkhan a tsar ya sa le/ rma ban rin chen mchog nus ldan bde ba'i rdo rje/gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po/ rgyal sras mu khri btsan po/dpal ldan jo bo rje a ti shā/ rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa/grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ gter chen padma gling pa/ gar dbang zhig po gling pa/ gro shul bde chen gling pa/ mkhas grub tshangs dbyangs rdo rje/ sde srid mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rnal 'byor tshul khrims rdo rje/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan/ se ra rje btsun pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ se ra mkhas grub bstan dar ba/dpal yul mkhas grub kurma lha dbang / rgya sprul padma mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ gzi 'gag mchog sprul 'jam dbyangs shes rab 2

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar shin tu nyung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/chos kyi snang ba sogs kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa rje rang gi sngon gnas rjes dran dang / 'khrul med kyi gter lung 'ga' dang /mngon shes kyi dpal dang ldan pa'i mkhas grub du mas gsal bar gsungs pa lags so/ /rje 'di nyid gter lung sogs tshad ldan gyi lung gis zin tshul yang / rgyal rong gter rgod padma bde chen gling pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan las/ mgon jo bo'i sprul pa cang shes lor/ /yul rgyal mo rong du sku bltams nas/ /khams lcags yul mdo sngags chos la 'god/ /der 'brel tshad rnga yab gling du 'dren/ /zhes dang / rdo grub chen kun bzang gzhan phan gyi 'byung 'gyur lung bstan las/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa smar gyi stod nas 'byung / /gsang sngags chos kyi bstan pa'i sgron me sbar//zhes dang / rdzogs chen bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan las/ jo bo'i sprul pa cang shes lo la ni/ /rgyal mo tsha ba'i rong du sku bltams te/ /mdo khams lcags yul dkar po'i chos la bsgyur/ /'brel tshad rnga yab gling du 'dren par 'gyur/ /zhes dang —/ shug sgang rig 'dzin chen po'i gter lung las/ mgon padma'i sprul pa mdzi'i ming / /de 'brel tshad rnga yab gling du 'dren / /zhes dang / mgar klong gter ston bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling pa'i gter lung las/ gnas rgyal mo'i gzhung char kun 3

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/dga' dpal: phan bde ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan 'dzin:zla gzhon pa gsar 'char lcags yul du: chos smin grol bdud rtsi'i char ba bsnyil: zhes dang / lcags sprul rol ba'i rdo rje'i gter lung las/ a lcags yul chos kyi nyi ma shar: dpal yul ba'i bstan pa'i dge mtshan tshugs: zhes dang / khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa'i gter lung las/ gnas de nas mi ring nye ba'i sar: dpal rdo rje phur ba'i rnam rol gar: khong rnal 'byor mchog gi ming mtha' can: de'i lte bar sme ba'i thig pa yod: dpal de la rnam sras sgrub skor sprod: ces gsungs pa sogs lags shing lung gis zin pa gzhan yang yod nges mod kho bor 'tshol long ma byung bas de tsam las spro mi nus so//gnyis pa la sku 'khrungs nas gzhung lugs phyogs med la gsan bsam mdzad tshul dang / sgrub pa nyams su blangs te 'bras bu mngon par smin tshul dang / bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ de yang rje 'di nyid sku 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni/ bod chen po'i shar phyogs rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi rgya kha bho to zhes pa da lta'i si khron zhing chen rnga ba rang skyong khul gyi lis rdzong du rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing pho rta yi lo ste spyi lo chig stong brgyad brgya go bzhi'i lor bod kyi rigs su 4

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar shin tu zhung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/yab lo ye then shi'u dang yum sman thar gnyis kyi sras su mtshan dpe'i nyi gzhon bzhad/ 'khrungs pa'i tshe phyi nang shel ltar gsal ba'i phru ma'i dar gyis sku lus la gos kyi tshul du g.yogs bzhin bltams / zhag gsum nas ma yum dus kyi chos nyid du gyur/ ma yum 'das pa de lhums su yod dus ma yum des dgun khar me tog ser chen gnyis bzhad pa mthong bas cig shos de btus nas mchod pas tshe skal yin pa la rten 'brel 'chug dbang gis tshe mthar ma phyin pa yin par grags/ de yang khyim mi rnams nas ma shi ba'i bu dwa phrug 'di gso dka' bas 'chi ba dga' zhes ma yi phur dang lhan du ro sgam du bcug nas 'tsho rten ci yang ma phul bar 'og khang du bzhag /ro dur du sba tshe bar gshin chog 'don bde'i phyir du ro sgam kha gcod mi srid pas nyin re bzhin bu chung 'chi min la brtags pas 'chi ba phar zhig nar son pa'i ngang tshul byung / zhag gcig mtshan mo nye du rgad po zhig sgor bud tshe ma ro dang bu chung 'jog sa'i khang mig de 'od dkar gyis khengs 'dug pa mthong / bltar phyin pas bu chung de mi gdong bzhi ba zhig gis pang du blangs nas snyor ba mthong /nang bar tshul de kun la bsgrags pas kun the tshom skyes te dge zhus bla ma zhes pa'i tshe mtshams pa zhig yod pa la zhus pas bla 5

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/mas bu chung de 'phags chen zhig gi rnam 'phrul du nges/ ma yum yang bde ldan zhing du 'dren 'dug pa'i rtags mtshan mnga' bas myur du bu de 'das ma bcug par stor skyong gyis zhes gsungs/ 'di dag gi skor rje gang gi sku yi tsha bu bla ma thub bstan snyan grags kyis bdag la dngos su gsungs pa yin la 'di dang mi mthun pa'i bshad srol gzhan yod pa rnams cung mi dag snyam/ de nas mgar ba gter chen gyis bdag mi lam sprul bsgyur gyis song ste gzi sprul rgya kha bho to zhes par bskrun yod pas sku bdag gyis zhes dang / kong sprul tshang nas kyang gzi sprul rgya kha bho to ru 'khrungs 'dug pas sku bdag la song zhes pa'i 'phrin yig lha sprul rin po che'i phyag tu rim par 'byor bas khong rgyal rong du byon/ byis pa de 'khrungs dus kyi rtags ngo mtshar ba de thos pas sa de ga'i rgya dpon chen po zhig gis byi ru'i tog can gyi zhwa mo dang lu ba sngon po sgo bzhi zhig phul nas bdag gir bgyis yod pa la lha sprul rin po ches thabs sna tshogs la brten nas gzi 'gag yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad/dgung lo gsum pa la sprul skus chibs pa mi thub pas rgya kha tshe dbang zhes pas smyug ma'i sle bo zhig gi nang du rgyab la 'khur nas bgrod dka' mtho gzar gyi nags tshal dang ri chu la 'phrang 6

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar shin tu nyung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/mang po brgal te dar thang du gdan drangs shing gser khrir bkod / dgung grangs lnga pa la rje mdo sngags chos kyi nyi ma dar thang du phebs pa'i drung nas kur gling zhi khro dang 'ja' tshon pod drug sogs kyi smin grol gsan/ dgung lo drug pa la khams dpal yul rnam gling dgon du rgya sprul dang / dpal 'byor sprul sku / sba rod sku chen rnams dang mnyam du gser khrir bkod/ dar thang phyogs kyi rgan rabs dag gi ngag sgros la sprul sku bzhi las gnyis dar thang dang gnyis ma dgon rnam gling la 'jog rgyu byas te ma dgon gyi bla ma rnams la sprul sku bzhi las gnyis 'dems bcug pas sprul sku'i byad mdzes pa la bltas te rgya sprul dang dpal 'byor gnyis bdam pas lha sprul tshang nas sprul sku bsam pa 'grub byed de dang mchog gi sprul sku de nga la thob 'dug gsungs te bzhad mo mdzad pas sba rod sku chen la bsam grub dang sprul sku 'di ba la mchog sprul du mtshan chags pa yin zhing ma dgon gyi sprul sku gnyis po rjes su sku rgod du gyur bas lha sprul tshang gi mkhyen pa ni ya mtshan zer/ 'on kyang 'di ni ma bu dgon gyi bar gyi phyogs ris kyi gtam tsam las bden par mi sems te /rgya sprul de ma bu dgon 'di gnyis po tsam ma zad dpal yul ba yongs kyi bstan pa spyi'i bdag po yin pas dang khong gi 7

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gdan sa gtso bo ma dgon rnam gling nyid yin pas nges par du ma dgon du bzhugs dgos pa'i thob dang go sa yod pa dang / bla mchan ye shes dpal 'byor yang ma dgon gyi bla ma yin pa dang /kurma sku chen yang srid rje mdo sngags chos kyi nyi ma lta bu'i grub brnyes kyi skyes chen dam pas phyi'i byad mdzes pa tsam la bltas par bshad pa yid rton rung ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sprul sku bzhi po yang rgya mchog sba gsum dang ras dbon yang srid bzhi yin zer ba yang the tshom gyi gnas yin tshul kho bos gdan rabs dri med gser phreng du dpyad pa byas zin pa ltar ro/ /de nas khong nas bla ma bkra shis phun tshogs yongs 'dzin du bsten te klog bslabs/ de yang thog mar yongs 'dzin gyis ka kha zhes bslabs pa na ga nga zhes sngon nas sbyangs pa'i bag chags sad pas yi ge 'bri klog thams cad tshegs med du thugs su chud/yongs 'dzin de las dpal yul rang lugs kyi gar thig dbyangs rol dang gtor ma'i mdzub khrid sogs brgyud pa'i phyag srol mtha' dag la sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad/ gso rig pa thub dbang las rtsis dkar nag dang sum rtags dag gsum dang —/ rgya ra 'jigs med blo gros las sgra dang / snyan ngag /spyod 'jug /sdom gsum sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas 8

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar shin tu zhung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/pa'i gzhung che phra du mar gsan sbyang gnang / gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje mi yi rol gar du byon pa lha sprul padma gar dbang bstan 'dzin gtsug gi nor bur bsnyen nas dpal yul rang rkang gi sngon 'gro dang / gtum mo'i myong khrid/ gnam chos rdzogs chen sangs rgyas lag 'chang / phyag chen sogs gser chos kyi rgyun yod do cog la gsan sbyang mthar phyin gnang bas sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur/ dgung lo bco lnga pa la mgar ba gter chen padma bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling pas khong gi gter chos kyi chos bdag tu mnga' gsol te/ gter gsar cha tshang gi dbang lung man ngag mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang zhing / khong gis sprul bsgyur gyis byon nas bskrun pa'i sras yin zhes gsungs/ sgo mang gnas kyi brag a ha rgya can nas bton pa'i gu ru bde ba chen po'i sku brnyan dang mtsho rgyal mgul phur gter byon/ bka' srung gza' bdud nag po sogs gces nor du bstsal te nang thugs kyi sras mchog tu dbang bskur / de nas mkhas grub dbang po sde tso mkhan po bsod nams dpal ldan gyi zhabs pad spyi bor bkur te rab tu byung zhing bka' 'gyur chen mo'i ljags lung dang spyod 'jug /sdom gsum / yon tan mdzod rtsa 'grel/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ mngon 9

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/mdzod / rgyud bla ma sogs byams chos sde lnga/ dbu ma 'jug pa rtsa 'grel sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs du mar gsan sbyang bgrang bya mang por gnang / dgung grangs nyer gnyis pa la kun mkhyen mi pham phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi zhal slob ma hā paṇḍi ta maḥthog si tu chos kyi rgya mtsho mchog sde tsho mkhan po bsod nams dpal ldan gyis dar thang 'dir gdan drangs pa'i drung nas dpal ldan zhi 'tsho'i sdom rgyun las bsnyen par rdzogs nas bstan pa'i rtsa ba dam chos 'dul ba rin po che'i rgyal mtshan phyag tu bzhes/ rgya chen spyod pa'i srol ltar gyi byang chub sems sdom dang / sangs rgyas gling pa'i zab gter dgong 'dus yongs rdzogs kyi smin grol mtha' dag gsan bzhes gnang zhing / rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang gi skabs su khri mthon por bzhugs su gsol te rdo rje slob dpon chen po ston pa'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ dgung grangs nyer gsum pa la dpal yul rnam rgyal gling du phebs te dpal yul grub dbang sprul sku rig 'dzin dpal chen 'dus pa'am thub bstan chos kyi glang po'i zhabs las bgrang bya lnga tsam la phyag rdzogs kyi gdams khrid cha tshang dang snying thig snyan brgyud chen mo sogs zab khrid rgya mtsho lta bu gsan sbyang mthar phyin gnang bas sa lam gyi yon tan 10

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar shin tu nyung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/dbyar gyi me tog bzhin du thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing rtogs 'bul rlogs gcod mang du phul bas thugs dgyes pa'i rtser son nas nang thugs kyi sras gcig tu gyur/ dgung grangs nyer drug pa sa lug lor rje nyid las/ rin chen gter mdzod kyi dbang lung zla drug la gsan/ gzhan yang dgongs zang dang /dgongs 'dus/ 'ja' tshon pod drug /bka' brgyad mdo byang /khams lugs mdo sgyu sogs snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi smin grol mtha' yas pa gsan/ mkhan chen ngag gi dbang po padma las 'brel rtsal las/ snying thig snyan brgyud dang / ya bzhi/ dum gnyis / lce btsun snying thig bcas dbang khrid du ma mnos/dgung grangs sum bcu pa la klu shul mkhan po dkon mchog me tog las/ rje'i lam rim chen mo dang / phar phyin rnam bshad snying rgyan/ legs bshad gser phreng / 'jug 'grel dgongs pa rab gsal/ drang nges legs bshad snying po/ rgyud gsang snying sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen du mar thos bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa'i rtse mor gyur/ khra dge slong las dril lugs mkha' spyod ma'i dbang gsan/ dge slong tshang nas nga rdza khrod cig tu nyal dred 'jigs su rung ba zhig la 'phrad pa las dpal yul mchog sprul la dbang skur rgyu de skrag /a kha kha nga 'di 'dra'i sa 11

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/mthon po na bzhugs pa'i skyes chen dam pa zhig la 'phrad ma myong zhes yang yang gsungs skad/ gtsang grub byams pa chos 'dzin gyi drung du byon pas/ grub chen gyi gzigs snang du shar ri'i phag nas tshes bco lnga'i zla 'od nam mkhar shar tshe nub ri'i sgor dar mdung gnam la zug 'dra gsum gzigs/ zla 'od sa gzhi yongs la shar tshe gu ru padma 'byung gnas gnam sa gang ba zhig gis zhal gzigs te/ sang nangs bar khyod rtsa ba'i bla ma dang mjal ba yin gsung nas mi snang bar gyur/ phyi'i nangs par skyabs rje mchog sprul rin po che mdun du phebs pas/ grub chen nas/ bdag gi bla ma rgya sprul rin po che'i yang sprul 'khrul med yin zhes gus bkur brtse gzigs bla na med pa gnang ste/'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bstsal nas thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ dgung lo so bdun pa'i dus tsam la a skyes gter chen o rgyan mkha' spyod gling pa bla mar bsten nas de nyid kyi gter gsar cha tshang gi dbang lung gdams khrid ma lus pa gsan zhing / gter ston tshad ma yin pa'i bsngags brjod phul/ gzhan yang yag shul mkhan po blo gros dang / a pang gter chen dpa' bo chos dbyings rdo rje/ gter sras rdo rje dgra 'dul/ ka thog mkhan po 12

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar shin tu nyung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/legs bshad 'byor ldan/ a mchog 'jams dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi bshes gnyen du ma las /bka' gdams/ lam 'bras/ zhi shangs/ bka' brgyud chos drug /gcod yul sogs zab chos man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan bsam rdo rus thug pa mdzad do//gnyis pa ni/ chung ngu nas nam rgyun bstan 'gro'i don sogs bya ba dmigs bsal can gyi 'gul bskyod med tshe nangs snga mo thor thun dang / zhogs tsha bzhes rjes dros thun dang /gdugs tshod gsol rjes dgung thun dang / mtshan mor nub thun bcas thun bzhir chos spyod bsnyen sgrub ting nge 'dzin la yang dag par 'jog pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa la gnas te zhag gnyis tsam las sku tshe hril bor rang dgar bag yangs su btang ma myong bar grags shing tha na rlung bum chen gcig mtshan mo nyal ba'i dus ma gtogs chad ma myong bar grags/ mdor na sku tsher bka' gter gsar rnying gi lha rab 'byams kyi bsnyen sgrub dang bskyed rdzogs la nyams len nar mar gnang bas sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan mngon du gyur te sa lam gyi yon tan thugs rgyud la smin pas don gyi skyes chen dam pa'i go sa la dbang 'byor/tshul shin tu btsun zhing / 'dul lung sde bzhi dang / byang chub 13

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/sems dpa'i sde snod dang sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams nas bshad pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi dgag sgrub kyi bslab bya mtha' dag tshul bzhin du thugs nyams su bzhes pas nyes ltung phra mo tsam gyis kyang gos ma myong / tha na bzhugs pa'i tshe dang byon bzhud gang gi skabs yin yang g.yas g.yon sku rgyab rnams su sku g.yo ba dang spyan rgyang ring bor gzigs pa dang / ma brtags pa'i ngag gi ca co sogs ye mi mdzad par spyan gnya' shing gang tsam du phab ste gom pa dal bus byon pa sogs spyod lam zhi dul kho na gnang bas / kun gyis dpal yul mchog sprul gser sku ja gsol yin zhes bsngags/ sku lus la tshul khrims kyi dri ngad bzang po rgyun par 'thul zhing / tha na na bza' dang / bzhugs gdan/ chibs sga / gsol phor/ mchil snod yan chad dang / gzim shag dang /byon pa'i nye 'khor tshun chad la dri bzang gis khyab pas skye bo kun gyi dad pa'i sgo dbang med du 'byed pa'i rnam thar gyi snyan pa phyogs kun tu khyab/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems dbang rnon gyi rtags su sku lus la rngul rdul gyi dri ma dang shig dang srin bu rnams sku tshe gang bor byung ma myong bar nye gnas sogs kun la rlung ltar du grags/ 'du khang gi rtsig pa la sku rgyab brten te dpe gzigs gnang bzhin yod pa la mi dkar po gos dkar gyon pa 14

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar shin tu nyung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/dbu skra 'khyil ler yod pa shub khra btags pa zhig gis shel gyi ral gris thugs kur drag bsnun 'ga' byas pa'i snang ba zhig shar / de nas bzung mkhyen rab kyi rtsal thogs med du rgyas te gzhung lugs kun la bslab pa la ma ltos par rang shugs kyis thugs su chud de mkhas pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ bsnyen bsgrub cig gi skabs su zangs mdog dpal rir o rgyan rin po che dang thugs yid ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i dag snang zla bzhi'i yun la shar bar rje nyid kyi zhal nas nye gnas shig la gsungs shing mnyam med o rgyan ma'i gsol 'debs de yang de dus gsungs pa yin par grags/ rdo rje phur ba'i tshom bu tshogs sgrub cig gi skabs su yul gsum gyad du gyur pa'i bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i rtags su slob ma rnams kyis dbu gsum pa dang / khro bo'i phyag mtshan gyi rnam par mthong ba dang / tshe sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub chen zhig gi skabs su 'du khang dang dgon pa'i tho phyi thams cad 'ja' dang 'od sna tshogs kyis gang ba dang /bka' brgyud sman sgrub chen mo gnang skabs su ril bu 'phel zhing —/ 'du khang du 'ja' thig du mas gang ba dang / phur ba zla sgrub cig gi skabs su gtor ma las me tog dkar ser dmar ljang sna tshogs skyes pa dang / hom khung nas nya bo'i skad ngan 15

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/'don pa dang / thugs sgrub zla sgrub cig gi skabs su thod pa'i bdud rtsi khol zhing lud pa dang /yang phur ba yang gsang bla med kyi tshom bu tshogs sgrub cig gi skabs su sgrub gtor gyi 'bru gdan nas khra tshig ma las myu gu sngo ljang skyes pa sogs mthun snang du grub pa byung / chung dus su lha'i zhal gzigs te sngon dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du skye ba bzhes tshul mang po dang —/zhal las/ rang nyid chung nga'i rmi lam nyang 'khrul brdar/ /bde ba'i rdo rje khrag 'thung rol ba rtsal//zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi dpa' bo'i gsang ming bstsal pa dang / byang shambha lar brdzus te skyes nas zla bcu gnyis la bzhugs pa dran pa dang / nam mkha' la zangs mdog dpal ri'i bkod pa gsal bar 'char ba dang /za hor rgyal pos gu ru rin po che gson bsregs mdzad pa'i las mir gyur cing mthar gu ru las bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbang gsan pa dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skye ba bzhes tshul dran pa sogs sgom rtags kyi yon tan mtha' yas mod thugs sgam pas ji bzhin mi gsung / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu dregs pa rnams bstan srung du bkol ba dang rgyal 'gong mang po dam la btags pa dang / dus gsum gyi nyes legs sgrib med du mkhyen pa sogs phyi rtags kyi yon tan mtha' 16

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar shin tu nyung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/yas pa mnga'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dgung lo dgu ba la tshes bcu'i khrom dbang dang ri chos gsum gyi dbang lung gnang bas sgo phyes te bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i dbu brtsams/ dgung lo nyer gnyis pa la rgyal rong rgyal khag lngas gdan zhus ltar phebs te dbang lung chos bka' du ma gnang / dgung lo nyer lnga pa la dar thang du dbyar gnas kyi srol gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so gcig pa rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing phyi'i lor dar thang du gter mdzod kyi dbang lung zla drug la gnang / 'di skor gdan sa'i khur bzhes/ lha sprul nang so skyar gsos dang / sgrub grwa skyar gsos / gser khang chen mo rten dang brten pa gsar bzhengs/ri khrod thar ba rtse gsar bzhengs sogs rnam dkar rten bzhengs kyi rim pa mang du mdzad/ dgung lo so drug lor slar cog rtse dang / so mang / rdzong 'gag /dam pa/ khro chu sogs rgyal rong gi yul gru du mar phebs te dgon sde nyams pa skyar gsos dang dbang lung khrid bka' grangs mang gnang / dgung grangs so bdun par smar rong dgon du gter mdzod kyi smin grol gnang /dpal yul rnam rgyal gling phyag phreng gi dmag gis bshig pa slar gso rgya chen mdzad/ dgung lo zhe bzhi pa la rma stod du kun 17

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gzigs paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng dgu pa dang mjal zhing dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi dbang zhus/ paṇa chen rin po ches/ khong la sog mer gan mkhan po'i mtshan gnas dang / gser yig gser tham dang / sog chas kyi lwa ba sgo bzhi 'brug ris can la mtshal gyi phyag tham 'byar ba can rnams gnang zhing / paṇa chen gyi bzhugs sgar mthong sar yang mchog sprul rin po che'i gur la gser tog 'dzug pa dang / dbu gdugs 'dzug pa dang / sgar gling 'bud pa dang / gzim brda'i gling bu 'bud pa dang / sgar gsol 'don pa dang / chibs thog tu phebs chog pa sogs kyi dmigs bsal du ma dang / chab mdo yan nas lha sa bar khral 'u lag gis skyel bsu dgos pa'i bka' shog sogs gnang ste bkur bzo tshad med pa mdzad/ khyed lta bu'i grub mtha' ris med la mkhas shing thugs sems dkar ba dkon ces bsngags brjod mang du gnang / paṇa chen tshang dang phyag mdzod gnyis nas khyed kyi sku tsher 'chang ba'i byin rten zhig dgos gsungs pa ltar paṇa chen rin po cher khong gi phyag dril dang phyag mdzod la ting shag cig phul/ zhal gyes khar yang paṇa chen rin po ches dbu thod gtugs te thugs smon gnang / dgung lo zhe bdun par lha sar phebs bzhed kyis thog mar khams dpal yul du 18

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar shin tu nyung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/phebs / dbang khrid chos bka' mang du gnang / lcags sbrul lor go 'jor byon cing khams phyogs brgyud de lha ldan du phebs/chab mdo nas bod gzhung gi 'u lag gis skyel bsu dang /nag chu nas se ra'i tsha ba khang tshan bsu mar thon/ de nas lha sa jo shāka rnam gsum dang / se 'bras dga' gsum/ rgyud rwa stod smad/bsam yas/rdor smin sogs gnas rten gdan sa du mar mjal phyag dang gnas 'brel mdzad/ se ra nas gdan zhu gsol 'dren zhus pa ltar mang 'gyed btang / gzhan yang dgon sde so sor mang 'gyed thebs bzhag mang du mdzad/ bsam yas su phebs skabs dkor mdzod gling nas ci'u dmar chibs pa med pa'i zhabs thang zhig gis zhal bstan nas rjes 'jug skyong ba'i dam bca' dang srog snying phul/ rjes su ri khrod mgon khang du tsi'u dmar mdung zhags bsnams shing chibs pa med pa zhig gi zhal thang bzhengs yod pa grwa bgres kun la gsal zhing de nas bzung tsi'u dmar srung ma'i gtso bor byed pa byung / chu lug lor phyir khams dpal yul du phebs/ rnam gling du gter mdzod kyi dbang yongs rdzogs zla bzhi la gnang / de nas brda go ri khrod du bzhugs te dbang lung zab khrid grangs mang gnang / shing sprel lor dar thang du byon/ me khyi lor rgyal rong dang / rdo snyi gser 19

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/thal sogs su phebs te dbang khrid chos 'khor mtha' yas pa bskor / snga phyir gser 'brong ri dang rma chen gangs ri sogs gnas chen du mar phebs te sa gnad gsos shing bstan 'gro'i bde thabs mang du bsgrubs/ rang dgon du lo ltar dbang lung chos khrid grangs med pa gsungs pas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ rnga yul dang / a skyong gong ma tshang / rwa lo tshang / smar shod rong bzhi sogs yul gru du mar phebs te dbang chos gyi sgo nas gzhan phan gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa gnang / mthar dgung grangs re lnga ba rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa pho khyi'i lo ste spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya nga brgyad lo'i hor zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer lnga la gsa'i sgrog chen nam drug chen sum mdor khri mun khang du gling blo ldan zhes pa'i ban sngags shig nye gnas su yod pa la de ring tshes grangs du yin dris pas nye gnas kyis tshes grangs ji bzhin zhus pas 'o da tshogs 'khor zhig bya gsungs nas gsol rten rtsam pa cung zad yod pa des tshogs gtor chung ngu zhig bzos te tshogs mchod bton phral 'das rgyu yin tshul bcas gsungs te dgongs pa dbyings su bsdus shing gzim khang gi phyi nang kun tu 'od dkar gyis gang ba'i ltas mtshan byung / de nas sku gdung yang zhugs 'bul sogs tshad ldan bya thabs ma byung bar drug 20

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar shin tu nyung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/chen sum mdo'i thang smad du sar sbas pa rjes su bstan pa slar dar gyi dus su bya btang dbang po dge rgan bstan 'dzin bzang po sogs kyis bton te gdan drangs pa yin la/ 'di la sku gdung dngos yin min sogs kha zer ba re yod mod gdung sba tshe phyi btson du gyur pa'i rnga yul a 'dus dgon pa'i ban rgan zhig gis pur khang che chung gnyis tsam yod par pur bdun sbas pa las mchog sprul tshang gi gdung de pur khang chung ba der sbas pa mthong ba dang / khos btson khang nas gom pa gzhal ba dang /gdung steng du shug phur zhig btsugs shing rdo dkar rdog po che chung gsum bzhag pa'i rdo dkar rdog po gnyis tsam ngos zin du yod pa dang / yul 'dir ra lo zhes 'bod pa spu ras kyi thul ba zhig gis gdung dril nas sbas pa'i spu dag gdung rus kyi ngos su gsal por yod pa dang / zhal 'tsho skabs dbu'i dpral ba'i ngos su 'bur bo zhig yod pa de dbu'i rus thod du rus 'bur gsal bor yod pa de yin nges dang / skal tshigs kyi bar gseb dang lhu rus kyi mtshams dag tu rang bsrel du mas gang pa bcas khong gi gdung 'khrul med du nges byed gsal bor yod pas na rje 'di'i gdung rus 'khrul med du nges pa rnyed pa yin no / /rje 'di tshul khrims shin tu gtsang zhing mkhyen rtogs dang 21

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/snyan grags che bas bod yul stod smad kun nas dad bkur che zhing grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas grub grangs las 'das pa zhig gis zhabs la btud cing dbang chos mnos pas slob tshogs rgyu skar gyi dpal la co 'dri ba byung / gsung chos kyang dpal yul lugs kyi ri chos gsum gyi zin bris ldeb grangs bzhi brgyar nye ba can dang / legs bshad gser phreng gi mchan 'grel sogs mi nyung ba zhig yod mod cung rtsa che rigs rnams dus 'gyur gyi khrod du mi snang bar gyur nas dpe rgyun chad pa yin la lhag lus rnams 'dir deb tu 'god rtsis kyis lhan gcig tu bsdus pa ltar ro/ /rje 'di nyid kyi yang srid ni grub dbang bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis sku bdag mdzad pa'i mchog sprul 'jigs med chos kyi seng ge tshang yin zhing da lta the wan du zhabs pad brtan ngang bzhugs la/ gzhan yang rje 'di'i yang srid du grags pa re zung yod do/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo rin chen rgyan dor nas/ /bur smrig dge slong gar du dgyes rol ba'i nye 'khor gnyis pa'i mtshan gyi dbyar rnga can/ /bshad sgrub chos kyi zla ba'i legs mdzad cha/ /bskal bar bya gzhan spangs pa'i lce rtse yis / /brjod kyang zad pa'i go skabs kyis phra na/ /blun po'i kha yis gsal rdzogs smra ba ni/ /lha lam ngos su padmo'i ldem 'khyug 22

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar shin tu nyung bar bkod pa gser gyi thig le/'dra / /rgyang mthong grong gi gser gyi bang mdzod la/ /ngag sgros thos pa'i phyugs rdzis mdzub ston ltar/ /ka phreng brgyus pa'i yi ge'i dbugs rta las/ /dam pa'i byung brjod gling bu 'di na bus//dge legs nyi ma'i zer 'bar 'dzum pa des/ /legs bshad rnam mthong 'dab brgya kha 'byed de/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i ge sar bzhad pa'i dris/ /yid can bung ba'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /ces rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs mi yi sha tshugs su byon pa skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul sku ma te badzra ba'i rnam par thar ba shin tu zhung ngur bkod pa 'di nyid rje gang gi gsung chos lhag lus rnams 'phrul par la 'god pa'i nyer bsdogs la brtson pa'i tshe dar thang bstan pa'i bdag po mtshungs med 'dul 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gtsug nor skyabs rje dpal ldan bla ma lha sprul gsum pa thub bstan gar dbang nyin byed bshad sgrub 'phrin las dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas 'di 'dra zhig bris zhes pa'i bka' lung gser gyi cod pan spyi bor bstsal ba ldog tu ma nus par rje de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor bkur ba'i chos gzugs dge stong 'khyam po thub bstan 'phrin ༵ / sna kārsha tram̐ kāswā /sa dkar ba o ji ya na thar ya zhes 'bod pas dar thang du bris 23

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gun /bla sgrub byin rlabs char rgyun zhes bya ba ji dza ha ra/༄7/ /dmigs med mkha' la thugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs / /byin rlabs char rgyun dngos grub dbyig 'jo ba/ /rtsa gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs zhes/ /rab 'byams rgyud sder bsngags pa'i bden don bzhin/ /bla sgrub cho ga nyung ngu 'dikā pasal bya/ /de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/dang na mo /dkon mchog rtsa gsum kun 'dus bla ma rje/ /khyed shes dad pa'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /bdag dang mar gyur mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /rnam grol byang chub thob par sems bskyed do//spyi bor pad zla'i steng du rdo rje sems/ /dkar gsal rdor dril longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas/ /thugs kur zla steng hūṃ la yig brgyas bskor/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs nyams chags sdig sgrib dag /yi ge brgya ba bzla/ mthar ni rdor sems dgyes shing 'dzum pa yis / /nyams chags sdig ltung dag zhes dbugs dbyung bcas/ /rang la thim pas snang kun sgyu ma yi/ /rang bzhin stong gsal ngang 26

byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla sgrub dang gsol 'debs kyi skor/la mnyam par bzhag /gnyis pa ni/ āḥ chos kun dmigs med ka dag rig pa'i gdangs/ /lhun grub snang cha ma 'gags rol pa'i rtsal / /rang gi spyi gtsug khru gang nam mkha' ru/ /seng khri padma 'bum brdal nyi zla'i steng / /dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs mchog /gdod ma'i mgon po dpal ldan mañdzu'i zhabs/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan chos gos rnam gsum dang / /dbu la 'dab ldan padma mthong grol gsol/ /dkyil krung sems nyid ngal gso'i phyag rgya las/ /utpal sdong bu g.yas g.yon gyes pa'i steng //glegs ral tshe bum nor bu'i rgyan ldan 'dzin/ /'ja' thig 'od klong dgyes nyams rab 'bar ba'i/ /thugs dbus dwangs ma'i 'od klong kun tu bzang / /mthing gsal rgyan med dkyil krung mnyam bzhag can/ /bla ma'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan / /phyogs dus rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i/ /rang bzhin ye nas lhun grub chen por bzhugs/ /don dam chos nyid rol ba la//gshegs sogs mtshan ma mi dmigs kyang //rtog bcas 'khrul blo tshim bya'i phyir//spyan drangs tshogs bsags rim pa ni/ /oṃ ka dag spros bral chos sku'i zhing khams nas/ /sku gsum bka' brgyud bla ma spyan 'dren gshegs/ /ma 'gags rang gsal longs sku'i gzhal yas nas/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /gang 'dul rnam rol sprul 27

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/pa'i pho brang nas/ /chos srung dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol//mkha' dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa'i sna tshogs gdan/ /rnam bkra bkod legs dbus su dgyes par bzhugs/ /sgo gsum rab gus dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams yid las byung ba'i mchod sprin dang / /bdag lus zag bral dus gsum dge tshogs 'bul/ /bcas dang rang bzhin thog med nas bsags bshags / /'phags dang so skyes dge la rjes yi rang / /rmad byung rnam grol 'bras bu'i chos 'khor bskor/ /rtag khyab lhun grub chen por bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs bla med byang chub chen por bsngo/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams sgrol ba'i ded dpon shog /mkha' dbyings rgyan gyur rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams/ /kun 'dus rig 'dzin bla ma'i skur thim gyur/ /gsol 'debs dbang bzhi'i rim pa ni/ /khyed shes re ltos gcig chog blo/ /bcos min shugs drag ngar ldan pas/ /'di ltar bsam zhing brjod par bya/ /e ma/ mnyam med bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon gcig pu/ /bka' drin mtshungs med dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rnam 'phrul mchog /skyabs gcig 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gsol ba 'debs/ /'gyur med mi shigs rtag pa rdo rje'i sku/ /'gags med gzhom bral nā da'i rang bzhin gsung / /'khrul med ye stong spros bral 28

byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla sgrub dang gsol 'debs kyi skor/'od gsal thugs/ /gsang gsum mi phyed rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs / /phyi ltar gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /nang ltar rin chen mchog dang lcags zam pa/ /gsang ba kun dga' bo dang rdo rje chos/ /rab 'byams gsang chen mdzod la gsol ba 'debs //rmad byung mkhyen pa'i gter gcig 'jam pa'i dpal//rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs pad dkar 'chang mthu stobs bdud 'dul dbang phyug gsang bdag mchog /kun 'dus rigs gsum mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba sems dpa' grangs med sgyu 'phrul sprin/ /mgon po khyod kyi ye shes rol mo ste/ /kun 'dus kun gyi byed po khyed nyid phyir/ /khyed shes gcig chog blo yis gsol 'debs na/ /thugs rtse'i spyan gyis nam yang mi gtong bar/ /thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i mchil rnon bdag rgyud la/ /thebs te srid pa ru log nges 'byung blo/ /bcos min shugs drag rgyud la skye bar shog /des drangs theg chen lam gyi 'jug sgo mchog /byang chub sems 'byung gang snang sgyu mar shar / /phar phyin drug slob rim gnyis sgrub la brtson/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i lam la nges gnas shog khyad par gsang chen 'od gsal snying po'i lam/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol mnyam pa'i ngang / /chos nyid rang bzhag chen po'i dgongs pa la rang 29

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/byan tshud pa'i lta ba'i rang ngo la/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin mnyam par 'jog pa yis/ /ka dag rig pa cog bzhag chen po'i klong / /lhun grub snang bzhi'i sa lam myur bgrod nas/ /gzhon nu bum skur mngon byang chub par shog /rigs bdag bla ma'i gsang gsum 'khor lo yi/ /yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing —/ /rim byung bdag gi gnas gsum la thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang byin rlabs thob/ /sgrib gsum dag cing lam gsum sgom la dbang / /'bras bu sku gsum sa bon rgyud la bzhag /slar yang gnas las 'od zer sna tshogs dang / /kun bzang thugs nas skye med as mtshan 'od/ /mthing zhun thig phran lug rgyud brgyan pa byung / /snying gar thim pas brjod med don dbang thob/ /cha mnyam sgrib dag blo 'das sgom la dbang / /'bras bu sku gsum dbyer med mngon du byas/ /rjes su bla ma 'od zhu ba'i//dmigs pa rang sems ka dag ni//rang ngo so ma ma bcos ngang //bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med blta/ /bla ma dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu/ /snying dbus padma'i ze'u 'bru rgyas pa'i rtser/ /stong gsal ma 'gags 'od kyi phung por bzhugs/ /sems nyid dus gsum skye 'gags gnas bral klong / /ma yengs rang byung bla ma'i rang zhal la/ /'dzin med rang babs ngang du mnyam par bzhag /a a a/ dge 30

byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla sgrub dang gsol 'debs kyi skor/ba 'dis mtshon bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /gnas lugs rang byung ye shes mngon gyur te/ /zag bral 'pho med rdo rje'i sku 'grub nas/ /tshe 'dir mngon par byang chub mchog thob shog /ces pa'i bla sgrub nyung ngu 'di nyid dad brtson sgrub la 'dun pa'i blo can 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho nas nan ltar bskul ngor rig pa 'dzin pa rdo je khrag 'thung bdud 'dul rtsal lam 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rol mo nas zloX pa bkra shis par gyur cig /oṃ āḥ gu ru mdzi shrī he badzra sarba siddhi hū ༄ga /bla sgrub byin rlabs mchog stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /na mo gu ru bhya/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa chos kyi dbyings/ /'gags med gsal dag rdzogs pa longs sku'i tshul / /sna tshogs 'gro ba 'dren pa sprul pa'i sku/ /rnam gsum gcig tu rdzogs pa'i bla mar 'dud/ /dngos yid rnam par dag pa'i mchod tshogs 'bul/ /sdom gsum gzhi bcas nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /dkar chos sgrub pa yongs la rjes yi rang / /gang 'tsham chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol/ /mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs/ /dge tshogs bla med byang chub chen por 31

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bsngo / /spyi bor rdor sems cha lugs yongs rdzogs can/ /thugs ku'i sngags las bdud rtsi'i rgyun nar babs/ /yig brgya ci nus su bzlas rjes/ ā/ mdun mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan gyi steng / /rgyal kun 'dus zhal rtsa ba'i bla ma ni//sku mdog mthing ga gcer bu rus rgyan can/ /rdo rje dril bu gar gyis yum la 'khyud/ /snang stong zung 'jug don dam 'pho ba med/ /kun zlum bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin la/ /gshegs bzhugs skye 'gags gnas pa'i mtshan ma bral/ /rten 'brel yul la dbang pa'i rgyal po ste/ /gnas gsum yi ges phyogs bcu'i zhing gnas pa'i//sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs bla mar bstim/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dam chos bdud rtsi'i mdzod/ /dge 'dun yongs rje dpal ldan bla ma la / /khyed shes bsam pa brtan pos gsol 'debs na/ /rdo rje gsum gyis sgo gsum smin par mdzod/ /si ci nus su bzlas rjes dbang bzhi blang pa ni/ /rigs bdag bla ma'i gnas gsum yi ge las/ /rdo rje gsum 'od dkar dmar mthing ba'i mdog /bdag gi gnas gsum thim pas sgrib gsum dag /ka dag ye shes tshig dbang rin chen thob/ /ka ya wakka tsitta sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa trīḥ rigs bdag bla ma 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ /tshangs bug nas zhugs a wa dhu ti'i sbubs/ /mchong gur smug po rang mdangs dag pa'i 32

byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla sgrub dang gsol 'debs kyi skor/dbyings / /gnyis med ro gcig nam mkha' khyab par brdal/ /a a a/zhes pa 'di yang rang slob du gyur ba'i btsun pa rang lo nas bkra shes pa'i ras dkar bcas nan cher bskul ngor dpal sprul ma te nas mgyogs par bris pa re zhig rdzogs so//shri maṅga lo/dza yan tu/༄gi /rang gnas ye shes mchog gi rang zhal nyid/ /mngon du ston mdzad bla ma dam pa dang / /sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du smin byed pa'i/ /gtor blugs cho ga ster ba'i slob dpon de/ /phyogs dus rgyal bas drang don ma yin par/ /rdo rje slob dpon dngos grub kun bdag ces/ /rgyud sde rgya mtshor lan gcig ma yin par//bsngags tshig me tog phreng ba tshar du dngar/ /de phyir mnyam med bla ma chos kyi rje/ /phyi ltar ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras/ /nang ltar byang sems bslab spyod 'gro ba'i bshes/ /gsang ba rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor can/ /'khor lo'i mgon der kha tsam ma yin par/ /mi phyed dad pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs//rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i snang brnyan 'jam pa'i dpal/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro la rjes brtses dgyes rol pa/ /gsang gsum mi phyed rdo rje grub pa'i dpyid/ /'jigs med chos kyi zla bar gsol ba 'debs / /rig 'dzin yongs kyi gtso mchog thod phreng rtsal/ /mthu stobs rdo rje rab 'bar tshom bu dgu'i/ /khrag 'thung rgyal po yongs kyi bdud dgra'i dpung / /'dul ba'i nus rtsal //sa

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/med rab 'byin pa'i/ /rdo rje che mchog 'dus pa rtsal grags pa'i//rnam 'dren bla ma mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / /tshe chos legs tshogs yar zla ltar 'phel nas/ /rlung sems snang ba dbang 'dus 'khrul gzugs gdon / /dam sri rgyal 'gong skye med dbyings bsgral mdzod/ /rtag tu khyod zhabs bde chen rgyan bzhugs te/ /zag bral brtse chen thugs kyis nyer dgongs nas/ /don dam 'pho med lhan skyes bde ba che/ /rang zhal mjal te mngon par byang chub shog /ces chos kyi zla bas rang la che bstod gzhan yid khrel ba'i rgyur byang 'dren pa shākya'i dge slong rig 'dzin rnam grol nas don gnyer chen pos bskul pa ltar bris pa dge/jug /rtsa gsum rgyal kun 'dus zhal rigs kyi bdag /ma hā gu ru padma thod phreng dang / /'gyur med gsang gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i dpal/ /nges don bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /sa gsum 'phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po/ /khyed shes mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /mi mthun nyer 'che'i mtshan ma kun zhi zhing / /tshe chos mthar phyin bsam don lhun grub mdzod/ /ces ming gi rnam grangs gzhan dang sbyar nas bris/༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ rig stong chos sku'i bum pa sku yi gdangs / /ma 'gags rol pa 'dzin med rgya yan pa/ /shar grol sgyu ma rdo rje sprin gyi 'phrul/ /rtog pa'i srog khrag 'thung la ches 34

byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla sgru ba dar gsol 'debs kyi skor/rngam pa'i/ /khams gsum bdud dgra ma lus 'dul ba'i dpal/ /gzhi snang lhun grub rtsal las yongs shar ba'i/ /sa gsum bla ma rigs gsum he ru kur/ /byang chub bar du gdung bas gsol ba 'debs / /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i mi mthun kun zhi zhing / /tshe bsod yon tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /rlung sems snang ba dbang du 'du ba dang / /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal bar byin gyis rlobs//zhes pa'ang 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes rang gi gsang ming dang sbyar nas bris pa'o//mu / /na mo gu ru/ rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes mchog nyid kyi //'byung gnas bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam bzang por//dpal gyi mgul nas 'od gsal zhes pa'i sgra//ston pa chos nyid ka dag brjod bral che/ /gcig dang du mar 'khor dang mya ngan 'das/ /gar yang ma chad phyogs su ma lhung ba'i/ /kun mnyam klong chen rang rig byang chub sems/ /'bad rtsol las 'das yangs pa bdal ba che//dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gcig bsdus pa//brjod med don gyi bla ma'i rang zhal la/ /mtha' bral blo 'das chen por gsol ba 'debs//dmigs med brtse chen thugs rje'i chu rgyun gyis/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i dri ma gzhir sangs te/ /lhun grub klong nas mtshan dpe'i skur snang zhing / /mkha' khyab sbyad

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/can rdul bral rdo rje'i skur/ /mig 'phrul ji bzhin sad pa'i mthu thob shog /ces blo gsal padma 'gro 'dul nas bskul ngo ma ldog tsam du 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes bris pa dge'o//༄7/ /na mo gu ru/ shes bya'i gnas la mkhyen pa'i pad stong bzhad / /nyam thag 'gro la ma ltar brtse ba'i mgon/ /yongs grub 'gyur med bden don ji bzhin gzigs/ /phyogs med bstan pa rgya mtsho 'dzin pa'i bshes/ /phan bde'i 'phrin las dkar pos sa gsum khyon/ /kun khyab grags pa'i dpal gyi bzang po'i gtam / /phyogs kyi mdzes mas dbyangs su len pa yi/ /mtshungs med dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /skye kun khyod kyi zhabs pad mi 'bral zhing / /gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rang blo'i rkang drug brtas/ /don bzang ro myong yid kyi mun pa bcom/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i go 'phang mchog grub shog /ces pa'ang skul po'i ngor rang ming gi rnam grangs gzhan dang sbyar nas ji bzhin min pa'i gcam bur bris/༄ga /oṃ swa sti/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i rang gzugs 'jam pa'i dpal/ /snyigs dus ngur smrig gar gyis dgyes rol pa /gsang gsum mi phyed rdo rje grub pa'i mchog /thub bstan chos kyi zla bar gsol ba 'debs/ /chos dbyings dri bral don gyi ye shes zhal / /mngon gyur spangs rtogs mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dpal sprul chos kyi zla bas shar mar bris pa dge legs 'phel/36

byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla sgrub dang gsol 'debs kyi skor/༄sto /rgyal kun gsang gsum gcig bsdus(dpe kha cig tu 'gro ba'i dpal zhes pa snang)bstan 'gro'i dpal/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen gcig gyur pa/ /mnyam med bla ma chos kyi zla ba'i zhabs //gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis mthar phyin shog /ces na thog nas rong bo bla ma rin chen rdo rjes bskul ngor dpal sprul ma pas bris pa dge/༄༄/ /rgyal kun mkhyen gzugs ye shes 'jam dpal thugs / /'gags med brtse chen dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i gsung / /thub bstan nyin byed gsum ldan rdo rje'i sku/ /'jigs med chos kyi zla bar gsol ba 'debs/ /dgyes pa rdo rjes so//༄7/ /phyi ltar bde gshegs sras gyur sgra gcan 'dzin/ /nang ltar grub pa'i dbang phyug lcags zam pa/ /gsang ba rigs gsum sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs //zhes pa 'di'ang mchog ming chos kyi zla bas so//༄ / /oṃ su sti/ ngag gi dbang phyug blo gter 'jam pa'i dpal / /bde stong rol ba dgyes pa'i 'dzum rlabs las/ /nyer thon gsang gsum rdo rje grub pa'i dpal/ /mtshungs med dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /༄7/ /gzhi yi rig pa kun khyab byang chub sems/ /gzhi snang 37

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/ma 'gags lhun grub mtshan dpe'i sprin/ /gang 'dul spro bsdus rol ba bsam yas mkhan/ /kun byed gdod ma'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /yab rje 'gro ba'i bla ma gter chen rje'i/ /lung byang mkha' 'gro'i zhal gdams las byung mtshan/ /ngag dbang kun dga' dpal ldan zhes grags shing / /rang nyid chung ngu'i rmi lam nying 'khrul brdar/ /bde ba'i rdo rje khrag 'byung rol ba rtsal/ /thog mar chos lam 'dren byed sngon 'gro'i dus/ /padma 'gyur med bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyis/ /kun khyab sa gsum dge legs dpal bzang po/ /bstan rtsa chos 'dul rin chen sgron me mchog /ma pham mgon po chos kyi rgya mtsho las/ /thob pa'i skal bzang bdag gir bgyis pa'i mtshan/ /thub bstan 'jigs med chos kyi zla ba che/ /bshad sgrub 'phrin las rab brtan dpal bzang po/ /rgya chen spyod srol byang sems sdom mnos mtshan/ /rgyal sras gzhan phan chos kyi zla bar grags/ /bod yul bla sgrub kun gyi mthar thug bcud/ /yang zab gser chos dgongs 'dus smin grol bcas/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po si tu pas/ /rtsa ba'i gsang mtshan dpal gyis dbu drangs nas/ /padma badzra rtsal zhes rig 'dzin gyi/ /rdo rje slob dpon mchog tu mnga' gsol mdzad/ /dpal mgon bla ma chos kyi glang po dang / /kun 38

byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla sgrub dang gsol 'debs kyi skor/mkhyen rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i gtsos/ /ris med skyes chen rnams las smin grol bcud/ /bka' gter gsar sogs brgyud srol so so las/ /byung ba'i skal bzang bdag gir thob pa'i mtshan/ /grub dbang rin po che las rgyud sde bka' ma'i mdo dbang skabs/rig 'dzin rdo rje khrag 'thung bdud 'dul rtsal/ /nying gter bka' brgyad mdo byang chen po'i skabs/rdo rje che mchog 'dus pa rtsal zhes dang —/ /kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po las ya bzhi'i smin byed skabs/gang shar zhen med sna tshogs rang grol rtsal/ /lang gro'i rnam sprul gter chen bla ma yis/ /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhes pa dang /dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rol mo zhes pa gnang / /khyab bdag dpal chen 'dus pa'i drung /kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal min byed skabs / /kun bzang 'od gsal klong chen yangs par grags/ /nā ro'i dngos sprul khra dge slong nas/dril lugs rnal 'byor ma yi smin byed skabs / /gsang mtshan snang mdzad rdo rje don grub rtsal/ /gsang chen snga 'gyur mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi/ /bka' srol thun min khams lugs sbrang rtsi'i rgyun/ /smin grol dga' ston thob pa'i gsang pa'i mtshan/ /bajid pa'i rgyal po/rdo rje thig le nyi shar rtsal zhes gnang —/ /de dag sa khams gser gyi rang bzhin ltar/ /'byung rung 'bras bu'i dus la dgongs pas na/ /'bras bu mngon gyur 39

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /'gyur med lhan skyes ye shes rtogs par shog /ces pa'ang khyab bdag bla ma legs bshad rtsal gyi(kaḥthog mkhan po legs bshad 'byor ldan yin pa 'dra)bka' phebs ldog tu ma nus par rgan po'i rang bzhin can mchog gi bla dwags dpyangs pa des bris pa dge zhing bkra shes//sngag /zhabs brtan smon tshig 'chi med grub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba/༄7/ /oṃ swa ste/ rmad byung tshogs gnyis dpal gyi gzi byin las / /thub bstan dge legs bye ba'i 'byung gnas mchog /'jigs med seṅge smra ba'i chos kyi tshul/ /bsgrags pas zhi bsil mchog ster zla ba ltar/ /snyigs mas gdung ba'i mun stug sel ba'i gnyen/ /bshad sgrub sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston legs 'god pas / /blo ldan rkang drug lang tsho rab brtan pa'i/ /'phrin las dpal gyis sa gsum khyab pa yi/ /grags snyan bzang po'i ba dan mngon mtho ba/ /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rang mdangs mngon snang bas/ /rdo rje'i gnas mchog zab gsal phra ba'i dbyings/ /ji bzhin gzigs pa'i mkhas grub khyu mchog gang / /zhabs pad bskal pargyar brtan cing bzhed pa'i don/ /chos ldan yid bzhin lhun grub don gnyis dpal/ /yar ngo'i zla bzhin gong du 'phel 40

byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla sgrub dang gsol 'debs kyi skor/ba yi/ /bde legs sa gsum khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang don gnyer can 'ga'i ngor dpal sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rol mos gang shar thal thol du smras pa dge'o//༄7/ /o su sti/ ngag gi dbang phyug mkhyen gter 'jam pa'i dpal/ /gdul khams rgya mtshor rjes chags dgyes pa'i nyams / /gsang gsum mi phyed rdo rje sprul pa'i gar/ /mtshungs med dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor zhabs zung rdo rje'i khrir/ /mi g.yo bstan pa'i sgron mer rtag bzhugs nas/ /sa gsum 'gro la mdo sngags chos kyi char/ /'dzad med phan bde'i gsos su bsgril ba yi/ /dge mtshan bkra shis 'bum gyi gzi byin can/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rgyan du rtag 'bar zhing / /don gnyis lhun grub snang ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /brtan g.yo'i phun tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang dpal sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rol mo'am thub bstan 'jigs med chos kyi zla bas bris pa dge/༄7/ /na mo gu ru ma rtswa ṣa ya/ tshangs dbang che dgu'i bsod nams dpal gyi gzis/ /gang gi ba spu'i khung bu'i yon tan cha/ /shas tsam mi mtshon ngag gi dpal 'dzin pa/ /blo gter 'jam pa'i rdo rjes shes pa stsol/ /gang mtshan bdud ci'i thig pa lan gcig tsam/ /sgra 'dzin sim pa'i mod la snying gi mun/ /sdub

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bsal de nyid snang ba'i mchog ster ba/ /'jam mgon thugs rje'i gzi 'od las 'khrungs pa'i/ /mnyam med bla ma mdzi he badzra//gsol ba 'debs so mi shigs rdo rje'i khrir/ /g.yo med bskal ba rgya mtshor brtan bzhugs nas/ /bstan 'gro'i rgyad mun rmang nas gzhil bar smon/ /deng nas khyod zhabs bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan / /mi 'bral gtsug gi nor bur rtag 'bar zhing / /smin grol bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ngoms med par/ /blo yi padmo'i dpal du nyer bzung ste/ /snang grag rtog tshogs dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang —/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma 'od gsal chen po'i sbubs/ /rnam grol gnyug ma chos sku'i rang zhal mchog /mngon mjal tshe 'dir byang chub 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di'ang khong nyid kyi gsung du kha cig bshad //༅/ na mo ratna tra ya ya/ tshad med srid zhi'i mgon gyur cing —/ /yon tan gter gyi mdzod mnga' ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i sa mkhan mchog /yang srid nyi ma gzhon nu'i zhal/ /mi ring myur du bsgyur nas kyang / /bdag sogs 'gro blo chos la bsgyur / /gang zhig gang 'dul mdzad pas skyongs/ /'phrin las byed por bdag gyur cig /ces pa'ang 'bangs mi thugs brtses bskyangs thob dpal sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes gsol ba rtse gcig tu smon pa 42

byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla sgrub dang gsol 'debs kyi skor/dge'o /༄/ tsho/ /na mo gu ru/ rang rig stong gsal 'gags med bde ba che/ /bde gshegs snang mtha'i thugs dang dbyer med dbyings / /rang bab ma bcos ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bde chen zhing du 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes ser shul ngag dbang gi ngor dpal sprul rgan bu chos kyi zla bas bris/༄7/ /oṃ su ste/ kun khyab mkha' klong yangs pa'i ngang / /kun mkhyen thugs rje'i rtsal chen g.yos/ /kun byed rig pa'i rol mo'i gdangs/ /kun nas 'gro khams 'di ltar bsgrag /kye ma mtha' med 'khor bar lus blangs pa'i/ /grangs ni mngon mkhyen rgyal bas kyang / /tshad dpog nus pa ma yin na/ /byis blo bdag gis ga la zhig /'on tang tshe rabs 'ga' zhig ni/ /rdo rje'i gsung mnga' bla ma dang / /rang gi'ang nyams la gang shar ba / /mdor bsdus ngo mtshar snyan sgra sgrog /tshe sngon bcom ldan thub pa'i drung / /gzhon nu bde ba'i ro langs zhes/ /gsang ba bla na med pa yi/ /chos kyi gdul bya gtso bor gyur/ /de rjes mi mjed 'jig rten 'di'i/ /shar phyogs mi tri zhes bya'i yul/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pa 'od/ /yul 'khor brgyad khri la dbang ngo / /de 'og dpal ldan klu sgrub kyi/ /slob chen ar ya de wa zhes/ /de nyid ma lus rtogs ston mkhan/ /phyi rgol ngan pa'i smra 43

dpa la yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/ba 'byin/ /de 'og gangs ljongs yul gru 'dir/ /mtshungs med mtsho skyes bla ma yis/ /mdo sngags bstan pa drangs pa'i tshe yig mkhan a tsar ya sa le/ /bden gnyis snang stong zung 'jug tu/ /rtogs shing mkhas grub gnyis dang ldan/ /ye shes sgyu ma sprul pa'i gar / /rnga yab gling du padma'i drung / /nus ldan bde ba'i rdo rje rtsal / /snang sems sgyu ma lha skur ldang / /de rjes srid pa'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /gar dbang bde chen padma gling / /tshangs dbyangs rdo rje sde khri pa/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mi dbang rje/ /'jigs byed rnal 'byor tshul rdor dang / /dge 'dun grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs/ /mkhan po 'dul 'dzin mi rje dang / /sngags 'chang skye bo mo la sogs / /bya dang ri dwags sogs kyang brdzus/ /mthar ni byang phyogs sham bha lar/ /rig ldan chos rgyal chen po las/ /sngagasa'adi sna/ // /sdu / song / 'di ni skyabs rje rin po che sku chung ngu'i dus zhal nas 44

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/༄7/ /thun mong blo ldog bzhi yis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /thar 'dod tshig tsam min pa'i nges 'byung blo/ /bskyed de mkha' mnyam mar gyur 'gro ba la/ /snying rje'i bsam pas rab drangs byang chub mchog /thob 'dod bsags sbyangs gnad kyis zin pa yi / /dngos gzhi'i lam mchog zab mo rdzogs pa che/ /tshig la mi ltos blo yis ma bcos pa/ /rang bzhin lhun mnyam chos nyid bdal ba che/ /ye ji bzhin pa'i ngang du 'jog pa gnad/ /de las tshogs drug blo yi shar cha gang / /ci byung gtad med 'dzin pa'i gzeb dang khrol/ /snang srid dag mnyam bla ma'i rnam rol du/ /shes pa'i har sangs rjen pa'i rang ngo skyongs/ /zag med dge rtsa 'khor gsum dmigs med dbyings/ /mig 'phrul lta bus 'gro la bsngo ba yi/ /sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i nyams len gces///shā dro'i ngor kun bzang 'od gsal klong chen yangs pa'am mchog ming chos kyi zla ༄7/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor mi lus rin chen 'di/ /rgyu dpe grangs kyi rnyed dka' yang yang soms/ /rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag tshul gzigs na//sdug bden phung por nam 'chi cha med nges/ /dkar nag las 'bras rgyal ba'i bdag bzhes na/ /las 'bras bslu med rang la 'byung bar nges/ /de phyir rang gi 'dun ma gtan gyi don/ /rtsa 46

yon tan gyi rtsa ba zhal gad /sa sogs kyi skor/ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun dngos la/ /mi phyed snying nas dad pa brtan po'i ngang / /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres pa'i nyams len la/ /nyin mtshan 'khor mo yug tu 'da' bar mdzod/ /de ltar mdzod dang chos sgor zhugs pa'i don/ /lus rten 'di yi steng nas grub pa yin/ /zhes pa'ang o rgyan rig 'dzin ngor mchog sprul ming 'dzin nas bris//༄༅/ /dbyings ka nas dag pa'i chos sku la/ /grol 'khrul gyi mtshan ma mi dmigs kyang / /de 'on kyang glo bur sgrib pa yis/ /lhad me long g.ya' dris sbags pa bzhin/ /de 'dzin med sangs pa'i gdeng chen la/ /brtan chags kyi btsan sa ma zin bar/ /nyams dga' sdug dang re dogs rtog pa'i spun/ /lang long du g.yo ba'i sprin mched kyang / /der snang la der 'dzin med pa yi/ /'od gsal gyi dgongs pa'i klong chen gyi/ /grol lugs sogs thun mong min pa la/ /dpyis phyin pa'i go myong byung pa na/ /thams cad du nam mkha'i rnal 'byor du/ /la bzla ba'i ltad mo gu yangs che / /gtad med kyi rgyal po'i btsan sa la/ /blo bde'i ngang slebs pa'i rnal 'byor mtshar/ /de 'on kyang thugs rje'i rtsal snang la/ /bzang ngan gyi phyogs chas dben pa yi/ /ro snyoms kyi spyod pas dbugs dbyung na/ /'khor 'das kyi rgya grol mngon byang chu/7/ /

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/don snying po'i bcud dang bral mchi yang / /rtog med kyi rnal 'byor rgyal khams pa'i/ /thugs bzhed ltar ne tso'i brjod dpe bzhin //chos dred mkhan mdzi'i ming des bris//mu / /ye grol spros dang bral ba ka dag gi zhing na/ /yongs grol don gyi rang rig pad 'byung de bzhugs nas/ /nang gsal khyad chos drug ldan tshogs 'khor la rol bzhin/ /'khor ba gzhi la sangs pa'i glu dbyangs shig len no/ /dbyings snang sna tshogs bkod pa longs sku yi zhing na/ /rang gsal zhal phyag rdzogs pa'i pad 'byung de bzhugs nas/ /phyi gsal nges pa lnga ldan tshogs 'khor la rol bzhin/ /rang snang dbyings su shar ba'i glu dbyangs shig len no/ /'gro 'dul bkod pa zangs mdog dpal ri yi zhing na/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag gu ru padma de bzhugs nas / /phyi nang 'dod yon mchod pa'i tshogs 'khor la rol bzhin //gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dul ba'i glu dbyangs shig len no//rig 'dzin dpa' bo dgyes pa'i tshogs gral gyi dbus na/ /snang srid gzhi bzhengs rtogs pa'i rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu/ /snang ba rgyan du shar ba'i tshogs 'khor la rol bzhin/ /nyams 'ur rig pa dwangs pa'i glu dbyangs shig len no/ /dga'o skyid do de ring rig 'dzin gyi tshogs gral/ /bskang ngo mchod do zhen med rang 48

yon tan gyi rtsa ba zhal sadams sogs kyi skor/rig gi lha tshogs/ /dag go tshang ngo ye grol chos dbyings kyi rol pa //spangs thob bral ba'i 'bras bu'i rten 'bral yang yag byung //'dir 'dus rig 'dzin rnal 'byor mched lcam gyi tshom bu/ /gdan gsum lha ru shes pa'i bskyed rim gyi 'khor los/ /'dod yon mi spang zhen bral tshogs mchod la rol bas/ /snang grag lha sngags rtog tshogs chos nyid du shar song / /lus gnas rtsa yi drwa ba'i 'khor lo na bzhugs pa'i/ /nyer bzhi'i zhing gi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi lha tshogs/ /a haṃ 'bar 'dzag bde chen tshogs 'khor la rol bas/ /gzung 'dzin mtshan ma dga' bzhi'i ye shes su dag song / /gzhi gnas rig pa spros bral rang byung gi ye shes //rig gdangs ma 'gags lam snang sgron drug gi 'char sgo/ /gang snang chos nyid rgyan gyi tshogs 'khor la rol bas/ /'khor ba ye dag 'bras bu gzhi rdzogs su thob song / /'dir tshogs rig 'dzin rnal 'byor las ldan gyi tshom bu/ /o rgyan sgro ma thā la mkha' 'gro yi zhing mchog /ma hā gu ru rig 'dzin rgyal po yi drung du/ /mi 'bral phyam gcig 'tshog pa'i rten 'bral yang zhu'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang skyabs rje mchog sprul rin po che khrag 'thung bde ba'i rdo rjes dgung lo bcu pa'i dus su gsungs pa lags so//༄7/ /grub mchog rgya mtsho'i spyi mes bi ma la/ /bsam bzhin ye shes sgyu ma'i skur snang ba/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug dpal stun

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bla ma la/ /gnyis med rig stong klong nas phyag bgyi'o/ /zhes rang rig don gyi gnas lugs ji bzhin gtan la phab pa'i bka' drin tshad med pa'i rang bzhin can bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal ba sngon du btang nas 'dir man ngag rgya mtsho'i srog bcud theg mchog 'od gsal snying po'i lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi'i gnas lugs lung dang rigs pa'i spros pa dor de 'jig rten rgan po'i tshig ltar nag 'gros go bder zhung zad cig brjod na/ lta ba klong chen rab 'byams yin/ /zhes pa ltar chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rang bzhin gyi spros pa dang bral ba smra bsam brjod med blo 'das chos sku'i dbyings chen po'i ngo bo la kun rtog mtshan ma'i spros pas rdul tsam yang gos ma myong mod/ 'on kyang rtsal snang sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis 'gro ba rnams bslus shing 'khor bar 'khyams pa ni med bzhin du snang ba rtog pas btags tsam pa ste/ dper mtshon na nam mkha' dwangs pa'i rang ngo la sprin sogs lhad byed kyi skyon ye nas ma grub kyang rkyen dbang gis sprin ldang ba na nam mkha' sgrib byed kyi skyon nyid du 'jig rten pa'i blo dang brdas bzhag pa bzhin no/ /des na rang gnas kyi ye shes thog ma'i rig pa kun rtog blo yi spros pa thams cad dang bral ba 'di yin dang 'di min gyi gtad so ci yang 50

yon tan gyi rtsa ba zhal gdams sogs kyi skor/med pa'i zang ma thal byung gsal stong ris med kyi ye shes ma btsal lhun grub kyi gnas lugs yid dpyod tshig gi sbun pa dang bral ba rang gdangs gnyug ma'i sems nyid 'od gsal ba 'di ka lta ba'i gnas lugs yin la/ lta ba'i gnas lugs de gtan la dbab na phyi nang gi dngos por 'dzin pa'i mtshan bcas kyi spros pa thams cad de'i klong du nub pa yin te/ bdag tu 'dzin pa sogs nyon mongs pa'i 'byung gnas kun tu rtog pa'i ma rig pa yin la/ de ni kun tu rgyu ba'i rlung gis bslad pa can gyi ya ma brla ste rdzun pa'i rang bzhin yin pas na rang byung gi ye shes rtsol sgrub dang tha snyad las 'das pa'i 'dus ma byas kyi chos sku rig pa'i rang bzhin nyid ye nas skye 'gags sogs spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i bden med nyid du nges pa'i shugs kyis de las 'phrul pa'i rtog tshogs phung khams dang /cadī pa bden stong spros pa bral bar nges nus pa yin pa'i ra de/ lta/ bu'i lta ba'i gnas lugs de nyid legs par khong du chud par byas te bsgom pa na/ sgom pa mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer yin zhes pa bzhin theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems la bcos min gyi blo 'byong na rab/ min yang thun re 51

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bzhin bcos ma'i byang chub kyi sems blo 'khel nus pa re sngon du 'gro bar byas te sngar lta ba'i gnas lugs ji ltar phab pa'i tshul de ltar sems spro bsdu'i byed rtsol dang re dogs sogs gang yang mi byed par da lta'i gshis lugs sam yin lugs kyi shes pa zo ma bcos pa tha mal ba'i rang 'babs 'di bzhin thad kur rang ngo rang shes tsam du lhod de 'bol le 'jog pa las dmigs pa'i gtad so can gyi bsgom bya ci yang med pas de bzhin rang babs bde lugs su bzhag /de'ang theg mchog rgyal po 'di'i lugs la nyams kyi 'dzin zhen thams cad dang bral ba zhig dgos pas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams dang zhen pa thams cad ldog pa'i sems nyid 'od gsal ba'i ye shes rjen la bud pa zhig gtsor 'don pa yin yang dang po'i gnas skabs su bde gsal sogs nyams kyi shun pa dang bral ba mi 'ong yang de dag la 'dzin zhen dam sgreng nge ba dang bcas pa'i mnyam bzhag las med kyang / sngar ltar rtsol med rang babs kyi gnas lugs yid dpyod blo yi mtshan mas ma bslad pa'i spros bral rig pa'i ye shes kyi rang lugs de ji bzhin bskyangs pas ci zhig na nyams snang gi shun pa thams cad na bun nam mkha' la rang yal du 'gro ba ltar rig pa byang chub kyi sems kyi klong du rang 52

yon tan gyi rtsa ba zhal bdams sogs kyi skor/yal rjes med du 'gro ba yin no/ /de bzhin du rnam par rtog pa'i phreng ba sna tshogs su shar ba 'di'ang grol lugs chen po bzhi'i gnad dang ldan pas mnyam bzhag gi dus su rnam par rtog pa thol gyis skyes tsa na rnam rtog re dang gnyen po re thod sprad pa sogs mi dgos mod kyang / 'on te rnam rtog kha yan du btang na de yin dang 'di yin med pa'i rnam rtog lu gu brgyud du 'gro nyen yod pas rnam rtog shar tsa na de ka ngo shes pa tsam du gang shar chos sku'i yo lang du nges par byas nas rang babs kyi gnas lugs brjod pa bral ba chos nyid rig pa'i gshes ma nor ba gnad du che/ de'ang bskyang bya'i rig pa la thun dang thun mtshams kyi dbye ba med kyang sgom pa brtan pa'i phyir du thun du bcad la sgom pa gtsor bton cing spyod lam du yang lam du khyer ba gal che/ de'ang khregs chod kyi tshul la sgom pa brtan pa na thod rgal gyi lam nas snang ba bzhi'i sa lam bgrod dgos pas de la yang nan tan du bya/ mdor na gang snang ba thams cad bla ma'i rnam rol/ gang shar ba thams cad chos sku'i rang bzhin du nges dgos pa yin no/ /de ltar bsgoms pas/ spyod pa rgyal ba'i myu gu yin/ /zhes pa ltar sngar snying rje byang chub kyis 'phangs 'bras sgo gsum gyi spyod pa thams cad rang don gyi 'dzin zhen 53

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/thams cad dang bral ba 'gro ba kun gyi phan bde'i gzhi nyid du smin pa'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che rtsol med du 'byung ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i lta sgom spyod pa ya ma bral bar gnas lugs ji bzhin gtan la phab pa'i 'bras bu 'di ltar dngos po'i spros pa'i mtshan ma ru gang snang ba'i chos can sna tshogs pa'i snang ba 'di dag dper na sgyu ma'i snang ba rang sar zhi ba bzhin chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes nang gsal khyad chos drug ldan gzhon nu bum pa sku'i dbyings su rang yal rjes med du 'gro ba chos nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kho na las 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad zad pas na blo zad chos zad ces bya ste/ snang ba bzhi'i mthar son pa yin no/ /de ltar chos zad pas chos nyid nang gsal bum pa sku'i klong nas phyi gsal nges pa lnga ldan sogs sku dang 'phrin las kyi rnam rol srid pa ji srid par 'byung ba ni 'bras bu'i tshul mdor bsdus pa yin no/ /smras pa/ rang nyams las brgal gtam brjod mu tig chun/ /'phags nor yon tan du mas gtams pa'i mdzod/ /mdo sngags bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan bzhed skong du/ /ne tso'i 'don des ji baspyan shar mar bris/ /zhes pa'ang rig pa 'dzin pa gang shar zhen med sna

yon tan gyi rtsa ba zhal gdams sogs kyi skor/tshogs rang grol gyis spel ba dge'o/ / ༄sto /chos thams cad ye nas 'od gsal spros bral ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin yin pa la de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyis gnyis 'dzin 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor la bdag tu zhen pas 'khor bar 'du byed pa'i kun rtog sprin gyi sgrib byed ling ma ling du mched pas rtsol bral gzhug ma'i chos sku stong chen 'od gsal gyi rang zhal mog mog por byas te mngon du gyur ba'i bskal ba sgrib pas de'i mtshang rtogs ldan bla ma'i man ngag las rtogs par byas nas 'di ltar rgyu 'bras rtsol sgrub thams cad dang bral ba'i rang sems zo ma bcos pa'i tha mal ba'i shes pa snang ba yul la ma reg /'dzin pa sems su ma zhugs pa'i skabs 'di zhes tshig gis mtshon brjod las 'das pa nang rnal 'byor ba rang gis mar me rang 'od rang gsal ltar nyams su myong rgyu sgrib med zang thal le tsam yod pa de la ye gnas chos sku'i rang bzhin rtsol bral gzhug ma'i rang zhal tsam gyi brda sbyar na chog gam snyam / de las gzhan dga' sdug sogs rnam rtog gi phreng ba 'khor ba'i kun rtog yin phyir dgag bya dang spang bya nyid du nges pa'i rang lugs kyi grol lugs chen po'i gnad kyis ma zin tshe rnam rtog kha yan du btang na lam gyi gol sa chen po yin pas 55

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/33 bri sdur bya'o/ /zhes chos rjes bskul ngor thub bstan 'jigs med chos kyi zla ༄ga /skyabs rje dam pa'i zhal gsung zin bris su bkod pa bzhugs so/ /spro/ /de la 'dir las dang po ba'i dbang du byas na thog mar thun mong blo ldog rnam bzhis rang rgyud legs par ldog bya ldog byed ldog tshul ldog tshad la brten nas sbyangs shing / le lo dang btang snyoms kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar myur du blo sna thung ha re ba'i sgo nas lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bskul bsam pa'i blo thag rbad bcad dgos/ 'o ya/ des na thun min 'od gsal bsgom pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum/ sngon 'gro la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis/ ji skad du/ phyi ba nang pa skyabs 'gro'i khyad/ /theg pa che chung sems bskyed khyad/ /ces gsungs pas skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum gyi skyabs su 'gro tshul dang sems bskyed yod kyang da skabs 'dir skyes bu chen po'i lugs kyi skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa 'di nyid yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten dper na khang pa'i mang rdo lta bu dang 'khor lo khri ldan gyi srog shing lta bu yin pas de gnyis shin 56

yon tan gyi rtsa ba zhal gdams sogs kyi skor/tu nas kyang gal che gsungs/ de nas dngos gzhi la ni/ gsar rnying gi rgyud sde kun gyis gsungs lugs mang rim yod kyang /man ngag bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten pa dgos pas 'dir rgyal ba dpal yul ba'i rang lugs dri bral gyi sngon 'gro sangs rgyas lag 'chang gi dgongs don ltar na bla ma kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su bsgom dgos gsungs pas rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gu ru rin po che dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor rang gi spyi gtsug tu pad zla nyi ma'i gdan sum brtsegs kyi steng du bsgoms nas dbang bzhi legs po zhig blangs mthar bla ma de nyid 'od du zhu nas snying dbus su thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med gcig tu 'dres par mos/'o de nas rang gi gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i klong na ye nas rang babs sems nyid rig pa'i ngo bo de zang thal stong gsal brjod bral ba yin pas de'i phyir stong pa'i cha la dbyibs dang kha dog gang yang med pa stong sang nge ba spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ gsal la rang bzhin med pa/ snang la der 'dzin med pa/ wal ler ye rer gnas pa'o/ /de yang de'i ngo bo stong pa'i cha de ni chos sku'i bdag nyid dang / de'i rang bzhin 57

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gsal ba'i cha de ni longs sku'i bdag nyid dang / de'i rtsal lam thugs rje kun khyab de ni sprul sku'i bdag nyid do/ /sku gsum rang la rang chas su bzhugs pa'o/ /'o de phyir sems nyid rig pa'i ngo bo ma bcos rang babs su bzhag na dper na chu ma rnyog na dwangs / sems ma bcos na gsal/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gnyug ma'i dran pas nam yang rang shar rang grol gyi gnad la brten na gang shar thams cad grogs su gyur pas dug lnga ye shes lnga dang —/ sku lnga lhun grub tu gnas pa'o/ /de yang gti mug rnam par dag pa me long ye shes/ sku rnam par snang mdzad 'grub pa dang /de bzhin du zhe sdang gi ngo bo chos dbyings ye shes/ thugs rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub pa dang / nga rgyal mnyam nyid ye shes/ yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan 'grub pa dang / 'dod chags sor rtogs ye shes/ gsung snang ba mtha' yas 'grub pa dang / phrag dog rang sar dag pa bya grub ye shes/ 'phrin las kyi lha don yod grub pa mthar thug 'grub pa'i rten 'brel lo/ /'o ya des na nyon mongs pa phra ba'i rnam pa gang shar thams cad zhi ba'i lha 'grub pa'i rten 'brel/ rags pa'i rnam pa gang shar thams cad mthar thug na khro bo'i lha 'grub pa'i rten 'brel lo/ /ha ha/ de yin na bsal bzhag dang spro bsdu dgag sgrub spang blang gang yang mi byed 58

yon tan gyi rtsa ba zhal gdams sogs kyi skor/par rang gnas kyi ye shes rang bzhag gi chos sku zer ba yin pas rang thog tu ngo sprad/ yin thog tu thag bcad/ grol thog tu gdeng bca' dgos gsungs pa de bzhin du rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad gsum la brten nas ting nge 'dzin chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la gnas par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang yun thung grangs mang khang rgan thigs pa'i dper gsungs pas rang rgyud gnad du ma smin gyi bar du thun yun thung grangs mang la bslab par bya'o/ /gang ltar yang thun bsdu khar dge sdug gtong len gyi dmigs pa re gal che gsungs/ mjug bsngo ba ni/ de ma thag mnyam bzhag gi ngad shugs ma yal gong nas bsngo smon gal che/bsngo ba ni rgyu la dam bca' ba'o/ /smon lam ni 'bras bu la dam bca' ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas bsngo ba smon lam gyi mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /sprul rin po che 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i zhal gsung de nyid bha dra'i ming 'dzin(a sug sprul smu rig 'dzin bzang po yin)rang gis rang la dran gso'i phyir che zin chung zin du bris pa dge'o//༄7/ /mnyam med o rgyan chen po khyed mkhyen no/ /las ngan mtsho chen rdol ba bdag la gzigs/ /dal 'byor gru chen lan gcig brnyed na yang / /'khor ba'i mtsho rlabs brgal dka' mi brgal(bsgral)bar / /mi rtag tshe 'di'i snang bas bslus bslus nas / /dal rten stong log byas pa cang gzigs sam/ /mastun
