dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/khyod gdong dmar bod kyi sems can la/ /thugs rjes gzigs pa nam yang mi brtul zhing / /nangs re dgong re 'byon pa'i tha tshig des/ /las ngan bdag 'dra nam yang gtong ngam ci/ /da ni brtse chen dgongs pa mchis srid na/ /sngon gyi zhal bzhes dus las mi g.yel bar/ /gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa bdag sogs la/ /thugs rgyud dgongs pas byin gyis brlab par mdzod / /rnyed dka' 'jig sla mi rtag dal rten la/ /snying po len la long yod lcags khrol te/ /long med myur du 'chi ba'i tshul mthong nas/ /dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten pa dang / /chos kyi rtsa ba las 'bras yid ches shing //thar ba'i them skas 'khor bar yid dbyung ba'i//thun mong lam gyi rmang rdo tshugs par shog /nges 'byung shugs drag rlung gis rab bskyod de/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i ma gyur 'gro ba la/ /brtse chen snying rje'i zer rno 'phro ba can/ /smon 'jug byang sems nyi ma rtag 'char shog /bla med myur lam rdo rje theg pa yi / /khang bzang bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam mthong nas/ /nam yang g.yo med rim gnyis zab mo'i srog /tshugs te dbang bzhi'i ye shes mngon gyur shog /so sor thar dang rig 'dzin nang gi sdom / /'gal med gcig pu'i dgongs pa mnyam nyid klong / /60

yon tan gyi rtsa ba zhal gdam sa songs kyi skor/bstan 'gro'i thad kur don du gang 'gyur ltar/ /bsnyengs bral dpal chen brtul zhugs grub par shog /'chi tshe mgon khyod snying nas dran pa'i med/ /'chi ba chos skur grol ba'i gdeng thob bam//sku yi snang ba dbyer med longs skur grol/ /tha ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma bcas/ /rnga yab dpal ri chos kyi pho brang du/ /gtso mchog khyod kyi drung du 'khod par shog /mdor na skyid dam sdug gam dbul yang rung / /na 'chi'i tshor ba snying la zug na yang / /mgon po khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ /thugs rjes gtong ba ye nas cang phod dam/ /de bzhin sdom gsum yon tan rgyan 'chang ngam/ /dug lnga hrag spyod mi dge'i 'dam bying yang / /nam yang khyod kyi 'bangs las mi 'da' phyir/ /rnam pa kun tu mkhyen mdzod padma 'byung / /re ltos khyod las gzhan med padma 'byung —/ /btang snyoms yal yol ma mdzad padma 'byung / /mkhyen no mkhyen no rje btsun o rgyan mkhyen/ /bdag sogs snying nas gsol ba 'debs lags na/ /sku yi snang ba mig gi lam du ston/ /gsung gi chos sgra rna ba'i dpyid du phobs/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa yid mkhar rtag 'bar ba'i/ /dge mtshan byin nus stsol cig padma 'byung / /snang srid bden med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs//chos nyid ye stong rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rig gdangs bla 61

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/mar 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rig rtsal ye shes rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /mtha' bral blo 'das 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings / /don gyi dgongs rgyud bdag la 'phos nas kyang / /'bar khro 'jigs sogs sku yi yon tan gar/ /rgod gshe rngam pa gsung dang thugs kyi gsang / /snying rje zhi sogs yon tan 'bad med gter/ /'phrin las gang 'dul thabs kyi gsang ba che/ /dus 'di nyid du bdag la mngon grub ste/ /mgon po khyod kyi 'phrin las grogs byed shog /tshe rabs kun tu rgyal dbang mtsho skyes zhabs/ /mi 'bral gtsug dang snying gi dbyig mnos te/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las mkha' mthar brdal ba yis/ /'gro mgon pad 'byung ci 'dra de 'drar shog /(sirnyi bzla/)'di kha tsam ma yin pa'i dad mos gdung shugs drag pos bskul ba ltar rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje khrag 'byung bdud 'dul rtsal lam 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes gsol ba btab pa tshig gi lam nas 'phos pa de bzhin du 'grub par rgyal dbang slo rgyan chen po nyid rang mkhyen no/ /zhes pa sa yos zla ba bdun pa'i(7)tshes bcu gcig(11)nyin thun nang shar mar bris pa dge legs 'phel/༄7/ /na mo ratna tra ya ya/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge 'dun thugs mthun zhing —/ /bslab gsum nor bu'i bang mdzod rab 'gengs pa'i/ /mastu skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /bshad dang sgrub

yon tan gyi rtsa ba zhal gdams sogs kyi skor/pa'i snying stobs go bgos shing / /rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la/ /goms pa'i thabs mchog cog bzhag bzhi brtson pa/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /phra zhing gnyug ma'i ye shes mngon gyur nas/ /man shel rma bya'i mdangs la brten nas su/ /snang bzhi mthar phyin gdod ma'i sar brnyes pa/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /de ltar phan bde'i rtsa ba rgyal ba'i bstan/ /rab tu brtan cing phyogs bcur rgyas pa yi/ /smon tshig legs par gang dang gang smon pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang / /thugs rje che mnga' bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /chos skyong bstan srung rgya mtsho'i nus mthu yis/ /gegs med myur du 'grub nas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /yar ngo'i zla ba ltar du 'phel gyur cig /tabya thā/ pañtsa pri ya a wā bho dha na ye swā hā / zhes rang dgon dar thang mdo sngags bshad sgrub gling gi dbu mdzad slo rgyan sdo/shā 'dzin nas yang yang bskul ngor 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes bris pa'o/ /

dpal yul mchog skul gyi gsung 'gram/༄7/ /'jam dbyangs 'don thabs bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /chos dbyings ngang las pad zlar dhī yig las/ /rang nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nu gur gum mdog /phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas glegs bam bsnams/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan spras skyil krung bzhugs/ /thugs ku'i 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs thim/ /sa bon sngags phreng 'od kyis rmongs mun bsal/ /rnam 'byed shes rab snang ba rgyas par gyur/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥdage ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jam dpal gzhon nu 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces pa 'di ni bsod nams kyi mthu dpal btsan po'i shugs kyis rgya chen rnam par gnon pa'i rgyal khrims chos bzhin du skyong ba'i mi rje dam pa'i dbang // kāchog rtse rgyal sras tshe dbang phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor dbyangs can bzhad ༄ga /'jam dpal ye zhes sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rgyun khyer snying por dril ba de nyid mchog stsol ces bya ba bhi dza hā ra/༄gi /gang zhig thun mong sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs shing / thun min byang chub 66

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/sems kyi rtsa ba brtan//myur bde'i theg mchog smin grol rim gnyis lam//'jug pa'i skal bzang thob pa'i blo ldan des/ /rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter gcig 'jam pa'i dpal/ /gang gi gsang gsum rdo rje rab bsnyen pa'i/ /rgyun gyi rnal 'byor 'di bzhin nyams blang na/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med 'jo bar 'gyur/ /aḥdamigs med mtha' bral gsal stong gzhug ma'i dbyings/ /brjod med brjod bral chos nyid snying rje'i rtsal/ /dbyer med rgyu yi ngo bo yi ge dhī/ /yongs gyur rig pa chu las nya 'phar ltar/ /rab rgyas padma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng / /rang nyid rje btsun mkhyen gter 'jam pa'i dpal/ /gser mdog mtshan dpe'i lang tshos kun nas mdzes / /phyag gnyis g.yas pas ral gri mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa'i utpal 'dab stong bzhad pa'i dbus/ /zab mo'i bden don ston pa'i glegs bam bsnams/ /mthon mthing dbu skra zur phud lnga dang ldan/ /dar dang rin chen longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras/ /mdzes pa'i zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i dkyil krung bzhugs/ /sna tshogs 'od zer mu mtha' med par 'phro/ /sku yi ba spu rtsa gnas grangs med par/ /rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /'khor 'das spyi dpal mkha' khyab rdo rje'i sku/ /snang stong zung 'jug chu zla lta bur gsal/ /gnas gsum rgyal kun rdo rje gsum gyi dngos/ /yi ge gsum dang thugs srog 'od du 'bar/ /phyogs dus sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab ni/ /bcom ldan 'jam 67

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/pa'i rdo rje ye nas rdzogs/ /rig stong gnyug ma'i gshis las phyag rgya'i sku/ /'phrul mtshan sna tshogs g.yo bzhin brtan par bzhugs / /rang babs rang ngo so ma'i phyag gis 'dud/ /rig rtsal sna tshogs 'gag med rol mo'i sprin/ /kun bzang mkha' khyab chos nyid rgyan gyis mchod/ /'khor 'das kun gzhi ye nas brjod bral klong / /dran rig zag med yongs grol chen por bstod / /thugs kur zla steng snyiḥyig gser mdog mthar/ /rdo rje'i 'bru drug 'greng stabs g.yas bskor 'khor/ /brjod med sngags kyi sgra gdangs zer 'bar bas/ /snod bcud 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhing du gyur/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥzhes pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bar med bzla/ /skabs su rlung dug phyung zhing 'jam par bzung / /snang srid chos kun gdod nas ma skyes kyang //kun rdzob snang cha'i ri mo yongs shar bas//sna tshogs chos su snang ba'i dngos po kun/ /kun btags sgyu ma'i ngang tshul ci bzhin du/ /snang tsam nyid nas gshes su ma zhugs pa'i/ /snang stong gnyis tshogs gnyis med bde ba che/ /ye grol chos dbyings nam mkha'i rgyan nyid du/ /yongs grol sems kyi rdo rjer khyer shes na/ /'khor ba ye dag tshogs gnyis ye rdzogs klong / /'gro khams rang gnas ye shes mchog gi sar/ /smin pa'i dga' ston dus su bstar nas kyang / /rig stong 'jam pa'i rdo rjer rab grub 'gyur/ /rjes spyod rang babs dran pa nyer bzung ste/ /a 'thas tha mal snang zhen ma 'chor bar/ /snang grags lha yi 'khor lor khyer ba yis/ /chos nyid mnyam rdzogs chen po'i ngang du spyod/ /ho dge ba 'di yis bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro'i/ /sgrib gnyis ma rig mun pa drung phyung nas/ /shes 68

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabang sogs kyi skor/bya'i gnas lugs ji bzhin mngon gyur pa'i/ /mkhyen rab ye shes snang ba rgyas gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang sdom brtson rnal 'byor dbang phyug spong pa'i dge slong dgon pa ba bla ma padma blo gros nas lha rdzas bcas 'di 'dra zhig bris zhes bskul ngo ma ldog tsam du chos smra ba'i gzugs brnyan rmongs 'chal snyoms las pa thub bstan 'jigs med chos kyi zla ba bshad sgrub 'phrin las rab brtan dpal bzang po'am 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes sha phyung rus phyung gis bris pa dge/tshul 'di tshig sdebs rgyan gyi rang bzhin las//don bzang byin rlabs ro nus bcud bral phyir/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po yon tan bzang po sogs/ /rdo rje'i gsung rnams gcig tu bsten pa gces//zhes ngang tshul ji bzhin yang smras so//kho /phur ba'i rgyun khyer spros med don gyi snying po bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /na mo ku mā ra ye/ a srid pa'i rtsa ba ma rig pa/ /ye shes rig dbyings rab bsgral nas/ /ye gdangs rig pa'i cho rol las/ /dug gsum rtsad gcod phur pa che/ /zhal ras nyag gcig chos kyi dbyings/ /sku gsum 'bar ba'i spyan gsum pa/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal mche bzhi gtsigs/ /chos dbyings rol rtsal cir yang 'char/ /khro gnyer bsdus shing rang snang nyid/ /gnas dag rgyan gyi rnam rol shar/ /zag med gnyug ma'i ye shes dbyings / /rlung lnga'i sbyor bas phul byas nas/ /dag pa lha yi rnam 69

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/pa ru/ /sku che yan lag rags la rngam/ /ma dag gnas dag bgegs kyang med/ /phur 'dril phur bu'i rno dbal can/ /ye nas rang gsal 'od 'bar ba/ /rgyu rkyen gsar bas ma bskyed pa'i / /gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings lhun gyis grub/ /dam tshig lha yi sa ma ti/ /o badzra tī li tī la ya sarba nyig nan baṃ skru phaṭaḥ zhes pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bzla/ rang rig ma bcos so ma'i klong / /rig pa gnad bsnun dgongs pa sbar/ /a phaṭaḥ zhes pa'ang dpal sprul dbang chen gzil gnon bzhad pa rtsal nas bris/dge'o//༄gi /(ratna gling pa'i phur ba yang gsang bla med kyi brgyud 'debs kha skong / )rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gter phyogs mthar rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /'dren mchog ngag dbang grags pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskyed rdzogs brtan pa thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngag dbang nor bu grags pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs / /mtshungs med nor bu yongs grags la gsol ba 'debs / /gnas lugs rang sa zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /grub dbang dbang chen lhun grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos nyid don dang 'phrad par byin gyis rlobs/ /yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas phun tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun dngos grub thob bsdu byin gyis rlobs/ /sngags 'chang padma dbang drag la gsol

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/ba 'debs/ /snang srid zil gyis gnon par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhas grub rā ga a gye la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs med gdul bya smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrub brgyud mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ /smin grol brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas lugs rang zhal mjal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam phur ba'i lha sogs zhes pa'i gsol 'debs chos dbyings ma 'di nyid mang nyung ran pa khyer bde ba lags la 'di mdzad pa po rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa yin pa mdzad byang ltar la byin rlabs kyi khungs dang ldan nges pas gzhan mdzad pa po su yin gyi gsal kha tsam med cing rang gi brgyud pa dang ma 'bral ba'i nyab stob mang po 'don pa la don med pas 'di nyid kho na 'don rgyu byas na legs sam snyam pa mchog ming pas so//sto /rdo rje phur ba'i gtor chog khyer bde dngos grub sprin bcad 'dzin pa'i lang tsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄ga/na mo badzra ku mā ra ye/chos dbyings brjod bral skye med nam mkha'i shā/ //

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/'gag med thugs rje'i snang ba 'bum gyi gzis/ /gang 'dul khro tshul rngam pa'i skur bzhengs pa/ /dpal chen rdo rje khros pa'i rgyal la 'dud/ /de la gtor mchod kyi yo byad mdzes gtsang gya rnam pa mngon par 'du byas te bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro ba rgyas bsdus spros pa dang 'tsham pas mchod tshogs rgya cher spel ba ni/ oṃ su bha wa sogs dang raṃ yaṃ khaṃ lan gsum/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung dkyil gzhu yi dbyibs / /me dkyil dmar nag gru gsum rab 'bar klong / /ke las mi mgo'i snyed pu gsum gyi steng / /a yig las byung ye shes kā pa lar/ /rtsu swā oṃ hā dang sum̐ lam̐ rmi/ /lha lta yig 'bru bcu las sha lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i gtor mchod rdzas/ /dbang po drug gi spyod yul mnyes byed cing / /zag med bde chen skyed pa'i sprin chen po/ /kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs/ /zag med kun tu bzang po'i ting 'dzin 'phrul/ /'bru gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pas byin gyis brlab/ /'bru gsum dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ rol tshogs mdzes brjid rngam par 'khrol nas / ju trī/ chos nyid kun bzang 'dus ma byas pa'i mkhar/ /chos can spros pa'i mtshan ma nyer zhi yang / /thugs rje'i rtsal las 'gag med yongs grub lha/ /dpal chen mnyam rdzogs rdo rje gzhon nu che/ /yab yum sras bzhi khro bcu khra thabs dang / /'bar ba'i sras mchog khro rgyal tī la ya/ /phur srung bcu gnyis dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang / /dbang mo nyer brgyad sgo skyong mched 72

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/bzhi sogs/ /(dpe kha cig tu dang zhes pa'ang snang)srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /gtso dang 'khor du bcas pa'i dam tshig can / /mdun mkhar sprin phung gtibs bzhin skad cig gis/ /dbyings nas skur bzhengs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ rtsu trī/ dur khrod gzhal yas pad nyi bam ro'i gdan/ /rab 'phrul lha mi'i 'byor pas gtibs pa'i dbus/ /mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /'khor 'das mnyam rdzogs rtogs pa'i phyag gis 'dud/ /dngos bshams yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin //nyer spyod bdun dang bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad/ /'dod yon lnga dang brjid ldan bā ling ta//bdud rtsi sman dang nyams pa bsgral ba'i khrag /sha chen bsur dang zhun chen gsal ba'i me/ /rkang gling thod rnga sha rus bza' bca'i tshogs/ /rdo rje srin po'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bla med sgrub mchog bstsal du gsol//badzra a pa bye 4PROB dhu pe a lo ke garnye n+ya wī de shabha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta bā lirto ma hā rakta sarba pu dza ho/ /snang srid bcud ldan 'dod yon bā ling ta/ /'o phud sman dang rakta dmar gyi skyems/ /zag bral thabs shes 'khor 'das gnyis med rdzas //bde stong ye shes skyed pa'i sprin chen por/ /'bul lo rdo rje 73

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gzhon nu yab yum dang / /sras bzhi khro bcu yab yum khra thabs tshogs / /'bar ba'i sras mchog badzra tī la ya/ /phur srung bcu gnyis dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang / /dbang phyug sgo skyong gter srung dam can la/ /'bul lo bzhes shig thugs dam gnyan po bskang / /thog med dus nas sgo gsum bag med pas/ /'gal 'khrul nyes pa ci mchis snying nas bshags/ /rtsa gsum phur ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /mchod cing 'dod don 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs brtan cing / /bshad sgrub chos kyi snang bas sa gsum 'gengs/ /bstan pa'i snying po rim gnyis zab mo'i lam/ /mi nub srid pa'i bla na rtag 'bar mdzod/ /lam mchog zab mo bsgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ /nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad nyer zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen tshe chos dpal 'byor snyan grags dang / /nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas/ khams gsum srid gsum skye 'gro zas dang nor/ /rlung sems snang ba dbang du 'dus nas kyang / /bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i dpal la ldang ba yi/ /dgra gdon gnod byed 'byung po thal bar rlogs/ /snang srid ro mnyam rdo rje phur ba'i lha/ /ye rdzogs rang gsal chen po'i bskyed rim dang / /thams cad yongs grol byang chub sems kyi dbyings/ /blo 'das 74

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/chos sku'i gnas lugs rdzogs pa'i rim/ /ji bzhin rtogs goms gdeng du gyur nas kyang / /ma rig ru tra skye med dbyings su sgrol//srog rtsol nyi zla'i rgyu ba dbu mar sdoms(bsdams)/ /grangs med shul lam mig 'phrul lta bur bgrod/ /dpal chen thugs kyi rdo rje tī la ya'i/ /zab gsal phra ba'i ye shes dbyings kyi mkhar/ /glo bur sgrib bral don gyi ye shes mchog /ro gcig kun bzang thig ler 'ub chub pa'i/ /bkra shis dge mtshan stong gi gzi 'bar ba'i / /'phrin las ma g.yel sgrubs shig sa ma ya nas pa'ang rang byung gi bzhed skong du dpal sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'am che mchog 'dus ༵ —rtsal gyis bris pa phyogs thams cad du dge zhing bkra shes par gyur cig /sarba maṅga ༄7/ /skru dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang / /sras bzhi khro bcu khra thabs za gsod bcas/ /dbang phyug ging lang 'bar ma brtan ma'i tshogs/ /phur srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kun/ /'dir gshegs gdan bzhugs zag med ting 'dzin 'phrul/ /'dod yon mchod sprin bde stong rgyan du bzhes / /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las gang brtsam thogs med sgrubs/ /khyad par byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen sol/ /lung rtogs sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston rtag rol cing / /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa'ang phur gsol grangs gsog pa la nye bar 75

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/mkho phyir bskul ba ltar dpal sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes shar mar bris pa dge zhing bkra shis/༄7/ /hūṃ gzhi dbyings 'gyur med chos sku'i klong yangs nas / /rtsal snang ma 'gag rdo rje phur ba'i lha/ /dbyings rig dbyer med gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /'khrul snang nad gdon dgra bgegs dbyings su bzlog /ces pa 'di chos kyi zla bas bris pa'o//༄sto /zlog byang nyung bsdus byad ma'i snying 'byin bzhugs/༄7/ /hūṃ o rgyan rang byung gsang chen dur khrod nas/ /mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo skur bzhengs gshegs/ /gtum drag 'bar dang gad rgyangs sgrog pa'i gnas/ /pad 'khyil tī la ya yi dur khrod nas/ /rigs bzhi'i bdud 'dul drag mo skur bzhengs gshegs/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi'i dur khrod chen po nas / /phra men gdong can rnam brgyad skur bzhengs gshegs/ /bka' nyan las byed bstan pa srung byed pa'i/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs bcas gshegs/ /khyad par dpal chen sku gsung thugs sprul che/ /bdud 'dul drag mo'i las byed yang zlo/6 mkhan/ /bya khyung rgyal po 'khor bcas skur bzhengs

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/gshegs / /byad ma dam nyams bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ /bdud 'dul drag mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /mi mthun rkyen ngan mi rung sna dgu bzlog /ban bon sngags pa'i byad zor dgra la bzlog /mu stegs bon po'i rbod gtong dgra la bzlog /rdo rje'i nang 'khrugs nang dme dgra la bzlog /dug lnga dug gsum g.yo 'khrugs dgra la bzlog /lha srin sde brgyad dal kha 'bebs pa bzlog /dam sri 'gong po'i za kha zug pa bzlog /nad sna rims sna gdon sna zug pa bzlog /'byung bzhi'i g.yo 'khrugs dus min 'chi ba bzlog /gtad mnan phung sel phur kha thor kha bzlog /mtha' bzhi'i dmag sna mtshon sna rdol ba bzlog /bzlog go bdud 'dul drag mo 'khor bcas kyi/ /byin rlabs mthu stobs rdo rje'i mthu yis bzlog/phyir bzlog sngags kyi gnod byed rang la bzlog/byad ma lhar bcas ming gi lhag mar mdzod/ /aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsa:sha:taḥraḥsaḥmaḥr:yaḥphaṭaḥ kro ti ha ri ni saḥsarba ḍa'i sa ma ya ru tra dgra bo ma ra ya rbad rbad/ bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo/ bhyo bhyo bhyo spyo bhyo rgyo rgyo/ bhyo bhyo bhyo rgyo rgyo bhyo rgyo/ rgyo bhyo bhyo rgyo rgyo bhyo bhyo/ sa ma ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog/ma mo e ka tsa ti sa ma ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog/btsan badzra du tri sa ma ya rgyo bhyo bzlog bzlog /bdud sra ma ni sa ma ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog /gshin rje ya ma ra tsa sa ma ya bhyo bhyo 77

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bzlog bzlog /gnod sbyin yorsha e 12 yo rdzo lho rtso bhyo bzlohā bzlog /gza' bhi snu ra dza sa ma ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog /rgyal po kiṅka ra tsa sa ma ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog /klu nā ga ra tsa ling sa ma ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog /srin po dha sha ru lu sa ma ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog /mu stegs tri du sa ma ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog /snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod gtong thams cad byad ma che ge mo'i thog tu bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog /byad kha phur kha dbal kha bzlog bzlog /gtad mnan phung sel bzlog bzlog /che ge mo'i steng du e sa bhyo rgyo bzlog bzlog /e dza bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog de ltar grangs gsog na thun re bzhin gtor chung la 'gugs gzhug dang byin rlabs byas mthar/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /khro mo bdud 'dul drag mo 'khor bcas kyi/ /mthu stobs bden pa bslu med rten 'byung mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob mi mthun 'jigs las skyobs/ /tshe dpal nus stobs nyams rtogs 'phel rgyas shing / /khams gsum srid gsum rlung sems rang snang 'dus/ /dgra gdon dam sri mtha' 'dre kla klo'i dpung / /mthu stobs rdo rje'i mtshon gyis rab bsgral nas/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /'di yang dgos gal la brten nas yongs kyi thugs bzhed ltar brjid pa'i rgyal po rdo rje thig le nyi shar rtsal lam rdo rje che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi/ /ra mar bris so//

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/༄7/ /hūṃ o rgyan rang byung gsang chen dur khrod nas/ /mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo skur bzhengs gshegs/ /gtum drag gad rgyangs sgrog sogs dur khrod nas/ /rigs bzhi'i bdud 'dul drag mo skur bzhengs gshegs/ /phra men rnam brgyad dbang phyug gter srung dang / /stobs chen yang zlog khyung chen tshogs bcas gshegs/ /byad ma dam nyams bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ /dzā gad skyems dang dmar gyi gtor ma bcas/ /'bul lo dgyes rol thugs dam gnyan po bskang / /gang bcol 'phrin las thogs med myur 'grub mdzod/ /ces dpal sprul chos kyi zla bas so//༄ga /ratna'i thugs sgrub tshogs bsdus bzhugs/༄ga/tshogs rdzas ci 'byor bshams/oṃ swa was sbyang / a sarba dra byam shwa dha ne hūṃ phaṭaḥces dang / raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ o aḥ rtsu ha ho hrīḥ rje btsun padma thod phreng rtsal: dbang chen yab yum gtso dang 'khor:mkha' 'gro dpa' bo ging dang bcas: sku la sgrib bsil mi mnga' yang: 'gro rnams bsod nams bsag pa'i phyir: ye shes tshogs la gshegs su gsol: dza rdu baṃ ho: sa ma ya ::thun mong rdzas kyi bskang ba ni/ ཿ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du:79

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bshams nas kyang: sgrub rdzas gnyan po gzhung bzhin bkram lags na: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang gyur cig: yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dam can srung ma'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig:bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thugs dam bskang gyur nas: rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig:ma ru lu ru lu hūṃ bhyo rgyu:thun mong lta ba'i bskang ba ni/ kun gzhi ma bcos klong yangs nas: rang rig rang gsal kun tu bzang : gdod nas ma skyes kun bzang mo: dbyer med bde ba chen po la: bskang dang bshags bya bshags pa'i yul: rnam dag spros bral chos kyis sku: chos kyis sku la gnyis su med: gnyis med rtogs pa'i thugs dam bskang: thun mong stong pa'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ dam rdzas rgyan gyi mchod pa 'di dag kun: gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du 'bul lags na: blang dor med pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang: thim pa'i tshul gyi dgyes pa chen por rol: rim gsum dang po mchod pa ni/ hūṃ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid che:bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la:zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: hā ṇa tsakra pu dza kha nyi: bar bshags ni/ hūṃ sngon 80

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/byung dus nas da lta'i bar: ma rig bdag lus ngag sems kyi:rtsa ba yan lag chags nyams sogs: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: badzra sa ma ya shudha ā: gsum pa bsgral stabs ni/dri tri badzra e ku sha dza: dza rghaṃ baṃ ho: sa che mchog padma thod 'phreng rtsal: g.yas pa'i rdo rje phur ba 'dril: g.yon pa lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin: dgra bgegs sgrol pa'i dus la babs: dri tri sha rlu dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa:rdu bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro zhal phyes shig: khams gsum yongs sgrol dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: rngam byed hom khung yangs pa'i mgul du bstim: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid ngang du mchod pa bzhes:dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha kha hi: drang ba ni/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: lhag chog bya ba ni/ a ka ros brlab/ hūṃ dpal gyis bka' nyan tshogs kyi lhag sdud rnams: dbang gi bka' nyan ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ging dang lang ka ma bdun sring bzhi dang : 'bar ma pho nya dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: lhag gtor 'di bzhes dpal gyi bka' lung bzhin: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod: i utstsha ṭa bha ling ta kha hrī: zhes sogs 'di yang bskul pa po 'ga' yi ngor chos kyi zla bas nyung ngur bsdus/bkra shis/81

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/khog/bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi bsdus don sgrub chen gyi lag len gsal bar bkod pa nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄ / /na mo shrī he ru ka ye/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin byang chub sems/ /spro bsdu'i byed po yang dag don gyi lha/ /bgrang yas zhi khro'i gar mkhan kun tu bzang //ma btsal rang ngo 'jal ba'i phyag bgyid do/ /sna tshogs las kyis snang ba'i 'gro ba la / /gang 'dul zhi khro'i bkod pa mtha' yas shing / /kun rtog dbang gis bstan pa rgya mtsho las/ /man ngag thabs kyi 'jug pa zab mo bstan/ /de la 'dir ji skad du/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ mdor na chos rnams thams cad kun/ /'di ru 'dus phyir dngos po bcu/ /zhes dang / rgyud rnams kun gyi gsang ba 'dus / /skal ldan 'khor la yongs rdzogs bstan/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bstan pa thams cad kyi gnad bsdus/ theg pa thams cad kyi spyi 'grel/ man ngag thams cad kyi yang bcud/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i zhe phug tu gyur pa gsang ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyud kyi man ngag lam rim sgrub thabs la brten nas nyams su 82

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/len pa'i thabs la gnyis te/ rgyud las/ rnal 'byor blo mthun sgrub lung btsal ba gnyis/ /'dir ni yongs rdzogs sgrub chen dril ba dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsgrub tshul gnyis dang dgos pa gnyis la dgongs pa ni/ them byang las/ rtsa ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs sgrub chen po/ /spros bcas tshom bu sangs rgyas sgrub thabs yin/ /spros pa nyer bsdus yongs rdzogs dril sgrub ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag don nus pa bskyed sgrub yin/ /gsungs pa ltar spros pa che chung dang rang nus ldan du bskyed pa dpa' bo gcig sgrub dang / 'phrin las sna tshogs byed pa sgrub chen tshogs sgrub kyi lugs gnyis las/ gang ltar sgrub kyang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las rgyud 'di'i dbang skur mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mnos nas dam tshig mig 'bras bzhin du srung pa dang / theg pa spyi'i lam gyi rim pa la nges pa rnyed cing khyad par rgyud 'di'i man ngag them byang las / bskyed dang rdzogs dang rdzogs chen yongs rdzogs las/ /khyad par sde gsum thun mong skor dang bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i chos tshan yongs rdzogs kyi don la sgro 'dogs legs par bcad nas yang sgos su rgyud las/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i 83

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/chos / /ye nas ma bcos chos kyi sku/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /thugs dgongs lta ba mthar thug pa/ /snang srid gzhi bzhengs lta ba ru/ /'khor 'das gnyis med yongs su rdzogs / /gsungs pa ltar lta ba phyin ci ma log pa nges pa zhig gis bsgrub dgos la/ 'dir spros bcas sgrub chen gyi 'grig rim cung zad bshad na/ de yang rgyud las/ rgyud don gsang pa'i sgrub chen la/ /bzhi ste phun sum tshogs gzhi bzung / /sta gon rim pa'i sgrom du gzhug /dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub gzhung bsring ste/ /mtha' rgyas chos kyis rjes bskyang ngo / /zhes pa ltar bzhi las/dang po phun sum tshogs pa lnga'am bdun gyis gzhi bzung nas gnyis pa sngon 'gro sta gon gyi sgom du gzhug pa ni/ rgyud las don tshan bcu gcig gis bstan kyang gsum du 'du la/ sa yi cho ga dang / sta gon gyi cho ga dang / sgrub lung zhu ba dang gsum las/thog mar sa chog ni don tshan gsum gyis bstan pa las dang po sa brtag pa la mtshan nyid spyir brtag pa dang / lto 'phye bye brag tu brtags nas bskos te sa bkra dang chu bkra yang brtag ste ngan na sbyin bsreg bya/ bzang bar shes na sgrub pa'i sna sel gyi rigs sgrub chen gzhan dang mthun par bya/ gnyis pa sa blang zhing bzung ba ni sa der phyin la cha gsum gtor ma dang / gzhi 84

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/dkar gyi steng du sa lha'i dkar gtor rtsi sman gyis bran pa'i mthar nyer spyod lnga dngos bshams kyis bskor ba dang / 'dzom na bum gter dang / rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ nas bzed/ dri bzang gi chu dang ldan pa'i las bum/ dbang chog gi phur pa rnams 'du bar byas la/ las byang nas/ bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka zhes pa nas ma hā kro ti shwa ri st+waṃ bar gyi lhar gsal nas cha gsum gang rigs dang / sgrub 'bum las byung ba'i sngags drug phyag drug dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags gsum gyis gtor ma brlab ste rdo rje dang bcas de lag g.yas pa sa la deb pa'i phyag rgya bcas sa yi lha mo gser mdog sogs nas 'khor sa bdag gis bskor ba byon par bsam la/ hūṃ ji ltar sngon sogs nas ye swā hāḥbar dang / chos rnams thams cad sogs dang / na mo bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs dang / sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba sogs nas byin btsan par mdzod cig bar btang nas sa bzung ba ni/ dbang chog gi phur pa lag tu blang la/ bdag yi dam khro bo'i nga rgyal gyi thugs sogs nas bsam te bar dang / oṃ gha gha sogs sder mo'i sngags gsum gyis phur pa der btab nas nas ces btab pa'i nas bsam mo/ /gsum pa sbyang ba ni/ rang nyid yi dam du sogs nas khang 85

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/dang ldan par bsam par bya/ de nas mi 'gyur lhun po sogs kyi shis brjod bya/ skabs 'dir dal brtsigs nas chag chag gdab/thig gi cho ga rnams 'dir blang nas skya thig yongs rdzogs gdab grub na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs skabs lag len bde la /ras bris la brten na 'di dag mi dgos mod sa chog ni tshang bar dgos so/ /gnyis pa sta gon gyi rim pa ni/ rdzas gsog pa dang so sor sta gon bgyid pa gnyis las/ dang po la rten rdzas dang mchod rdzas gnyis las sgrub rdzas kyi gtso bo rgyud las/ gling dgur bhan dha dgu'am ni/ /bum gcig me gcig khram gcig dang / /rta zhal phur gcig snying gcig dang / /sku gcig sku rten sngags byang 'god / /yang na mtshan ldan gcig nang du/ /che mchog sku bris kha khyer du/ /dpal chen sku yi snying po bri/ /sku dang gsung gi rten yin pas/ /dmigs pa'i rten du dbus su 'god/ /thugs rten rdo rje rtse lnga 'god/ /yon tan rten du a sbo ta/ /'phrin las bsgrub phyir lcags phur dgu/ /zhes dang / go 'byed mar me dgu yang 'god/ /ces gsungs pa ltar che mchog gi rten du thod sku la a mṛ tas gtams pa dang / bum pa dang / dpal brgyad la thod pa brgyad dang / mar me dang / khram shing dang / rta zhal dang / phur 86

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/pa dang / del snying dang / rig 'dzin gyi sku dang / dregs pa kun 'dul gyi sku dang / drag sngags kyi byang bu rnams dang / zhi ba'i rten shel rdo as mtshan pa dang / sku tsaka yongs rdzogs rang sngags can dang / rdor dril dang / phur pa dgu dang / mar me dgu dang / dngos grub kyi rdzas gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba rnams dang / gtso las kyi bum pa dang / rdzas bzhi'i dbang rdzas yongs rdzogs rnams dang / mchod rdzas dang dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad yongs rdzogs dang / mchod cha'i rigs dang / sku chas gar ging gi chas sogs sgrub pa la dgos pa'i mkho rdzas yongs rdzogs ma tshang ba med pa skabs 'dir sta gon bgyis nas 'byung gtor gtong ba spyi 'gros ltar la/ sa chog dang dkyus gcig bgyid na 'di mi dgos mod/ de min las byang las/ bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka sogs kyis rang nyid lhar bskyed nas bka' bsgo ni sgrub 'bum las/ ཿ yang dag don la mi mos pa/ /sogs nas hūṃ bzhi'i khro bcu'i sngags kyis yo byad de dag la bgegs skyod bya/gu gul bdug /de nas las bum a mṛ tas bsang / su bha was sbyangs nas dmigs med ngang las gzhal yas khang sogs nas dmigs te bar dang sngags brgya rtsa brjod de yo byad dag 'khrud dgos pa rnams bkru/ gzhan la yang 'thor bar bya'o/ /las bum 87

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/'di sgrub pa'i skabs su yang chag med dang / gung gnyis la mched lcam rnams la yang khrus bya'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag sogs sta gon du bgyid pa ni/ thog mar bum pa sta gon la dbang bum las byung ba ltar dgos mod 'dir dbang chog ltar bum pa sgrub pa mthar chags su bya'o/ /de nas lha sta gon ni lha rnams la dri'i thig le dang tshom bu lha grangs bkod la mchod pa sman raka sogs kyis bskor nas las byang las byung ba ltar dpal dgu'i sngags gsum re re bzhin brjod nas dam tshig pa dpal dgu'i lha tshogs bskyed de ma he'i las byang gi nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin sogs nas na mo trī bar dang —/ phyag 'tshal yan dang rnam lnga'i mchod pa rtsu rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sogs nas rakta'i mchod pa'i bar kha raṃ kha nyi yan dang / de nas bstod pa ni/ hūṃ mnyam nyid chos sku'i rang bzhin la/ /sogs kyi bstod pa yan bya la/ mchod pa dang tshom bu rnams slob ma sta gon gyi mjug bar mi bskul('di la the tshom/ )bar bya'o/ /de nas bsnyen pa kha gsos la hūṃ sngon spos byung nas skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dkar bgegs spyi 'gros dang / de nas ma he'i gzhung gi las byang ltar zhi bsnyen brgya dang gtso bsnyen stong dang gzhan rnams ci rigs bzlas 88

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/nas bsnyen bstod dang / ma ning bsdus pa/ tshogs bskang bsdus pa lhag chog yan dang / bdag dbang spyi 'gros ltar blang pa'am min yang rung ngo / de nas slob ma sta gon ni sgrub khang gi sgor slob dpon min pa gzhan rnams byon nas slob bu gsar ba rnams la khrus bya/ 'byung gtor gtong pa rgyas bsdus gang 'tsham btang nas 'phyong dpal be'u'i rgya can las/ mtshams lha bskyed pa stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid las kyi che mchog sogs dang /hūṃ yang gsang dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la/ /sogs dang / las byang 'phyong las/ rtsu yang dag don la mi mos pa/ /sogs ma he'i gzhung sring las/ rtsu rgyal ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs sogs tshang bar brjod nas spro na rgyal tshab kyi bden brjod dang / mched lcam rnams kyis ju bzhi dang drag sngags so lnga'i thun dang me chus mtshams bcad/ de nas 'phyong las hūṃ steng 'og phyogs mtshams sogs dang / ma he las/ rghaṃ bdag nyid dpal chen sogs nas rtsu phaṭaḥbar gyi srung 'khor bya/ de nas yar 'tshog nas trī sngon dang yan lag bdun pa/ bla ma bde gshegs 'khor bcas sgrub 'bum dang ldeb shar las byung ba ltar dang / maṇḍal/ chos rnga chen po sogs 'don mthar rdo rje rgyal pos sgrub 'bum las byung ba ltar nges shes bskyed phyir rtsis mgo yan lag lnga dang phun 89

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/sum tshogs pa bdun ngos bzung ste chos rgyas bsdus 'tsham par bshad nas de lta bu'i sgrub pa'i sta gon bgyid pa'i phyir gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod ces brjod nas sgrub 'bum las bla ma slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /sogs zhu lan rnams dkyus ltar bya la/ rdzas gzhi byin rlabs spros dbang byed cing gtad/ tshig gzhung ltar dang / de nas mig dar 'gebs/me tog gtad nas zhu lan gyi rim pa rnams nas dam sgrog sa ma ho bar bya'o/ /gsum pa sgrub lung zhu ba ni/ maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas ho bla ma slob dpon sogs zhu lan gnang nas rdo rje rgyal pos 'phrul 'khor bslab pa rnams go brda 'phrod nges su bshad do/ /de nas shis brjod mdor bsdus bya zhing sta gon gyi lha nam mkha' la 'degs pa ni mched rnams lang nas thal mo sbyar te ho dus gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i gtso/ /sogs nas gnas pa ra mdzod/ /bar dang / maṇḍal gyi sogs nas par bsam bar bya/ cho ga'i mjug dkar gtor dang / chad brtan/ bsdu ldang yan mthar chags su bya'o/ /de nas sta gon zin pas bum pa sogs yo byad rnams bsdu ba dang tshom bu dang mchod pa yang bsdu rung ngo / /de da/0 gis sta gon gyi rim pa bstan zin to/ /

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/gsum pa dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub kyi las 'grig ni/ don so brgyad kyis bstan pa rnams bsdu na gsum ste/ mtshams gcod pa dang —/ rgyan bkod kyi rim pa dang / dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la phyi mtshams gcod pa sgrub chen spyi yi tho ltar bya/ dam sri gnon pa ni gzhung bshad ltar gyi laṅga 'du bar bya la/ dur khrod du phyin te sgrub 'bum las rang nyid che mchog dngos su gsal la ling snod de nyid nas rdor 'gug dang /bden chung / rtsa brgyud/ zangs 'ur/ pho nya sgos skul dang phur thun mtshams skul rnams byas nas sgrub 'bum las/ rdu dam sri bya ba'i sogs nas rgyas gdab mjug ma ra ya phaṭaḥbar bya/ de nas gtor sku yang 'dzugs/ sgo byang 'dogs pa la sku gnyis skyer phur la btags pa dang dmar gtor gnyis bcas bshams nas sku gnyis bsang sbyangs nas sgrub 'bum lhar bskyed sngags kyis spyan drangs shing bstim nas mchod pa rnam lnga sngags 'bul dang / gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud cir gyur pa lha'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gur gyur nas gsol bar bsam la zhes pa nas rang sngags mthar bha ling ta kha hi btags pa gsum gyis phul nas so so'i 'phrin las bcol ba gzhung ltar bya'o/ /ma tram̐ sgrol ba la 'gug pa sogs mi dgos par gzhung ltar bton cing 91

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/mnan pa yang steng nas khro bo'i gar gyis mnan par bsam pa yin gyi gzhan la gnon mi dgos shing bsgral ba gnas so sor bzhag nas gzhung las/ : zhes khog pa sogs nas bsam mo bar bya'o/ /nang mtshams ni/ gzhung las/ bdag dpal gyi thugs ka nas ཿ bcu spros te phur pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las stod khro bo mthing nag phur pa 'dril ba smad lcags sreg gi phur pa dbal dang ldan par bsam la sngags kyis drangs bstim mchod pa brtan bzhugs dag bya'o/ /de nas gzhung ltar la/ phur mtshams byed na sngags so so'i mtshams su dgu 'theng dgu dang dgu rkyang gnyis gnyis kyis byed pa thugs sgrub ltar ro/ /gnyis pa rgyan bkod kyi rim pa ni/ dang po yo byad byin gyis brlab pa la ting nge 'dzin lnga las/ dang po gzhung las/ bdag rdo rje rgyal po'i sogs nas brlab bo bar dang / stong nyid ngang las yi dam lha nas brlabs so bar dang / bdag nyid lha nas bskyed do bar dang —/ mchod rdzas sha lnga nas bsam mo bar dang / rgyu bsgral lo 'tshal gyi sogs nas bskyed par bya'o bar rnams bya/ rgyan bkod dngos la bkod tshul gzhung ltar la/ tshig 'di'i don hūṃ bkra shes mtshan ldan nas dur khrod rdzas bkod 'jug /rdzas su bzhugs bar dang rol mo rnams ldir/ rol bsu sprug bcas 'ur 92

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/sum rdung mthar rtsu chos sku sogs nas hūṃ hūṃ bakṣe bar bya zhing 'ur bzhag /spro na 'dir rnga rabs bya'o/ /de nas bsre bstan('di la the tshom/ )/ rgyan gsol/ skyems drangs/ sman bsdus yan mthar chags bya/ lha sta gon la gdab pa rol mo bcas/ rtsu rang bzhin lhun grub sogs / nas zhi khro gnyis ka a a bar bya/ rol mo bzhag /brda sgo dbye ba/ brda phyag 'tshal ba/ rtags gdab/ dam bca' / bshags pa rnams mthar chags bya la/ byin 'bebs ni/gzhung las/ bdag gi dad pas gdung sems sogs nas bsam te bar bya/ rol chen byas nas hūṃ stong gsum stong gi sogs dang /spro na rig 'dzin byin 'bebs dang / dur khrod byin 'bebs rnams kyang bya la/ rig byid ma 'don na tshig bdun spyan 'dren bya'o / /de nas dgongs 'dus las byung ba'i mchod pa byin rlabs sam yang na spyi 'gros ltar byas nas hūṃ bka' gsang rmad du sogs byas nas gzhal yas don bstod 'dir bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje rgyal pos zhal bkod legs par gdams/ ho skal ldan mched lcam sogs bya/ da bsnyen sgrub dngos gzhi la rdor dril byin brlab dang / trī sngon nas rnying sngon spos byung sogs dang /las byang ma he'i gzhung sring dang / las byang 'phyong dang /'phyong dpal be'u'i rgya can rnams 'thab lugs mchod byang 93

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bkol ba rnams spyi 'gros ltar la bsnyen sgrub kyi gnad don zhi ba bsnyen pa/ khro bo sgrub pa/ las sbyor drag sngags rnams dgos pas bsnyen dus zhi ba'i 'dzab skul dmigs pa dang zhi bsnyen gyis thun bzung nas sgrub pa'i skabs gtso bo'i 'dzab skul dmigs pa dang / gtso bsnyen kho nas thun bzung zhing thun mthar bka' brgyad so so'i 'dzab skul dmigs pa dang bsnyen pa brgya skor re bya'o/ /sgrub chen gzhung bsring tshe las byang gtong lugs byin 'bebs dang las bum rang gzhung ltar 'don dus sogs thugs sgrub ltar blos 'phrul shes dgos la/ gzhan sa bcad phyag bzhes snga ma rnams kyis brgyan par bya dgos so/ /las sbyor la zhi khro'i 'dzab skul dmigs pa rnams btang nas drag sngags so lnga'i thun bzung / las sbyor rgyas pa'i skabs nyin thod chang len pa la gzhung gi rgyun du 'byung ba'i dngos grub blang ngo / sgrub phran la nyul le skyod pa yang gzhan ltar ro/ /bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su stong tshig mchod pa yang gzhung ltar bya'o/ /de ltar las sbyor gyi mtshan thun gsum mo/ /dngos grub chen po len pa ni/ gzhung sring chen gnyis ku'i las byang bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi 'dzab rnams song ba la stong tshig gis mchod nas sgrub 'bum las/ rgyun bshags nar ma oṃ āḥ rgyuḥrgyal ba zhi khro rdo rje 94

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/slob dpon dang / /sogs bshags pa dang yig brgya nyer gcig dang —/ de nas gzhung ltar byin 'bebs rnams 'don te drag sngags so lnga btang nas ka ya sirnyi oṃ la sogs pa brgya stong bzlas te stong tshig gis mchod/ de nas rakta thod snod bcas slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag ste/ stong tshig la brten pa'i dngos grub len pa ni/ gzhung las/ slob dpon bdag yi dam sogs nas tsa kha hi bar dang / bde bar gshegs pa sbyor ba mdzad sogs nas thob par bsam/ zhes pa dang / bde gshegs sras bcas sogs nas dngos grub stsol bar dang / gong gi dngos grub kyi bsnyen pa ci nus bzla/ de nas hūṃ bde gshegs yab yum sogs nas bar gyi dmigs rnam ma lus par bsam zhing bar dang / sna khams gsum sems can sogs nas dgyes par bsam bar dang / bde bar gshegs pa sras bcas yab yum rnams sogs nas thob par gyur cig bar rnams bya'o/ /de nas dngos grub yongs rdzogs blang ba ni/ tt+waṃ bde gshegs yongs rdzogs sogs nas phyogs dgu ma lus kyi dngos grub bskul bar lha dang gnyis su med par mos pa bya'o/ /bar dang / spro na dngos grub byin 'bebs skul ba hūṃ nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje zhes pa nas bdag la bstsal du gsol bar bya/ ma nus kyang chog pa yin no/ /95

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/'og gi dngos grub kyi snod kā pa la khor yug tsam sogs nas dri ma med par bsam zhes pa nas gong gi oṃ āḥ rdzu sarba pañtsa a mṛ sogs sngags bdun bzla/ dngos grub skyel sngags yang bdun bzla / dngos grub rdzas kyi thad sogs nas bsam mo bar dang /dngos grub 'bebs sngags nyer gcig bzla/ yum gyi bha ga sogs nas bsam mo bar dang / sngags brjod de ces rta mgrin sogs bsam mo bar bya/ yang sngags dang dngos grub kyi ngo bo sogs nas bsam mo bar bya la/ de rnams sngags dang phyag rgya sbrags pa gnad du che'o/ /de nas bgegs skyod kyi khro bcu'i sngags dang gha ra'i sngags rnams brjod nas thod chang nas sman mchod bya/ de nas dngos grub kyi rdzas dag ka ya siddhi sogs kyis rol bar bya'o / /de nas rang dngos grub thams cad yongs su 'dus pa nas bsam mo bar bya'o/ /de yi mjug tu gzhung ltar shes pa brjod / ho rnam snang bkra shis sogs nas sirnyi myu bar bya'o/ /de nas dbang skur ba ni/ spyir dbang chen skur yang 'dir bya mod bsdu na sgrub dbang 'dir skur dgos pas de la thog mar khrus dang bgegs bskrad nas spros pa la dga' na sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lo rgyus rgyas bsdus gang rung bshad nas maṇḍal phul/de yang zhu lan rnams gzhung ltar byas te sgrub rdzas yongs rdzogs 96

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/dang mchod rdzas phal cher dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad rnams dang bcas pas dbang dkyus ltar bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas bsngo ba dang shis rjod bya'o/ /de dag gis sgrub chen dngos gzhi'i las 'grig rnams smras zin la/ 'dir ma smos pa thun drug nyul le skyod pa dang / dngos grub skyel chog dang / tshangs pa dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gam lhun grub sbyin sreg dang / gzhung sring pas tshogs bskang gtong lugs dang / las byang phyi ma rnams dang /brda sgo dbye ba rnams bzung tshul dang / bsnyen sgrub kyi dus bgo lugs rnams sgrub chen spyi ltar shes par bya'o/ /rjes kyi las 'grig ni/ de nas brda sgo dbye ba nas bzung las byang dang / ma ning ske/ dregs pa/ tshogs bskang sogs rgyas par byas te lhag ma'i mjug tu sgrub 'bum las/ sna shar gyi phyogs kyi sogs sgo dbye khro bcu'i phur ba dang sgo byang gnyis sogs tho rnams blang la sgrub 'bum las/ oṃ āḥ rtsu gis sogs nas hūṃ rgyal ba'i bka' sdod bstan pa srung sogs bar bya'o/ /gzu dpang ni hūṃ gzu dang dpang du sogs gzhung ltar dang / gtor 'gug dang skul ba rnams dang / chad mdo dang / zor la ma he'i gzhung sring nas byung ba kho na'i mjug drag sngags so lnga brjod de chad mdo bya/brtan ma sogs mthar chags su bya'o/ /phyir nang hri sngon nas 97

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bzung ste lhag ma yan grub rjes gter sbed ni bum pa gzhung bshad ltar dang / yo byad 'du byas nas hūṃ skyob pa sangs rgyas sogs nas smon lam bar bya la/ gzhan la yang kha bsgyur shes par bya'o/ /shis pa brjod/ de nas dkar gtor sogs dang / bro mnan bya/ tshe dbang skur ba sgrub 'bum ltar bya/ yang shes brjod dang —/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ sku drin gso ba/ mar me'i smon lam/ shis brjod/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ lhar ldang / lus srung rnams sgrub 'bum dang ma he'i gzhung sring sogs 'thab shes par bya'o/ /mjug tu sgrub 'bum las/ ho dge ba dri med sogs bsngo ba bya'o/ /'di dag tu smras pa rnams go rim phal cher thugs sgrub sogs dang mi 'dra yang gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi rgyud dang sgrub 'bum nas byung ba ltar yin pas 'di ltar byas na legs par mthong ngo / /gzhan 'gal med rnams sgrub 'bum las go rim byung ba rnams lag len mi bde bas sgrub chen gzhan la rigs 'gres byas pa yang yod pa lags so/ /smras pa/ rgyal bstan 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ man ngag mar gyi nying khu 'di byung bas/ /thar 'dod skyes bu'i bcud du len shes na/ /'chi med zung 'jug grub par the mi tshom nges gsang rgyud sde'i gnas la dpyad gsum gyi/ /dam pa'i man ngag 98

dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam gyi sgrub thabs sogs kyi skor/mig sman mi bdog na/ /'dris nyams rgan po'i gshis kyi long 'gros des/ /dngos grub gnyis kyi gnad mig mthong bar dka'/ /grogs dag phyi tshul legs pa'i o zob kyis/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la'ang rang bzos bslad pa yi/ /zhwa dpe lham la 'gebs pa'i mun sprul 'dis/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas la bskal mang 'o brgyal 'gyur/ /de phyir dam pa'i man ngag mi bdog par/ /tshod yod sems kyis gsang ba mi dkrug cing / /phyi tshul legs kyang gang byung mi byed par/ /gnas 'dir bag yod mdzod cig snying nas zhu/ /zhes pa 'di ni rmongs ban ma 'i ming gis smras pa dge'o//99

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/khog /gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zag med kyi rol mtsho chen por gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ rghaṃ gli/ ka dag spros bral brjod med rig pa'i mdangs/ /lhun grub ye shes phyag rgya rtag gi skur/ /bzhengs mdzad dpal ldan mgon po tshogs kyi bdag /ma ning nag po sku gsung thugs mgon dang / /e ka tsa tī gnod sbyin dmar nag dang / /zhing skyong seng gdong rdo rje nge nus ma/ /ar ya rī man gang ba bzang po dang / /gnod sbyin nor bdag dzam lha rigs lnga bcas/ /nor dbang a par ṭī ta ye shes grags/ /gza' rgod khyab 'jug gdong mo mched bzhi bcas/ /rdo rje legs pa bdud btsan klu yi mgon/ /thang lha mkha' ri mdo khams gnas gzhi'i bdag /zab gter srung ma rma rgyal spom ra che / /gnyan chen mu le sha med la sogs pa/ /sngon byon grub dbang rdo rje'i tha tshig la/ /ral med snying gis g.yar dam 'chang ba yi /chos skyong nor lha gter bdag yum sras mched/ /blon 'bangs bka' nyan las byed 'khor dang bcas/ /skad cig thogs med yud kyis 'dir gshegs la/ /mchod tshogs 'dod 'byung gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la / /kha 'dzin srung skyob bya ra mi g.yel zhing / /tshe 'dir nor 'phel gegs zhi bsam dgu 'grub/ /khyad par byang chub bsgrub 102

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/pa'i mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /legs tshogs dpal gyi dga' ston la rol nas/ /bkra shis dge ba'i dpal gyis legs phyug shog / ces pa'ang rang slob bla ma bsod nams nas bskul ngo ma ldog par phran dpal yul rdzong sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo je dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rol mo zhes 'bod pas gang dran shar mar spel ba'o//༄7/ /bswo/ mi mngon chos dbyings stong chen 'od gsal gshes / /lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i mkha' klong nas/ /srid zhi mnyam sbyor 'khor ba yongs sgrol ba'i/ /dpal chen mtshan dpe'i skur bzhengs he ru ka /tshogs rje tshogs bdag yum chen bā ta li//dug gsum yongs sgrol sku gsung thugs mgon dang / /rtog tshogs gnas dag phyogs bcu'i mgon po dang / /sde brgyad mgon po pho nya bdud shan rtsis/ /sprul ba yang sprul lha dmag 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /phyi skyems ja chang zas phud bā ling ta/ /nang ltar rtsa rlung thig le byang chub sems/ /gsang ba rang grol rtog tshogs 'gyu 'phro'i 'phrul / /rang babs chos dbyings rgyan gyi mchod pa 'bul/ /kun rtog las kyi sgrib pa yongs dag nas/ /thams cad mi gnas byang chub sems kyi dbyings/ /'gro 'ong gnas bral kun bzang bde ba che/ /rig stong rdo rje'i rang zhal mngon mjal nas/ /zag bcas rdul bral 'ja' skur grol ba yi/ /rtsol med 'phrin /rdo3 ma

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/kāshārji ༵ ṭā sna /zla/kān/da ska// spya/ ñtsha sdi 'e pa'i sprin sa/sna /lhag//bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas nas kyang / /tshul khrims bsung zhim phyogs su rgyu ba yi/ /bkra shis dge mtshan bla na 'bar gyur cig /ces pa'ang padma 'gro 'dul nas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor rdo rje che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis thol byung du shar mar bris pa dge zhing bkra shis//༄khya/ /sngags srung ma'i gsol bsdus bzhugs/༄7/ /bhyoḥdabyings kyi yum chen mkha' 'gro e ka tsā/ /smug nag khros ma dgra bo'i snying 'byin ma/ /nges gsang a ti'i bstan srung dpal lha mo/ /ye shes las dang 'jig rten ma mo'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs kun bzang rol pa'i mchod sprin bzhes/ /snying po'i rang lugs dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /'phrin las gang bcol ma g.yel khyed kyis sgrubs/ khyad par zab lam 'od gsal snying po'i don/ /sgom pa'i 'phrang sol bogs bskyed bsam don sgrubs / /mdor na rnal 'byor yid la gang brtsam pa'i 'phrin las rab 'byams ma g.yel myur 'grub mdzod/ /ces gsol mchod 'di zab gter mdzod 'dzin chos nyid gling pa'i bka' yis bskul ngor phran dpal sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes bris pa dge'o//10/thi/ /bhyoḥrgyal kun bskyed yum bde stong dbyings kyi 'phrul//

'azin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/sngags kyi srung ma e ka tsā ti ma/ /ye shes las dang 'jig rten ma mo'i tshogs/ /'khor bcas 'dir gshegs bsang skyems gtor ma sogs/ /dngos bshams yid byung mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod/ /'gal 'khrul nyes bshags dag tshangs mchog stsol nas/ /bar gcod gegs zhi bsam don yid bzhin 'grub/ khyad par chos ldan bya ba gang brtsam pa/ /myur 'grub 'phral yun phan bde'i legs tshogs rgyas/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod / /ces pa'ang o rnam ngor chos kyi zla bas so//gcu/ /bhyoḥdangos bshams yid byung ting 'dzin 'phrul/ /zag med mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang / /snang srid dag mnyam bde ba ches / /dbyings yum 'khor 'das ma mo'i tshogs/ /kun rdzob snang cha'i ri mo las/ /'khrugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa bskang / /dag tshangs mchog stsol mi mthun sol/ /don gnyis dpal gyi dga' ston stsol/ /ces pa'ang chos sde chen po dar thang mdo sngags bshad sgrub gling gi mdo rgyud thos bsam gling ba'i grwa tshang la rgyun gsog tu dmigs te dpal sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes bris pa lags so//༄7/ /oṃ shri he ru ka ma hā kro ta ye/ ka dag dbyings dang bde chen rdo rje'i khams/ kha dog dbyibs su rab 'bar keng rus gzugs/ /gang gis mchod bstod gsol zhing las bcol na / /nga bdag gzung 'dzin mtshan ma dbyings sgrol phyir/ 1//5 co

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/tsam min snying nas spyan 'dren na/ /cha lugs sna tshogs 'phrul mtshan g.yo bzhin gshegs/ /ja chang bā ling ri mtsho ltar bkrams 'dir/ /nya rgyas zla ltar lhag ger brtan bzhugs nas/ /ta thā ga ta'i bstan la rab dgongs te/ /tha mal 'khrul rtog ngan spyod 'dam bying ba'i/ /da dus skyes pa'i rnal 'byor bdag 'dra la / /nam yang mi g.yel thugs kyis nyer dgongs te/ /padma badzra sogs kyis dam bzhag ltar/ /pha rol phyin dang theg rtse'i dgongs don spel/ /ba lang rwa bzhin chos la ring ba dang / /mi dge'i sdig spyod kho nas dus 'da' ba'i/ /tsa ma ra sogs yul dang 'gro ba la/ /tsha grang nad sogs mi 'dod rkyen ngan phobs/ /dza ya'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan tshugs te/ /wa skyes lta log ming gi lhag mar mdzod/ /zhwa bzhin mchog gsum gtsug tu bkur byed cing / /zas nor mchod mgron bsnyen bkur sbyin bdag la/ /'al 'ol tsam min rtag tu srung skyob mdzod/ /ya rabs mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug la/ /ra ltar blo mi khug pa'i dregs ldan dang / /la lung nyes med sems can sna tshogs pa/ /sha zan lce spyang ltar gsod 'gro ba dang / /sa ma ya rgyud 'chol bar spyod pa rnams/ /ha he'i rdo rje'i mtshon gyis rab bsgral te/ /a don skye med dbyings su 'pho bar mdzod/ /mdor na bstan dang 106

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/bstan 'dzin rgya cher 'phel/ /bstan la rab gus rgyal srid stobs 'byor rgyas/ /yid srub nag po'i rtsa lag rtsad nas chom/ /mthun rkyen zas nor char ltar bsnyil nas kyang / /phan bde'i legs tshogs gong nas gong 'phel ba'i/ /bstan srung sems dpa' mchog tu mnga' gsol na/ /lugs gnyis rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las 'bad med du/ /bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las ma g.yel sa ma ya/ /zhes pa'ang ston gsum 'bras ldan gyi dga' ston la spyod pa'i dus tshes dge bar bkra zhes pas dge zhing shis pa'i ming gi dge mtshan gyi 'gram yid 'ong khod snyoms kyi gnas dag par khrag 'thung bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa dge'o//༄7/ /hūṃ dur khrod bdag po yab yum bka' 'khor bcas/ /'dir gshegs dngos bshams yid las byung ba yi/ /zag med kun bzang mchod tshogs 'di bzhes la/ /gnod byed dgra rkun 'ching ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa dpal sprul chos kyi zla bas so//༄ga /nor sgrub dbang gi zhags pa yid bzhin re skong zhes bya ba/༄7/ /na mo ratna sa twa rgya/ /bgrang yas bskal bar sbyin pa'i par phyin la/ /rab goms blo yi nus pa'i 'bras bzang las/ /'dod dgu'i mchog stsol nor ster 'chang pa'i gzugs/ /rnam mang thos sras bka' sdod dang bcas rgyal/ /de la rnyed bkur gyis 'phong pa'i gang zag gis ched du rang 'dod kyi 'ching ba dang bral bas 107

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gzhan phan dang dkon mchog mchod pa'i rdzas su dmigs nas dbang sgrub kyi tshul la 'bad dgos pa yin zhing /de la thog mar rang gnas nas bskul dgos pa yin pas/rang nyid skad cig gzhi las he ru ka /gsang ba'i bdag po gtum chen mthing ba'i zhal/ /sgeg thung khros pa'i nyams can dpal chas rdzogs/ /g.yas g.yon rdor zhags me klong gar dgur rol / /o āḥ rtsu badzra tsa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭaḥ bgrang / rang mdun spang ljongs gangs ri'i phreng ba'i dbus/ /bī yig yongs gyur dge bsnyen nor bdag che/ /rnam mang thos sras 'dod pa khams kyi bdag /yab yum sras blon 'khor 'bangs las byed bcas / /skad cig thogs med yud kyis 'dir gshegs la/ /dngos yid ting 'dzin 'phrul las byung ba yi/ /mchod tshogs zag med bde skyed dam tshig rdzas/ /'dod 'byung nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin 'di bzhes/ /tshe chos dpal 'byor yar zla ltar 'phel zhing / /sa gsum skye 'gro'i snang sems dbang du bsdus/ /yid la 'dod pa'i dpal yon legs khug nas/ /phun tshogs bye/shā spra sapa// / du spyaX /tshor shog /ces pa'ang gyi na ba rdzong sprul ming 108

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/dku/ /rgyal chen rnam sras kyi gtor chog dbang gi zhags pa bzhugs so/ /༄gi /na mo gu ru ye/ de la gtor ma sgrom po nor bu'i dbyibs can 'dod rdzas du mas spras pa dang dkar dmar ja chang skyems phud bcas 'bru gsum nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel la/ rang gi snying ku'i 'od zer gyis/ /rin chen gter gyi pho brang nas/ /rgyal chen rnam sras yum 'khor bcas / /skad cig gnas 'dir sa ma dza/ /bī 'das pa'i dus nas sngon byung ba/ /yang dag sangs rgyas rin chen mang / /gnod sbyin nor ster tshul 'chang ba/ /rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras mtshan / /yab yum sras blon gnod sbyin tshogs/ /rin chen nor rkyal pho mo la/ /phyi mchod 'dod yon rnam lnga dang / /nang mchod rgya phor bse phor dang / /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rdzas/ /gsang mchod sman raka gtor gsum dang / /sbyor sgrol stag gzig nor bu'i rigs/ /rten rdzas mdung dmar rgyal mtshan dang —/ /dgra snying bse rmog khrab la sogs/ /ting 'dzin yid las byung ba dang / /dmar dkar ja chang skyems phud dang / /'dod 'byung dpal gyi gtor ma sogs/ /dngos 'byor mchod pa 'di 'bul na/ /dgyes bzhes dam skong dngos grub stsol/ khyad par lha 109

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/klu mi yi g.yang / /'gro ba'i tshe dpal stobs 'byor dang / /gzugs dbang lang tsho'i dbyig chen po/ /'bad med rin chen char du snyil/ /'byor ldan skye 'gro'i yid sems skul/ /rnam dkar mchod sbyin mgron du stor/ /zas nor rta glang rin chen gos / /phan phyug gnag lug ja dar 'bru/ /snam ras gser dngul rin chen tshogs/ /gang 'dod yid bzhin dngos grub stsol—/ /chos ldan chos kyi dga' bas 'tsho/ /'byor ldan rtag tu 'byor bas ngoms/ /srid ldan srid mtha' rgyun ring 'phel/ /ci bsam 'bad med 'grub par mdzod/ /bkra shes mchog gsum dpal gyi dbyig / skye dgu'i snying la rtag 'char zhing / /rnam dkar phan bde'i 'phrin las rgyas/ /sa gsum dge ba'i bkra shis stsol/ /oṃ badzra ma hā ra dza yaklu sa ma ya bī sharma ṇa ye sarba tsitta ratna gling dza sa pa ri wa ra e rda bha ling ta kha hi/ bī sharma ṇa rā ga ratna gling gling / sarba gling gling 'gul 'gul yaṃ yaṃ dung dung bsdus bsdus dza dza a du ṇi tri badzra aṅga sha dza/ hūṃ stong pa chen po e yi klong / /lhun grub rig rtsal khro bo'i tshogs/ /thabs shes gnyis med bde stong bro/ /tshe g.yang dpal la gnod byed bgegs / /mnyam pa chen po'i ngang du mnan/ /bskal ba'i bar du ma ldang zhig /tshe g.yang dpal gyi mtsho mo 'khyil/ /sirnyi pha la 110

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/a la la ho/ zhes pa snyigs dus kyi rgud pa sel ba'i rtsod bral gyi gter ston chos nyid gling pas snga mo nas skul ma gnang ba dang nye char dgos gal la brten nas dpal sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes bkra shis 'grub sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i dus su shar mar bris pa dge zhing bkra shis/sngag /dam can mgar ba'i 'dod gsol mchod byang dbang gi zhags pa bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /ho dgongs shig dgra bla'i rgyal po gtsang btsan che/ /dam can rdor legs mgar ba dmar nag dpung / /mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs bcas la/ /zag med ting 'dzin gyis sprul 'dod 'byung bsang / /dkar mngar ja chang brjid ldan bā ling ta/ /nyams pa'i dgra po'i sha khrag nang khrol bcas / /'bul lo dgyes par rol la gsang bdag dang / /pad 'byung rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgos ltar/ /snga 'gyur nges gsang rdo rje'i theg pa yi/ /bka' yi srung ma mchog gi g.yar dam che / /mi g.yel snying gi gta' ru 'dzin pa yi/ /bstan srung sems dpa' mchog tu mnga' gsol lo/ /lam gyi sa mkhan ye shes rdo rje legs / /rig 'dzin bka' sdod dam can rdo rje legs/ /tshe dpal bskyed mdzad skyes bu rdo rje legs/ /gnam sa phyed sdu/ga

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gtsang btsan rdo rje legs/ /'dod don kun sgrub sprul pa'i rdo rje legs / /mi 'bral grogs mdzad dgra bla rdo rje legs/ /'dod dgur cir yang bsgyur ba'i 'phrul mtshan gzi/ /rab 'bar yid bzhin rdor legs mnga' gsol lo/ /dus dgra dus kyi g.yo ba mtha' bzhi'i dpung / /bstan rtsa gzhi nas brlag pa'i yid brnags dgra /gangs ljongs phan bde'i phun tshogs nyams byed gang —/ /rjes shul lhag ma tsam yang med par sgrol/ /rgyal khams mtha' dbus chos srid 'byor ba rgyas/ /las rlung dbang thang nam mkha'i pha mthar brdal/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas/ /de 'dzin rgyal sras rig 'dzin ngang mo'i khyu'i / /bslab gsum rim gnyis srog mkhar legs tshugs te/ /tshe sgrub mthar phyin don gnyis dpal 'phel zhing / /mdor na rnal 'byor yid la gang smon pa'i/ /'dod pa'i don sgrubs 'phrin las thogs med mdzod/ /bdag cag gzhi byes nad gdon dgra rkun skyobs/ /tshe bsod 'byor rgyas las rlung dbang thang dar/ /khams gsum dbang bsdus dgra 'dre bstan bshig sgrol/ /phun tshogs phan bde'i 'phrin las g.yel med sgrubs/ /zhes pa'ang rig pa 'dzin pa khrag 'thung rdo je bdud 'dul rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o/ /('di rdo yul gyi yul lha thang yag mgar ba'i gsol kha yin zhes rjes dkar bla ma 'od tshul nas rgyu ma// byeng bcas te gsungs pa thos/mchan/)

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/༄7/ /trī/ bstan srung sems dpa' rgyal chen sku lnga mched/ /gnod sbyin ci'u dmar btsan dmag 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /las byed shan pa ru 'dren dpung tshogs bcas/ /gsol mchod mi mthun nyer 'che'i 'tshub ma sol/ /tshe chos dpal gyi snang ba'i mdzes 'bar shog /ces pa 'di mchog ming chos kyi zla bas smras pa dge/༄7/ /'dir gshegs gdan bzhugs ting 'dzin rol mo'i 'phrul / /'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin tshogs 'di bzhes la/ /kun rtog 'khrul ba'i rgyal gdon phar mthar skyod/ /tshe chos mthar spyan tshabakra shis phywa g.yang stsol/ /ces pa 'di ni mchog sprul chos kyi zla bas sa ri/༄/ga /thub bstan spyi dang nges gsang snying po'i srog /mi nub yun du srung ba'i g.yar dam mchog /snying gi go ru 'dzin pa'i bstan srung che/ /rno myur stobs ldan gnod sbyin tsi ma ra/ /sku sprul mched zla btsan rgod rnam drug bcas/ /glog ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis 'dir gshegs la/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod tshogs ji snyed dang / /bsang dang gser skyems bā ling gtor ma'i tshogs/ /mtha' mi bstan dgra'i srog dgugs sha khrag bcas/ /'bul bzhes mchod gsol sngon dam rjes dgongs la/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin rgya cher rab 'phel zhing / /phun tshogs 113

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/lung rtogs dpal g.yang nub med par/ /mtha' 'dre rgyal gdon kla klo'i dpung tshogs kun/ /la 'ur me tog sad khyer ji bzhin thongs / /rgyal khams phan bde'i 'bras bur longs spyod pa'i/ /dge ba'i dpal la rol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa'ang mchog ming chos kyi zla bas nyer mkho'i stabs kyis bris/༄ga /bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gsol mchod phan bde'i gru char 'bebs pa'i sprin bcud zhes bya ba/༄gi /padma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtsang ma'i stegs bur mchod gtor bdud bshos bzhi/ /dkar skum bzhi dang gru gsum dmar gtor bzhi/ /rim bzhin bzhi sgrom rgyan mdzes dar gyis brgyan/ /bsdu na dkar dmar bdud bshos gsum gyis 'bus/ /gser skyems dkar phud spos sna'i bsang dud sbyar/ /mda' dararu mtshon lhab lhub spyan gzigs dang / /bran pa'i rol mo dang bcas 'di skad gyer/ /rang nyid padma thod phreng skur gsal ba'i/ /thugs ku'i 'od kyis brtan ma 'khor tshogs bcas/ /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes bskul sprin dpung bzhin/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar thogs med gshegs par gyur/ /bhyoḥbaka' yi bran g.yog tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs brtan ma skyong ma rnams/ /sngon gyi thugs dam dam 114

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/tshig rjes dgongs la/ /'dir gshegs mchod bzhes rnal 'byor 'dod don sgrubs/ /badzra sa ma dza/ me tog tshal dang spos sprin gtibs / /mar me gzi 'bar dri chab klung / /ro ldan zhal zas snyan 'jebs sgra/ /'chi med bdud rtsi dmar chen khrag /bā ling 'dod yon gtor ma sogs/ /phyi nang mchod sprin dam tshig rdzas/ /thugs la dgyes dgur gang 'char ba/ /dngos bshams yid las rnam sprul pas/ /rab 'byams nam mkha' yongs bkang ste/ /ma cig kong btsun de mo sogs/ /dam can brtan ma bcu gnyis po//'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la/ /'bul lo dgyes shing tshim par mdzod/ /oṃ badzra dundhe lha pe a lo ke garnye n+ya wī de shabha a mṛ ta rakta bā ling ta ma hā pu dza ho/ zhes pas mchod nas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūṃ sngon tshe slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /bka' nyan bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma rnams/ /mdzes brjid sku la sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /mi zad cho 'phrul 'dod dgur bsgyur ba yi/ /'phrin las thogs med dam tshig rjes gcod ma/ /bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bstod/ /bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong —/ /gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang / /'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /bdud mo bzhi yang 'dir 115

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gshegs gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong / /btsan la drag mo rdo rje sman gcig ma//g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje zu le ma / sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil/ /sman btsun bzhi yang 'dir gshegs gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /sha med gangs dkar rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ /kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyiyam/ /gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang / /rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /gnod sbyin bzhi yang 'dir gshegs gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bod skyong brtan ma chen mo khyod rnams kyang / /sngon tshe rdo rje thod phreng spyan snga ru/ /zhing chen gdan la tshogs kyi mchod bkram nas/ /rnam lnga bdud rtsi'i longs spyod mnga' 'bul te/ /dbang bskur dam mnos ming btags lung yang bstan/ /lag tu rdo rje byin nas gral du bzhag /ji ltar bka' bsgos khas blangs dam bcas bzhin / /dam las ma 'da' bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gal te dam tshig 'di las 'da' gyur na/ /rdo rje yaklu khros pas snying dkyil nas/ /khrag drang 'o dod 'bod par gdon mi za/ /de bas las rnams thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis 116

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/sman phran 'bum dang bcas/ /bran g.yog 'khor bcas gtor ma 'di longs la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi//bar chad dgra bgegs nad dang gnod pa'i tshogs/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi dang bzlog pa dang / /rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /khyad par padma thod phreng bka' bsgos ltar / /so kha srung dang kla klo'i 'tshe ba bzlog /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas shing / /bod khams mtha' dbus rtag tu bde bar mdzod/ /('dod gsol rgyas pa mi sbyar na mtha'i rgyal bstan dar zhing zhes pa sbyar/ )ces pa'i dam skul 'phrin las gnyer dam bya/ khyad par 'dod gsol dmigs bsal sbyar bar spro na/ stobs ldan rnams kyi rgyud la bsam ngan gyi / /'jig rten phung sems zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ci ste las ngan dbang gis phung g.yos kyang / /nus med rang zhir gyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gzhan dma' 'bebs phyir g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi/ /'khrugs long ma lus zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /chags sdang dbang gis dus 'khrugs 'di zhi nas/ /so sor rang dbang thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang rims kun dang / /bgegs rigs brgyad khri gdon chen bco lnga sogs/ /lus srog dge la bar du gcod pa yi/ /'byung po'i gnod pa zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /skar mda' lhung dang 117

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/sa g.yos 'jigs pa dang / /byad stems mthu dang thog ser 'bebs pa sogs/ /mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pa dang / /nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /glo bur ye 'drog gnod pa ma lus dang / /dug dang sbyar dug kha zas ma zhu dang / /'khon dang nyams grib 'bags dang mi gtsang sogs/ /dri ma thams cad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dus min 'chi bar gyur pa sna tshogs dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang / /'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba rnams/ /myur du zhi zhing med pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /yul phyogs kun tu char chu dus su 'bebs / /lo phyug rtag tu legs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mi nad phyugs nad dus 'khrugs rgyun chad nas/ /rgyal khams dge ba'i 'tsho ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rgyal bstan dar zhing bstan 'dzin bshad sgrub 'phel/ /rgyal po chos spyod 'gro rnams dge bcu ldan/ /nad mug 'khrugs rtsod ming yang mi grags shing / /rdzogs ldan bde skyid dar ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gsol mchod 'di nyid nyer mkho'i dgos gal la brten nas thub bstan 'jigs med chos kyi zla bas dpal sa skya ba chen po kun dga' blo gros dang 'gro ba'i mgon po gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje'i gsung gnyis las ji ltar 'os pa 'don bder nyung bsdus lhag bsam dag pas sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis/118

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/khug /brtan ma'i gsol bsdus phan bde'i 'od snang zhes bya ba/༄7/ /rtsu trī/ chos dbyings stong chen 'od gsal gnyug ma'i 'phrul / /padma thod phreng bka' nyan bod skyong gtso/ /bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis sman phran 'bum dang bcas/ /lhab lhub gos dang rin chen rgyan mdzes can/ /mkha' dbyings khyon 'gengs spyan 'dren dgyes bzhugs la/ /zag med ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs pa'i / /dkar mngar ja chang dam rdzas bā ling ta/ /'dod 'byung bzang shing sman spos sbyar ba'i dri/ /lha klu mi yi mchod tshogs ji snyed dang / /mtha' mi bstan dgra'i srog dbugs sha khrag bcas/ /'bul lo bzhes mchod sngon dam rjes dgongs la/ /rnal 'byor 'khor bcas gzhi byes dus kun tu/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las g.yel med srung skyob mdzod/ /gangs ljongs mtha' dbus dge bcu'i snang bas mdzes/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dpal la rtag rol nas/ /mtha' dmag mtha' 'dre'i rgyu ba rgyun bcad nas/ /rgyal bstan mi nub yun brtan 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces nar ma'i gsol mchod rgyur chos kyi zla bas so// 119

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/༄ / /trī padma'i bka' nyan bod khams skyong byed pa/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor tshogs 'bum phrag bcas/ /'dir gshegs gdan bzhugs dngos yid ting 'dzin 'phrul/ /mchod tshogs dgyes bzhes sngon dam rjes dgongs la/ /gangs can mtha' dbus bde skyid dar rgyas shing / /thub bstan yun du brtan pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa'ang mchog ming pas so//༄7/ /bhyoḥ bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs/ /'khor bcas 'dir gshegs mchod tshogs bzhes/ /mtha' bzhi'i dmag sde'i so kha srungs/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde yun brtan mdzod //ces mchog ming pas so//smon /ge sar skyes bu chen po'i gsol mchod re ba kun skong yid bzhin dbang rgyal zhes bya/༄na /na mo padma kā ra ye/ de la gtor ma dkar skum rgyan ldan dang gser skyems 'bru sna sogs bza' btung gi dngos po gya rnam pa dang / khyad par dri bzang gi shing dang sman spos sbyar ba'i dud sprin mkha' khyab tu spros la/ rang nyid thod phreng rtsal gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ zhes ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor sbyangs/ 'bru gsum dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ rol tshogs mdzes brjid rngam par 'khrol zhing snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis/ kye ki ki ki la bswo 120

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/bswo bswo/ /kun gsal mthing gi bu mo'i bzhin ras la/ /rab dkar chu 'dzin dar gyi lwa thod can/ /ha har bzhad pa snang grag sprin gyi dbyangs/ /sgra ldan glog gi phreng ba'i do shal dbus/ /rab mdzes lha yi bkod pa'i gzhal med khang / /rgyan rdzogs rin chen gdan khri brjid pa'i dbus/ /'dzam gling yongs kyi ral ba'i cod pan la/ /dbang bsgyur seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul ni/ /ku mud mdangs 'tsher rol ba'i stabs kyis 'gying / /g.yas pas sba lcag lcags kyus mtshan pa 'phyar/ /g.yon pas gter bum gru mor rgyal mtshan brten/ /rdo rje'i go khrab sku la brjid par gsol//phyi rol 'ja' sprin glog zhags 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /dpa' rtsal dgra bla'i sde dpon sum cu dang / /'khor gyi dmag tshogs nyi rdul grangs mnyam pa/ /rno ba'i mtshon thogs mgyogs pa'i rta pho bcibs / /brjid pa'i gos gyon ki bsa'i gad mo sgrog / gcig las du mar sprul zhing snyigs dus kyi/ /rgyal bstan srung pa'i g.yar dam dran mdzod la/ /sna tshogs myur ldan g.yo ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi/ /yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs / /'dod yon lnga dang bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad/ /rin chen bdun dang lha mi'i 'byor ba bcas/ /seng chen dgra 'dul 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bdud rtsi sman dang 'o phud rin 121

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/chen skyems/ /'dod 'byung brjid ldan bā ling gtor ma dang / /nyams pa bsgral ba'i khrag zhag dri bzang shing / /sman spos sbyar ba'i dud sprin 'khrigs pa yi/ /zegs ma rer yang dpag med mchod pa'i sprin/ /lha mi'i 'dod yon ma tshang med pa'i dngos/ /dbang po drug gi spyod yul mnyes byed rdzas/ /'bul lo seng chen dgra bla'i tshogs la 'bul/ /dgyes pa'i zhal ston mthun pa'i legs tshogs spel/ /bsam pa'i don sgrubs phyogs las rnam par rgyal / /khams gsum dbang bsdus grags pa'i ru mtshon sgrengs/ /mi mthun rgyad pa'i tshogs rnams zhi bar mdzod/ khyad par gang la dmigs pa'i don 'bras 'di/ /bsam 'phel dbang rgyal rgyal mtshan rtser mchod ltar/ /thogs med myur bar stan thog 'di nyid du/ /smin pa'i dga' ston cir yang ster bar mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /gzhi byes kun tu bya ra mi g.yel bar/ /nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus min 'chi ba sogs/ /'jigs pa kun las rtag tu skyob par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag la ma nyes bsdo ba yi/ /yid sbubs dpung gi rtsa lag rtsad nas choms/ /dkon mchog mchod pa'i rdzas dang yo byad tshogs / /ma byin rku zhing 'phrog pa'i bsam sbyor can/ /sngon dang da lta phyis su 'byung gyur pa/ /gang dag mchis pa de kun gang 122

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/'dul gyis/ /rnam 'gyur 'phrul mtshan stong gi mthu rtsal gyis/ /gab pa mngon phyungs sgrib pa gsal bar ston/ /ngang tshul ji bzhin rdol gtam smrar chug cig /da dus skal ngan snyigs ma tha ma'i tshe/ /rgyal bstan bshad sgrub nyi zla dgung du yal/ /bstan 'dzin gser ri'i phreng ba mun khrod yib/ /nag phyogs mi dang 'byung po'i srin bya rgod/ /phan bde'i dpal g.yang lang tsho nyams chas pas/ /khyed cag lhag bsam dam bca'i go cha che/ /ral med srog gi mdud par bsdam byos la/ /rgyal bstan de 'dzin bcas pa'i dbu 'phang bstod/ /nyams pa ma rabs skye bo'i mgo 'phang smod/ /gang zhig bslab gsum rin chen rgyan 'dor dang / /smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsi dug bsgyur mkhan / /ma rabs mgo 'phang bstod dang srid sde'i tshogs/ /gal med sdug la sbyor ba'i rang 'dod can/ khyad par chos sde 'dis mtshon phyogs kun gyi/ /spong dang klog pa'i sde grwa che phra la/ /dma' 'bebs dngos dang brgyud nas 'tshe ba dang / /bstan pa'i snying po 'dul khrims gtsang ma'i sgo/ /rnam par 'byed la khyog po'i mig ldan sogs/ /bsam sbyor gdug pa'i tsher ma'i dbal 'chang ba / /rje dang 'bangs dang nang 'khor nye ba'i khrod/ /gang du gnas kyang srog rtsa rbad kyis chod/ /dus kyi rgyad pas brtan g.yo 123

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/thams cad 'jig /las kyi 'bras bu chud mi za ba smin/ /dus dang las la ma ltos la 'ur du/ /brnags pa'i 'phrin las ma g.yel khyod kyis sgrubs/ mdor na snod bcud rgyad pa'i g.yo 'khrugs zhi/ /tshe chos dpal 'byor snyan grags rlung rta rgyas/ /khams gsum yul dbus zas gos nor g.yang khug /dgra 'dre bstan bshig mthu rtsal drag pos sgrol/ /khyad par bshad sgrub srog gi yu ba brtan/ /lung rigs dpal gyi gad mos sa gsum g.yo / /bslab gsum gos kyis legs spud rgyal mtshan mchog /srid zhi'i khams na mdzes par 'bar gyur cig /de 'dzin dad brtson shes rab phul phyin pa'i//dge 'dun thugs mthun khrims gtsang gos kyis brjid//mthun rkyen 'byor ba char bzhin dbab nas kyang / /chog shes bde spyod nor dang ldan par mdzod/ /bstan dang 'gro la gcig tu sman pa yi/ /lhag pa'i bsam ldan rnal 'byor bdag cag gis//gang bcol 'phrin las thogs med yid bzhin tu//bsgrub pa'i dge mtshan ston cig 'dzam gling rje//gcig tu khyod gsol khyod mchod khyod bsten na/ /yal yol ma mdzad mthu rtsal shugs bskyed la/ /bkra shes phan bde'i snang bas sa gsum du/ /rdzogs ldan 'bum kyi gzi byin 'bar mdzod kyi / /zhes pa'ang skabs kyi dgos gal 'ga' zhig la brten nas 'jam dpal dgyes 124

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/pa'i rdo rjeXm rdo rje che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis shar mar bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyunā ga/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal zhe snang rdo rje'i skur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas mchod rdzas ma dag pa'i dngos po thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod bharnya 'bar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor rdzas ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa 'dod yon gyi sprin phung zad med du spro ba'i dbyig chen po zag med mthu byin rgyas pa'i rmad byung bdud rtsi'i gser skyems dang 'o phud bzang shing sman spos kyi dud sprin la sogs mchod pa'i yo byad dngos su bshams pa rgya chen sngags kyis byin gyis rlabs shing / dran rig 'od gsal rdo rje'i cho rol las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pa lha klu mi yi 'dod dgu'i dngos po ma tshang ba med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can glog 'khyug pa ltar 'phros pas dpal dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma gnyan chen thod pa rtsal yab yum blon 'bangs bka' sdod sgo skyong ru 'dren pho nya shan pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las sgyu 'phrul gyi rol pa zhi khro'i nyams cir yang 'char 125

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/ba rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bkod pa chen pos mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa ma dzaḥthug /dpal dgra bla'i rgyal po gnyan chen rmu bdud rtse dgu 'khor bcas kyi gsol mchod 'dod don kun 'grub 'phrin las dbang gi zhags pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/༄ / /rang gi snying kha'i rtsu las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can glog 'khyug pa ltar 'phros pas dpal dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma gnyan chen thod pa rtsal yab yum sras blon bka' sdod sgo skyong ru 'dren shan pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las sgyu 'phrul gyi rol pa zhi khro'i nyams cir yang 'char ba rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bkod pa chen pos mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa ma dzaḥ dar sna'i g.yab mo dang rol tshogs mdzes bajid rngam par 'khrol bas/ rtsu chos dbyings spros bral 'dus ma byas/ /kun khyab byang chub sems kyi 'phrul/ /gzhan dbang bya rtsol las 'das pa'i/ /yongs grub don gyi he ru ka /kun btags 'khrul bas bslad pa'i 'gro/ /thugs rje'i brtse bas sgrol mdzad pa'i/ /dpal chen stobs ldan nag po che/ /bstan 126

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/srung sems dpa'i skur bzhengs pa/ /gnyan chen rmu bdud rtse dgu che/ /yab yum sras blon 'khor 'bangs rnams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam rol bcas/ /bkod pa rab mdzes gnas 'dir gshegs / /gling bzhi'i pho brang so so nas/ /srog bdag nor ster gnod sbyin tshul/ /rang rang g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcas/ /chos ldan 'dzin ma'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /pho brang mkha' spyod tsā ri nas/ /bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum zhes/ /sgrub pa'i 'phrang bsal grogs mdzad pa'i/ /rnam rol 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /mdor na gdul dka'i snyigs ma'i 'gro /'dul thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /sgyu 'phrul rol pa ji snyed pa / /ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /oṃ shrī badzra dharma pā la nā ga rā tsa ga tri phu sa pa ri wa ra badzra sa ma yā dza dzaḥ.a bī sha ya tiṣṭha lhan/ hūṃ trī/ mchod yon bdun dang bkra shis rdzas / /rtags brgyad rin chen sna bdun dang / /mi dbang nye ba'i rin po che/ /gling bzhi bkod mdzes sgra snyan bcas/ /phyi yi mchod pa dpag med pa/ /lha gnyan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /gzugs mdzes sgeg bzhad g.yo ba dang / /gar gyi rnam pas rab bsgyings pa/ /'byung ba'i sgra dang glu gar dbyangs/ /bstod dang tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra/ /lhan skyes sbyar ba'i dri dang ro/ /lha klu 127

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/mi yi reg 'jam gos/ /sna tshogs chos kyi skye mched bcas/ /nang gi mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes/ /sna tshogs 'phrul stabs g.yo ba'i gar / /dpa' bo'i yid la myos ster ma/ /rig mchog lnga yi mu tra che / /bde chen chags pa'i dbyings su bzhes/ /rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong / /sbyar ba'i sman chen rā sa ya/ /dug gsum bsgral ba'i khrag chen po/ /nyams pa zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra/ /phye mar gtub pa'i sha dang rus/ /don snying dbang lnga'i me tog dang / /gsur chen bdug spos zhun chen me/ /khrag sna'i dri chab bam chen ro / /rkang gling thod pa'i cang te 'u/ /rmad byung gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i bstan srung lha gnyan rje/ /'khor dang yang 'khor bcas la 'bul/ /rnal 'byor chos bzhin sgrub pa yi/ /'phrang sol bogs bskyed bsam don sgrubs/ /dge legs rin chen phung po'i char/ /phyogs dus kun tu 'bebs par mdzod/ /yang cig mchod pa'i sprin spro ba/ /'dod 'byung bsang gi dud sprin ni/ /dkar sngo g.yu 'od 'khyil ba'i mdangs/ /dri bzang stong khams khyab pa'i dngos/ /byed las dbang po'i spyod yul du/ /ma tshang med pa'i 'dod 'byung rdzas/ /dkar dmar ja chang skyems phud bcas/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'phrul/ /smugs 'thibs nyams dang bying ba'i grib/ /gzhan yang ro bag 128

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/dme 'khon dang / /dam nyams sdom gsum ral ba'i grib/ /rdzas sbyor dmod pa'i grib la sogs/ /mi mthun rgyad pa'i skyon bsal bar / /mthu ldan sngags rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /gnyan chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mthu stobs nyams rtsal rgyas phyir 'bul / /gzhan yang 'bru bshos dkar dmar brgyan/ /mkha' la lding dang sa la 'dzul/ /chu la 'phyo dang gangs la gnas/ /thang la 'grim zhing spang la brten/ /gcan gzan ri g.yung mi yi nor/ /dgos rgyu ma tshang med pa ni/ /mang por ting nge 'dzin gyis spel/ /so sor thob pa sngags rgyas byas/ /rdo rje'i dam ldan khyed rnams kyis / /spyan sngar ci 'dod 'byung gyur cig /khyed rnams mkho rgyas mnyes nas kyang/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i don rnams sgrubs / /de ltar phul ba'i yon tan gyis/ /khyed rnams stobs ldan gzi brjid rgyas/ /'jig rten dge ba'i 'phrin las stsol/ /nam mkha' mnyam par 'bar gyur cig /de'i mthus 'jig brten kun dar nas/ /dkar phyogs mtho zhing nag phyogs nyams / /dge bcu 'phel zhing mi dge 'grib/ /char 'beb lo phyug legs par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi / /srung ma mchog tu khyod bsten na/ /nad gdon dgra rkun 'jigs las srungs/ /tshe chos dpal 'byor rlung rta spel/ khams 129
