dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gsum skye 'gro zas nor bsdus/ /yid srubs dpung gi rtsa lag chom / khyad par mi yi tshe dpal dang / /phyugs kyi g.yang kha ral byed gegs/ /bsam sbyor tsher ma'i dbal chog la/ /mi phyugs nad yams zhi bar mdzod/ /ljongs 'dir dge bcu'i snang bas mdzes / /ngur smrig gos kyis legs g.yogs shing / /sde snod rgya mtsho'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /bslab gsum nor bu'i dpal drangs mdzod / /phan tshun dge 'dun mthun gnas shing / /bste stang rim gro kun 'phel nas/ /sdom gsum 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/don gnyis lhun grub 'phrin las mdzod/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bzhed pa'i don/ /bshad sgrub chos kyi snang ba 'bar/ /khrel bag ngo tsha'i gos kyis brjid/ /chos 'dul rgyal mtshan brtan par mdzod / /phyogs bzhi'i rgyal blon skyes pa 'bangs/ /mi mthun rgyad pa nyer zhi zhing / /chos dang nor dang 'dod dang thar/ /sde bzhi'i dpal yon rgyas par mdzod/ /de dag bstan la rab gus nas/ /dkon mchog rnyed bkur gyis bsnyen cing / /dpyid kyi dpal mo'i sgra dbyangs ltar/ /snyan pas sa steng khyab par mdzod/ /bkra shes dam chos dkon mchog dpal/ /skye dgu'i snying la rtag 'char bas/ /ma lus phan bde'i gzhir gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis mi nub gnas par mdzod/ /de nas bstod skul drag pos 'phrin 130

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/las ni/ hūṃ gli/ ma chags padma'i rigs kyi cho 'phrul las/ /'jigs rung drag po'i skur bzhengs he ru ka /snang srid zil gnon padma badzra rtsal/ /nga las ma gtogs tha dad dbyer med pa'i / /de phyir snang srid sde dpon khyed rnams nyon/ /sngon gyi chad mdo g.yar dam dran mdzod la/ /mthun rdzas gtor ma'i tshogs rnams dang du bzhes/ /rnal 'byor gang brtsam don rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /sngon tshe 'phags yul dur khrod phung lung nag /bar du bsam yas has po ri yi rtser/ /tha ma zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang cher/ /dmod pa drag sngags dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas / /bstan srung dge bsnyen rdo rje thod pa rtsal/ /zhes gsol rdo rje phyed pa'i dbang rtags bcas/ /rdo rje'i mna' chu lce la bzhag nas kyang / /dbang bzhi'i chu bo rim gyis bskur ba'i dus/ /(dpe kha cig tu mnos pa'i dus zhes pa snang /)rig 'dzin rgyal dbang padma thod phreng gis/ /gdong dmar bod kyi lha srin rnam mang las mthu rtsal myur ba'i stobs la cher bsngags bcas/ /rdo rje'i bstan dang zab gter gnyer gtad tshe/ /bskos gdab rang gis khas blangs dran mdzod la/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang nges gsang a ti'i bstan / /srung spel 'dzin pa'i bya ra ma bsnyel bar/ /snying gi gta' ru chongs shig sa ma ya/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni lha gnyan 131

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/mchog khyod la/ /dang pa'i sems kyis chos ldan grogs 'tshol zhing —/ /sku gsung thugs dang gsang ba'i rnam rol la/ /gcig tu bsngags shing gus pas bstod par bgyi/ /khyed cag rdo rje'i tha tshig gnyan dgongs la/ /da dus snyigs lngas gdung ba'i 'gro ba dang —//rgyal bstan de 'dzin bcas pa'i skyes bu la/ /srung skyob ma g.yel bu ltar brtse bar mdzod/ /sngo ser gos kyis bgos pa mda' lnga'i grong //g.yo zol bslu brid mtshon gyis 'gro ba'i srog/rang dbang 'dren byed pho nya dpung gi tshogs/ /don snying lkog mar 'phrog cig lha gnyan rje/ /dam ldan dge ba'i bshes kyi khyu phyungs nas/ /mi dge steg pa'i g.yab mos ljongs 'di yi/ /dam chos dge legs phun tshogs dpal bcom ste/ /ngan 'gro'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye snyam pa'i/ /dga' rab bdud kyis rgyal tshab ltar bsnyes shing / /smon log dbang gi zhags pa grub pa yi/ /sdud byed brtson 'grus brtse bral rgod byung na/ /dpung bcas phye mar 'thog cig dgra bla'i rgyal/ /dgra sde'i 'byung khams me yi dbal tsha yang / /khyod kyi 'phrin las chu yi pho nya ba/ /gnam lo rgyal po zla ba'i blon po dang / /zhag gi dpung bcas za dus mtshon gyis sod//mdor na bdag dang rgyud 'dzin bcas pa la//dngos sam brgyud nas 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor can//bstan 'gro'i 132

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/phan bde bshig la chas pa rnams/ /rgyab rten lha srung mgon skyabs bcas pa'i tshogs/ /'gugs byed pho nya rnon pos myur khug la/ /'ching byed zhags pa nag pos rked nas chongs/ /sdom byed lcags sgrog 'bar bas yan lag sdoms/ /myos byed dril bu'i tshogs kyis myos par gyis/ /rmongs byed tshogs kyis dran pa smugs su chug /rjed byed tshogs kyis shes pa 'phyo bar gyis/ /bstim byed tshogs kyis gzugs dang gnyis med stems/ /dbye byed phra men mgo brnyan rnam gnyis kyis/ /lha srung mgon skyabs bcas pa dbye byos la/ /nyams rid skem zhing 'dar phril mya ngan gyis / /yid la gdung ba'i me chen 'bar bzhin du/ /gshed byed tshogs kyis lha srung gshed phobs la/ /sgrol byed stobs ldan tā ki ra tsā che/ /dmar nag khros pa'i bzhin ras 'jigs ngom nas/rol gri 'bar bas mgo lus dum bur gtub/ /stob byed phyag tshang ging gi pho nya'i tshogs/ /rngam pas stob nyul sha khrag dregs pa'i sder/ /bstabs pas dgyes rol ha ho ki bsa'i sgras/ /stong khams rgyal rtags dbyangs kyis khyab par mdzod/ /dbang byed tshogs kyis nyams pa'i tshe dpal mthu/ /rang rang gzi brjid tshe dpal mthu stobs rtsal/ /gso phyir dgyes dgur rol ba'i 'phrin las stobs/ /srid pa'i khams na zla bral rgyas par mdzod/ /133

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/'dren byed snying rje'i rtsal 'chang chen po yi/ /thugs rje'i bsil rgyun char gyis las nyon me'i/ /nus bcom sgrib bral rnam shes a dkar po'i/ /rnam par skye med bde chen dbyings su 'phos/ /de ltar kun 'byung srid khams rgud pa'i tshogs/ /zhi mdzad pho nya'i 'phrul stabs sna tshogs pa/ /ston cing dam chos mi nub 'dzin pa'i srog /dge 'dun rin chen spel cig bstan srung rje/ /khyod ni rdo rje'i dam gnas dge bsnyen che/ /bdag ni sdom gsum rgyan ldan dam tshig can/ /'u cag rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin can / /bu gcig ma yis brtse ltar rjes chags mdzod/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob srung bya 'khor bcas kyis/ /nyin mtshan kun tu g.yel med khyod bsten na/ /gang 'tsham rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med pas/ /yid la ngoms pa'i lang tsho rgyas par mdzod / /skul lo thugs dam gnad nas skul lags na/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i dpal la rjes chags nas/ /brnags pa'i dgra bo yid srubs dpung gi tshogs/ /skad cig ma 'gyang myur du bsgral bar mdzod/ /gnas 'dir btang snyoms yal yol mdzad pa na/ /rdo rje'i dam ral lhag bsam khur dor bas/ /khyod kyang dge bsnyen bstan srung zol 'chang ba'i/ /g.yo thabs 'phrul gyis brdzus pa tsam du zad/ /de phyir stobs rtsal nus pa'i mtshon rnon 134

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/pos/ /pha rol dgra sde phye mar brlag nas kyang/ /phan bde'i dge legs snang bas sa gsum na/ /don gnyis gzi byin rgyas pa'i bkra shes rgyuskor/ /ces pa 'di nyid don gnyer can 'gas dus snga mo nas nan cher bskul da'ang spyir 'di rigs la dam pa gong ma'i gsung byin rlabs can 'phrin las khyad par ba rnams nub pa'i rkyen ngan dang a gsar mtshar che tsam la dgos pa ci yang mi snang bas yun ring btang snyoms su bzhag kyang slar chu khyi lor skul ba pos yang yang nan tan dang rang nas kyang dgos nus phra mo tsam yod par rtogs te thun mtshams su ci rigs pa grub par bgyis pas 'phrin las myur du 'grub pa'i bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal por gyur cig/sarba maṅga lo/༄cu/ /hrī:snod bcud rnam dag 'od gsal bde chen zhing / /spros med yongs grub dpal chen he ru ka /stobs ldan nag po bstan srung sems dpa' che/ /gzhan dbang yul skyong dregs pa yongs kyi rje/ /kun btags nag po'i rtsa lag sgrol ba'i gshed/ /gnyan chen rmu bdud rdo rje thod pa rtsal/ /yab yum sras 'khor sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /skad cig glog ltar myur ba'i tshul gyis gshegs/ /zag med kun bzang ye shes las 'phrul zhing / /rgya chen sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /'dod 'byung mchod pa mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod/ /dgos dgu ma tshang med pa 'bul lo bzhes/ /khyad par nyams pa zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra /nag po'i rtsa lag bdud sde kla klo'i dpung / /rgyal 'bangs mnga' ris stobs rtsal 'byor ba'i tshogs/ /bstan srung dregs pa'i stuXs

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/kyis bzhes rol la/ /rgyal khams mtha' dbus dge bcu'i snang bas mdzes/ /phun tshogs phan bde'i dga' ston rgya cher 'phel/ /bshad sgrub lang tsho'i gzi 'od kun tu 'bar/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shes dge legs shog /tshog /hūṃ gli/ snang srid rnam dag rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing / /rang rig ngo bo padma thod phreng rtsal//mtshan 'dzin rtog pa skye med rdo rje'i 'phrul/ /'gag med rang shar dregs pa yongs kyi rje/ /dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje thod pa rtsal//yab yum sras blon bka' sdod sgo skyong bzhi/ khyad par gnyan sras rdo rje dgra 'dul rtsal/ /bstan dgra sgrol ba'i las la rab myur zhing / /rnal 'byor dpon slob srung skyob g.yel med lha/ /rno myur thog 'dra gnyan sras dpal chen mgon/ /las byed shan pa sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs //skul lo yid brnags dgra la rings par chos/ /mgyogs pa'i bang dang rno ba'i mtshon ngar bskyed//dgra sde ma lus myur du cham la phobs/ /gtso bos nang 'khrugs dmag dpung nang 'thab thongs / /yul mkhar rang 'gyel rang mtshon rang srog chod/ /mgyogs pa g.yang khar dpa' bo mtshon grir sod/ /dpon 'bangs blo nyes la yog ltas ngan thongs/ /nyin gcig pa sogs 'tsho med nad kyis thobs/ /mdor na nyi mas ba mo bcom pa 136

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/bzhin / /mthu stobs tshe dpal dbang thang gzi brjid bcas/ /bka' srung dregs pa'i za skal nyid du bzhes/ /'jig rten mi bde'i bskal ngan rgyad pa'i tshogs//gcig tu spungs 'dra'i dgra sde brlag par mdzod/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin rgya cher rab 'phel bas/ /mdo smad nor 'dzin phun tshogs phan bde'i srog /yun ring brtan cing skye rgu bde dge'i dpal/ /nam yang mi nub /byi / 'tsho ba yi/ /'phrin las dpal gyi snang bas mdzes 'bar ༄ga/gter srung lha gnyan chen po dgra 'dul rtsal gyi gsol mchod 'dod don kun 'grub dbang gi zhags pa zhes bya ba/༄7/ /hūṃ trī/ chos dbyings mtha' bral kun khyab rig pa'i gshes //lhun grub snang cha 'gag med rol ba'i rtsal/ /lha klu mi yi yul snang bkod pa brgyas/ /'gran mi bzod pa gnyan gyi pho brang che / /sna tshogs rin chen kun brtsegs ba gam rtser/ /stong gsum srid pa'i lha klu mi yi nor//gcig tu spungs 'dra'i rin chen bang mdzod la/ /mnga' dbang bsgyur zhing dgra sde'i gshed ma che/ /dpal chen gnyan sras dpa' bo dgra 'dul rtsal/ /khros pa'i 137

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bzhin la beeḍūr mdangs chags pa/ /gtum byed stag steng zhabs gnyis 'gying rol nas/ /phyag gnyis gnam lcags mda' gzhu dgra la 'gengs/ /sku la bse yi khrab rmog brjid par gsol/ /phyogs bzhir yab yum sras dang btsun mo dang / /lha gnyan btsan bdud klu yi 'khor tshogs bcas/ /kun gsal yangs pa'i khyon 'gengs dmag tshogs rnams/ /rab 'phrul lha mi'i bkod pa las 'das pa'i/ /zag med bde stong ye shes rdo rje'i zhing / /zad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi mnga' dbang can/ /dran rig sems kyi rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /thogs med yud kyis sprul pas 'dir gshegs la//'o phud sman dang 'bru bcud chang gi skyems//dkar dmar zas phud brjid ldan bā ling ta/ /'dod 'byung bsang gi dud sprin sna tshogs gos/ /'phyang 'phrul g.yo ba dar gdugs rgyal mtshan 'phan/ /stong gsum lha klu mi yi phywa g.yang nor / /dgos dgu ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin dang / /nyams pa bsgral ba'i sha khrag nang khrol bcas/ /dngos yid ting 'dzin dag pa'i 'phrul chen las/ /byung ba'i zag med bde bskyed mchod tshogs bzhes/ /thugs dang 'gal gyur gnong pa gzod par gsol/ /snyigs lnga'i dbang gi lha srung rgud pa'i las/ /mna' thab gzhob dang dme yug nal gyi grib/ /myatha' mi'i zas 138

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/nor rdzas sbyor dmod pa'i grib/ /rgyal gdon dam sri rgya 'dre 'gong po'i grib/ /sdom gsum nyams pa'i grib la sogs pa yi/ /grib smugs 'thibs mnol byings pa kun sangs nas/ /mthu nus stobs dpal rdzu 'phrul cher rgyas te/ /ji ltar go lar bgrod pa'i rgyu skar tshogs/ /gling bzhi ri rab yud kyis bgrod pa bzhin/ /phun tshogs rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las 'bad med du/ /bsgrub pa'i gsang gsum dpal yon rgyas gyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bya ra mi g.yel bar / /tshe dang chos dang dbang thang dpal 'byor dang / /snyan grags rlung rta yar zla ltar 'phel zhing / /'khor dang gdul bya nam mkha'i pha mthar brdal/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis dge mtshan rgyas/ /khyad par bslab gsum nor ldan 'dus pa'i sde / /lung rigs dpal gyi gad mo cher sgrog pas/ /phyogs 'di yongs 'gengs snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srol/ /mi nub yun brtan mtha' ru rgyas par mdzod/ /phyogs bzhi'i rgyal phran zas gos nor gyi tshogs/ /ljongs 'di'i dga' ston dpyid du khug nas kyang —/ /sde bzhi'i dpal yon rab rgyas dge bcu'i khrims/ /mi nyams mtho ris them skas brtan par mdzod/ /mdor na bdag dang rgyud 'dzin bcas pa yi/ /chos mthun srung ma mchog tu khyod 139

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bsten na/ /srung skyob mi g.yel gang brtsam thogs med sgrubs/ /dgra 'dre bstan bshig mthu rtsal drag pos sgrol/ /khyad par yid la brnags pa'i dgra sde'i tshogs/ /rgyal 'bangs mnga' ris phyogs su gtogs pa kun/ /yun tu ma 'gyang skad cig la 'ur du / /'phrin las mngon spyod drag pos brlag par mdzod/ /sngon byon rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tha tshig la/ /rang gi pha mes ji ltar gnas pa ltar/ /deng yang rnal 'byor bdag gi tha tshig dang / /mtsho skyes bstan la gcig tu sems pa yi/ /snying stobs ma ral rdo rje'i dam dgongs la/ /'phrin las thogs med sgrubs shig sa ma ya / /zhes gnyan chen rmu bdud rtse dgu'i gnas sgo brag song ge gnam rdzong la gnas rten 'cha' ba'i gnyan sras chen po'i gsol mchod 'di yang grub chen me long rdo rje'i rnam rol gang gis bka' phebs dang rang gi rnam rtog gi phreng ba'i rdzun snang la brten nas rig pa 'dzin pa che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis gang dran shar mar bris pa dge'o//mu / /oṃ āḥ rtsu hri/ skye med dbyings las 'gag med rol pa'i 'phrul/ /thugs rje'i rtsal rdzogs rno myur stobs ldan lha/ /gnyan sras dpa' bo rdo rje dgra 'dul rtsal/ /gzhi las ma g.yos sku mdog sngo bsangs brjid/ /kun rtog gzung 'dzin 'khor 'das yongs sgrol ba'i/ /mnyam nyid dgongs pas zhabs gnyis stag steng 'gying / /thabs shes gnam lcags mda' gzhus dgra srog 'dren/ /spyan gsum glog ltar 'khyug pas stong gsum 140

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/gzir / /zhal gdangs dug khrag nad kyi rlangs pa 'phyo/ /sku la rdo rje'i bse yi khrab rmog gsol/ /'khor du gnyan bdud klu btsan skar ltar 'khrugs//bsam mi khyab pa'i stobs chen 'jigs rung rgyal / /'khor bcas glog ltar myur ba'i tshul gyis gshegs/ /bde stong zag med ye shes las 'phrul ba'i/ /dngos bshams dkar dngar brjid ldan bā ling ta/ /ja chang 'o phud sman raka bdud rtsi'i skyems/ /'dod 'byung bsang dang rol tshogs snyan pa'i sgra/ /khams gsum lha klu mi yi bkod pa dang / /nyams pa'i dgra po'i lnga phung khrag zhag bcas/ /'bul lo dgyes par rol la bdag cag gis/ /gang brtsam rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs / /khyad par rgyal khams dge bcu'i do ra ru/ /phan bde'i dga' tshal mchog la legs 'god cing / /rnam dkar 'phrin las bzang pos mtsho skyes rje'i/ /bstan pa'i rang lugs snang byed rgyal po yis/ /sa gsum skye rgya'i rgyad mun sel ba la/ /snying stobs btsan po'i go cha bgo byed cing / /rtogs pa'i rdzong 'dzin lung rigs mtshon rnon can/ /gang la 'khu zhing gnod pa'i sems ldan dang / /yongs kyi rje bor snyems rlom 'chang ba yi/ /yangs pa'i khyon kun nyams pa'i rkyen slong mkhan/ /yid gnag dgra bo gang du gnas gyur kyang //brgyal nad smyo 'bog mdze grum 141

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/mkhal mchin nad/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gdon dang rims yams phobs/ /gnyen kun dgra sdang 'khor 'bangs ngo log nas/ /nang 'thab 'khon 'dzing nang dme sna tshogs pas/ /'chi tshad grir 'gum mi rung sna dgu yis/ /rdul du rlogs la rjes shul med par mdzod / /sngags 'chang rgyal po'i dgongs bzhed gegs med 'grub / /'phrin las mi 'gong nam mkha'i pha mthar brgal/ /rgyal rtags dbyangs snyan srid gsum lha mis sgrog /rgyal khams bkra shis phan bde'i dga' ston rol/ /bshad sgrub nyi zla'i 'od snang 'bum du brdal/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal sum rtsen pho brang rtser/ /bdag cag lha mi yon gyi bdag po bcas/ /ngal gso 'thob pa'i 'phrin las ma g.yel kye/ /zhes pa 'di rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i rkyen las thol byung du bris pa dge zhing bkra shis la gsang rgya/spro/ /hūṃ trī/ bde stong dbyings las zung 'jug rol ba'i sprin / /gnyan sras dpa' bo rdo rje dgra 'dul rtsal/ /lha gnyan btsan bdud klu dang gnod sbyin 'khor/ /dgyes sde sman dang ru 'dren shan pa'i tshogs/ /skad cig glog ltar myur ba'i tshul gyis gshegs / /'dod 'byung bsang dang brjid ldan bā ling ta/ /dkar mngar 'o phud ja chang rin chen skyems/ /lha klu mi yi gnas yul bkod pa'i nor/ /ma tshang med pa'i 'dod dgu 'bul lo 142

'phrin lasaphya rtsab chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/bzhes / /mi mthun kun sol mi nor longs spyod spel/ /khams gsum dbang bsdus dgra 'dre bstan bshig sgrol/ /snyan grags srid gsum khyab pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /khyad par sngon byon grub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis/ /dkar phyogs skyong la tha tshig gnyan bsgrags ltar/ /rigs kyi pha mes ji ltar gnas pa bzhin/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig srog mdud ma ral cig /snga 'gyur bstan pa mig ltar gces par srungs/ /ltar snang chos brgyad g.yeng ba'i grub mtha' chom/ /phun tshogs phan bde'i dga' ston rgya cher spel/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal bsam don lhun grub mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni rang 'dod ched 'dzin gyis ma bcings pa'i gang zag bstan pa kho na la sems pa'i skyes bu ma gtogs rang don 'khor ba'i bya bzhag la 'bad pa rnams kyi spyod yul ma byi/ /sdo rdo // ༵ /bye de bzhin 'di gnyis shin tu gsang ba gal che zhesadapal ༄7/ /rtsu hrīḥ e yig stong chen 'khor 'das dag mnyam klong —/ /waṃ yig 'pho med bde ba chen po'i rtsal/ /zung 'jug thabs shes mnyam sbyor gnyan sras che/ /dpa' bo dgra 'dul bdud dgra bdud kyi rje/ /klu btsan gnyan bdud gnod sbyin 'khor tshogs bcas/ /sna tshogs 'phrul mtshan g.yo bzhin gnas 'dir gshegs/ /zag med ting 'dzin rol mo'i mchod sprin bzhes/ /'gal rkyen kun sol bsam rgu ma lus sgrubs/ /phyogs 143

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/las rnam rgyal grags pa'i ru mtshon sgrengs/ /nyams pa'i dgra bo mthu rtsal drag pos sgrol/ /khyad par rgyal bstan de 'dzin bcas pa'i tshogs//phan bde'i dga' ston mi nyams gong 'phel zhing //bstan la 'khu ba'i nag phyogs bdud dgra'i sde/ /mthu stobs rdo rje'i mtshon gyis brlag par mdzod/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'bras bzang smin pa'i las/ /yid kyis smon zhing sbyor ba'i rab brtsam dang / /ngag tu smras pa'i lugs gnyis don 'bras gang / /thogs med myur du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mdor na rgyal bstan srog gi ka ba brtan/ /lung rigs dpal gyi gad mos sa gsum g.yo/ /dpal 'byor dbyar gyi chu bo cher 'phel nas/ /sa gsum bkra shes snang bas mdzes 'bar shog /༄7/ /kye rno myur thogs med gter srung che/ /gnyan sras rdo rje dgra 'dul rtsal/ /yum sras mched blon 'bangs 'khor sa/sna / /mchod gsol bstan rgyas dpal 'byor spel/ /chos kyi zla 144

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/dku/ /dgra bla'i rgyal po dpal chen mgon po'i sgrub mchod kyi rim pa phan bde'i glog zhags zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄gi /shrī badzra kro ta hya wa padma kā ra ye/ dus gsum dus med ka dag gzhi dbyings su/ /ma bcos chags bral chags chen rol pa'i gdangs/ /lhun grub mi shigs rol mo'i gdangs 'bar ba/ /gad rgyangs dbang po sa gsum bla mar 'dud/ /de la 'dir dgra bla'i rgyal po 'khor bcas mchod pa la thog mar tshad gnas bzhi'i 'jug pa sngon du song nas/ trīḥrang nyid skad cig gzhi las he ru ka /padma dbang chen dmar gsal gri thod can/ /dur khrod rus rgyan me klong gar dgur rol/ /khams gsum dbang sdud rta skad srid gsum sgrog /ma bcos bcos sgyur bral ba'i rig gdangs las/ /lhun grub phyag rgya rtags kyi sku ru gsal/ /snying po bzla/ de nas mchod tshogs rgya cher spel ba ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ ma hā su kha sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā bā ling ta ma hā rakta gu hya dzñā na badzra a pa bye gundhe dhe pe a lo ke garnye n+ya li de shabha putstsha ho: na ma sarba sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ trīḥ skye med zab gsal bde chen rol ba'i mdangs / /'gag med dpal chen dgra bla'i rgyal po ni/ /gshis lugs gnyug ma don gyi he ru ka /ma chags mi chags chags pa 145

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/dbyings sdud lha/ /'bar ba'i khro rgyal dbang dang dbyer med kyang —/ /chos nyid rtsal las chos can srid pa'i khams/ /legs nyes dbang byed bstan pa srung ba'i slad/ /khyad par mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /gcig tu sems pa'i snying stobs go gyon nas / /phan gnod byed po yul dbang zor dor tshul/ /smug nag ral thod 'khor gsum chas spras shing / /mdung dmar rgyal mtshan grur rten dgra snying gsol/ /ki bswo ha sgras sa gsum 'dar byed bzhin/ /rta mchog cang shes glog 'brug ldem pa bcibs / /g.yas g.yon sras po dgra rgyal mgon po dang / /btsun mo blon 'bangs bka' sdod shan pa'i tshogs/ /skad cig thogs med yud kyis 'dir gshegs la/ /mchod tshogs mdzes sprin dngos yid dag pa 'di/ /dgyes shing bstan dang bdag la 'go phyir bzhes/ /sngon dang mtha' la 'gal 'khrul nyes mchis bshags / /khyed cag rgyal bstan srung spel 'dzin pa yi/ /dam bca' ma ral rdo rje'i dam dgongs la/ /he ru ka pa las rab rtsal chen sogs/ /sngon byon grub pa'i tha tshig ma bsnyil bar/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'phrin las bzang po'i rtsal/ /nam mkha'i khyon yangs brgal ba'i stobs bskyed la/ /'phrin las bzhi dang gang bcol thogs med sgrubs/ khyad par mtsho skyes padma'i bstan pa 146

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skoral / /sgo gsum lhur len bshad sgrub spel byed pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pas dbu byas shing / /bdag dang brgyud 'dzin bu slob bcas pa la/ /gzugs can gzugs med yid ngor sdig grub pa'i/ /gnod sems 'chang dang khas skul lag pas gcod/ /dngos sam lkog nas 'bu bzhin 'jigs byed pa'i / /rnal 'byor bdag la ma nyes dgra byung na/ /dam ldan pho nya'i tshogs rnams dgra la chas/ khyad par gangs ljongs bde skyid la 'khu zhing / /rang sdes ma ngoms gzhan sder glags lta ba'i/ /thub bstan rin chen rmang nas 'don snyam pa'i/ /dbang phyug drag po'i snyems pas 'gying ba rnams/ /gtso dang 'khor du gtogs pa'i sde rigs dang / /bka' nyan mngag gzhug 'gros 'dun gcig pa'i tshogs/ /rgyab rten lha srung bcas pa gshed phobs la/ /zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang da lta ru/ /rlung mkhris bad kun 'du ba rnam bzhi dang / /pho lhog gnyan nad rigs kun de la rgyobs/ /mig 'bras sar 'phongs snying gi dwangs ma longs /mgrin gcus zha rengs lkug pa'i gza' nad phobs/ /yid mug shes pa 'phyo ba'i rgyal nad thobs/ /mdor na mthu rtsal gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog /yid srubs nag po'i rtsa lag la phobs la /de dag rjes shul lhag ma med pa yis/ /'phrin las dge ba'i lo 147

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/tog smin par mdzod/ /mi dang mi min rgya 'dre 'gong po sogs/ /rgyal 'gong dam sri'i 'du tshogs thal bar gtor/ /nyin dang mtshan dang dus bzhi lan drug tu/ /bdag cag dpon slob srung skyob ma g.yel cig /bu gcig ma la gdung ba ji bzhin du/ /dam ldan bdag gi srung mar khyed bsten na/ /tshe dang chos dang dbang thang dpal 'byor dang / kha rje bsod nams rlung rta yar bskyed la / /gzhan sder rgyal rtags rang sder khyad par ston/ /lugs gnyis bya ba bsam bzhin 'grub nus pa'i/ /bkra shis dge ba'i bde legs 'phel rgyas mdzod/ /ces pa'ang bar skabs dgos ched dang bsnan te phran dpal sprul gzhon nu khrag 'thung bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa dge'o//༄7/ /kye dbyings las rang shar dregs pa'i tshogs/ /dgra bla'i rgyal po dpal chen mgon/ /bka' 'khor shan pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /mchod gsol dgra dpung cham pa phobs/ /ces mchog sprul choswā zla bas ṭwāṃ/ ri/ ga 'dzin rtsal 'chang padma thod phreng gis/ /bstan pa'i rang lugs bka' gter chos kyi mdzod/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub sde yis bsten pa'i lha/ /dge bsnyen nor bdag bstan pa gsal ba'i mgon/ /btsun mo blon 'bangs bka' 'khor pho nya'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs gdan bzhugs dngos yid ting 'dzin gyis/ /bskyed pa'i bsang dang skyems phud gtor 148

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/mas brngan/ /bzhes la rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs //khyad par bslab ldan 'dus sde 'phel rgyas brtan/ /lung rtogs dpal gyi nyi gzhon mkhar 'phags te/ /sa gsum skye dgu'i rgud mun rmang gzhil zhing / /phun tshogs lugs gnyis dpal yon rgya chen spel/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal snyan pa'i ba dan sgrengs / khams gsum skye 'gro'i zas gos nor g.yang khug /dgra 'dre bstan bshig ma rung cham la phobs/ /mthu rtsal glog ltar myur ba'i stobs bskyed cig / /kye zag med ye shes mchod pa'i sprin/ /'dod rgu ma tshang med pa 'dis/ /gnyan chen lha yon thod dkar ba/ /'khor bcas mchod do mnyes shing tshim/ /nad gdon dgra jag 'jigs pa srungs//gang bcol thogs med 'phrin las sgrubs// /kye ting 'dzin dngos yid dag pa las/ /byung ba'i mchod tshogs rgya chen 'di/ /khe rtse mched gsum 'khor bcas la/ /'bul lo mnyes tshim 'gal 'khrul bshags/ /rgyal gdon dam sri'i rgyu lam srungs//'phrin las ma g.yel myur 'grub mdzod// /kye nyams pa'i sha khrag srog dbugs mdangs/ /bsang skyems gtor ma'i dngos po ru/ /ting 'dzin 'phrul gyis bskyed pa yi/ /dgos rgu ma tshang med pa 'dis/ /btsan rgod bse khrab 149

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/'khor bcas la/ /'bul lo dgyes skongs rnal 'byor srungs/ /mtha' dmag kla klo'i dpung tshogs thul/ /bstan srung mthu yi dngos grub 465/ / /kye mthun rdzas kun bzang rol ba'i sprin/ /zag med 'dod 'byung mchod pa 'dis/ /pha bong gru bzhi 'khor dang bcas / /mchod do rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ /zas nor gos kyi phywa g.yang stsol/ /'phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod/ /ṭwāṃ kā dīkāng bri ༷sol tshan lnga 'di mkhan mchog gi thugs bzhed ltar 'jigs med chos ༄na /yul lha chen po bse khrab can gyi gsol mchod phan bde'i slog phreng zhes bya ba/༄༄/ /trīḥ chos dbyings rnam dag lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /rig rtsal ma 'gag ye gdangs rang rig lha/ /dpal chen khro rgyal badzra ku ma ra/ /mnyam rdzogs ye shes klong du ro gcig kyang / /kun rtog sprin gyis bskyed pa'i sna tshogs 'gro/ /rang rang las mthun sna tshogs 'phrin las kyis/ /rjes 'dzin thugs rje'i 'phrul mtshan stong 'bar ba/ /btsan rgod chen po rdza yi bse khrab can/ /phyi ltar btsan rje srog dbugs sdud pa'i gshed/ /nang ltar 150

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/dpal ldan bla ma'i sku lha mchog /gsang ba rdo rje phur ba'i bka' srung mchog /ma lus 'khor bcas mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /zhim mngar ro bcud ldan pa'i bā ling ta/ /nyams pa zhing bcu bsgral ba'i khrag gi skyems/ /ja chang phud dang sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra/ /'dod yon zad med dri bzang dud pa'i smin / /dngos bshams yid kyi rdo rje las 'phrul ba'i/ /zag med mchod pa bde chen rgyan du bzhes/ /snyigs ma'i dbang gis dug lnga stobs bdo bas/ /thugs dang 'gal gyur gnong pa bzod par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas //bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun//nad mug mtshon 'khrug bskal ngan mi mthun phyogs/ /las rlung dbang thang nyams pa sor chud cing / /pha rol ban bon bsam sbyor gdug pa'i dbal/ /mthu gtad mnan dang hom bsregs 'phangs la sogs/ /dgra sde'i mtshon kha lha 'dre'i dal kha dang / /stong sde'i mi kha nyes tshogs zhi bar mdzod/ /rgyal khams mtha' dbus dge bcu'i snang bas mdzes/ /phun tshogs phan bde'i dpal kun ngang gis 'du/ /snyan grags lha yi rnga chen phyogs brgyar ldir/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dus ston rgyas par mdzod/khyad par phan bde'i gzhi gcig rgyal ba'i bstan/ /lung rtogs 151

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/srog gi ka ba rab tu brtan/ /ma smad tshul khrims mngon mtho'i ba gam mdzes/ /lung rigs dpal gyi gad mo cher sgrog pa'i/ /bslab ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs rab 'phel rgyas nas/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i lam la mig 'phrul bzhin/ /las nyon 'khrul ba'i grong khyer dbyings bsgral nas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i mchog thob grogs mdzod cig /'gro ba'i phan bde'i dpal la snang byed pa/ /rgyal khams mi mthun sdig pas rab dkrug pa'i/ /mda' lnga'i dbang po'i rdzu la zhugs 'dra rnams/ /mthu stobs drag po'i rtsal gyis brlag par mdzod/ /mdor na dar thang mdo sngags bshad sgrub sde'i / /bstan srung mchog tu sngon byon rig 'dzin las/ /bka' yi yal gam(g.yar dam)ji ltar mnos gyur pa/ /ji bzhin dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya/ /zhes pa'ang kun rtog sprin ris 'phrul gyis bskul ba ltar rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje khrag 'thung bdud 'dul rtsal gyis shar mar bris/༄7/ /hrīḥ ting 'dzin rol ba'i cho 'phrul las/ /zag med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /'dod 'byung dbang lnga tshim byed mchog /'bul lo gnyan chen rmu bdud rje'i/ /bka' sdod sgo skyong sde bzhi zhes/ /gzhon nu ral ba'i lan tshar can/ /shar gyi skyes bu 'khor dang bcas/ /dbang drag rdo rje'i gtsug 'ching can / /lho yi skyes bu 'khor dang bcas/ /dpa' rtags ral gri 152

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/rngam stabs can/ /nub kyi skyes bu 'khor dang bcas/ /rgyas byed nor bu'i mtshan rtags can/ /byang gi skyes bu 'khor dang bcas/ /khyad par padma kā ra yi/ /bka' nyan bstan srung dge bsnyen che/ /nor bdag bstan pa gsal ba'i mgon/ /yab yum sras blon 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do 'phrin las sgrubs/ /khyad par chos sde 'dis mtshon pa'i/ /'phags tshogs bslab gsum rgyal mtshan can/ /phyogs dbus tha grur yongs khyab nas/ /lung rtogs dpal gyi bkra shis 465/ /ces pa'ang mkhan po sogs thugs bzhed can gyi bka'i ngor phran shākya'i dge slong mji'i ming nas bris/༄sto /dge bsnyen nor bdag chen po'i gsol mchod 'dod 'jo'i dga' ston bzhugs/༄gi /na mo gu ru pra gle bha dra ye/de la rin po che bdar phye dang g.yang can gyi spyi rdzas sogs bsres pa'i gtor mchod dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa mdzes gtsang phun sum tshogs pa dang ja chang 'o phud sogs btung ba'i bye brag ji snyed dang / bzang shing gi dud sprin sogs mchod pa'i yo byad mngon par 'du byas la/ sbyangs spel bsgyur ba'i sngags rgyas mi zad pa'i gter du byin gyis brlab ste rol tshogs bcas snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis/hūṃ hrīḥ gdod nas lhun grub bde chen rdo rje'i mkha'/ /zab gsal phra ba'i ye shes chen po'i dbyings/ /brtse chen thugs rje'i bkod pa'i rnam rol brgyas/ /gzugs su 'phos pa'i 'phrul 153

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/mtshan stong 'bar ba//gsung gi rdo rje'i 'od mtshan mtsho skyes rje//shes bya kun mkhyen blo gros mkhyen pa'i gter/ /sngags 'chang rgyal po blo ldan mchog sred rtsal/ /gsang gsum rnam rol dge bsnyen bstan srung che/ /nor bdag chen po bstan pa gsal ba'i mgon / /dkar gsal ston zla rgyas pa'i bzhin ngom zhing / /rin chen khri steng rol stabs lhun chags bzhugs/ /phyag gnyis rgyal mtshan gter bum bsnams nas kyang / /dar dang za 'og banabs shing rin chen brgyan/ /lu thod bcings shing gser gyi snyan cha dang / /mgul du rin chen ga'u phra tshom can/ /sna tshogs ratna'i do shal gyis spras pa/ /'khor du dgyes sde btsun mo blon 'bangs 'khor/ /nyi rdul grangs snyed khyad par 'phrin las kyi/ /pho nya rnam bzhi 'dzum zhal me long can/ /snang srid legs nyes gsal ba'i brda ston mdzad/ /ser mo sgeg gzugs rin chen ne'u le bsnams/ /gang 'dod zas nor gos kyi phywa g.yang 'bebs //khro 'dzum zhi zhal dmar pos chos dung bsnams/ /lung rtogs chos kyi sgra dbyangs mkha' mthar spel/ /mthing nag khros pa ral gri'i 'phrul 'khor can/ /nyams pa'i dgra bo'i mgo lus dum bur gcod//sprul dang yang sprul bsam mi khyab pa'i tshogs//mkha' la rgyu skar bkra bzhin 'dir gshegs shig /sarba dharma pā 154

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/la sa pa ri wa badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ/ trīḥ snang srid rnam dag 'od gsal bde chen klong / /kun btags sgyu ma'i spros pa nyer zhi yang —/ /ma 'gag sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rol pa las/ /yongs shar gzhan dbang bya rtsol las 'das pa'i/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /phyi mchod lnga dang rin chen rnam pa bdun//nye ba'i rin chen go khrab mda' mdung mtshon/ /bzang shing dri spos sna tshogs dud pa'i sprin/ /'dod 'byung bā ling dar zab ja chang skyems/ /dkar mngar 'o phud rol tshogs snyan pa'i sgra/ /lha klu mi yi phywa g.yang 'dod rgya'i dpal/ /ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'bul lo bzhes/ /mi mthun kun zhi legs tshogs dpal 'byor spel/ khams gsum dbang bsdus dgra bgegs gnod byed sgrol/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams dge bcu'i snang bas mdzes/ /phun tshogs phan bde'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ /khyad par ljongs 'di'i mi mthun rgud pa'i dgra /('dir tshig chad)hor sogs kla klo'i bsam sbyor gdug pa'i dpal/ /nyer zhi rang gshed rang la dbab par mdzod/ /bstan pa'i gzhi ma bslab ldan 'dus pa'i sde/ /rgya cher 'phel zhing bshad sgrub lang tsho rgyas/ /'phral yun blang dor legs nyes mi nor 'pher('di 'phel zhes bcos na don dang 'gal bas mi 'thad/ blang dor legs nyes mi nor bar rang rkya 'pher ba'i shes 155

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/rab bstsal ba'i 'dod don gsol ba'i don du go dgos/ )/ /ji bzhin 'byed pa'i shes rab snang ba stsol/ /lung rtogs chos kyi mthun rkyen zas nor gos/ /dkon mchog mchod pa'i yo byad rin chen tshogs/ /snam ras 'bru mar ja dar rkang bzhi'i tshogs/ /'bad med ci dgar rtag tu bstsal nas kyang / /dge legs rnam grol rin chen lam mchog la//brten pa'i tshul mchog bshad sgrub lung bsgrags las / /nam yang g.yel med mthun rkyen lhun grub tu/ /'byung ba'i dga' ston cir yang stsol bar mdzod/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i don/ /ji bzhin 'byed la blo gros thogs med cing —/ /yo ga rnam gsum dgongs bcud mngon gyur ba'i/ /sa mkhan drod 'dzin snying po'i srung ma mdzod/ /de'i mthus chos kyi sgra dbyangs dbyings khyab pas//skal bzang don mthun ngang mo'i tshogs 'dus nas/ /mdo rgyud dbyangs chen tshogs gnyis mkhar 'phags te/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i chu mtsho rgyas par mdzod/ /gang zhig bstan 'gro'i dpal la sdang byed cing / /mi mthun log pa'i brtul zhugs kyis 'tsho ba'i/ /mi dang mi min mtha' 'dre 'gong po'i rigs/ /rgyal gdon shi gshed dam sri rbod gtong mkhan / /gang dag mchis pa rgyab rten sdong zla bcas/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las khyad par drag po yi/ /mngon spyod 'phrin las 156

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/g.yel med mtshon cha yis/ /rjes shul lhag ma tsam yang med par mdzod / /sngon tshe 'phags yul seṅge'i sgra chen gyis/ /lta log mi stegs rigs rnams bsgral mdzad ltar/ /deng yang phan bde'i lang tsho nyams byed pa'i/ /rgya bod hor sogs mtha' mi'i dmag dpung sgrol/ /gangs can spa gro stag tshang dben gnas su/ /bdud dang mu stegs dam sri 'dul ba ltar/ /dpal chen gro lod rtsal gyi skur bstan nas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dbang bsdus la/ /nag phyogs rtsad chod dkar phyogs gzengs bstod de / /bdud dang rgya 'dre 'gong po'i rgyu lam chod/ /mdor na bdag cag yid la gang smon pa'i/ /rang gzhan don gnyis phun tshogs legs pa'i tshogs/ /'bad med ci dgar 'jo ba'i mthu byin gyis/ /phan bde'i dga' ston mi nub rtag 'char bas/ /bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun sde rgyas shing / /bslab gsum rgyud bsdam lung rtogs dpal gyis 'byor/ /mthun rkyen kun 'grub sbyin bdag chab srid rgyas/ /bstan la rab gus srid zhi phun tshogs pa'i//mi mthun nyer zhi tshe dpal mthar son nas//bkra shis dge legs snang ba'i mdzes 'bar shog /4ri /raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥ/ ha ho trīḥ sngon byon rig 'dzin padma thod phreng gi /bka' nyan zab gter bstan pa srung ba'i lha/157

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/khyad par dar 'phyar chu dmar gnas kyi bdag /btsan rgod khro chen 'bar ba spun bdun tshogs/ /yab yum sras blon 'bangs 'khor sum brgya'i tshogs/ /rig 'dzin dam dgongs 'dir byon bsang mchod bzhes/ /'dod don kun sgrubs nad gdon bar chad sol/ /'khu ldog ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /zhi zhing byams pa'i sems kyis 'khod par mdzod/ /mdor na chos ldan bya ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ /dam nyams bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol/ /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs rab spel/ /snyan grags lha yi rnga sgras sa gsum 'gengs/ /dpal 'byor spyabyar gyi mtsho chen rgyas mdzod kye/ /zhes pa'ang 'jam dpal dgyes pas ༄7//hūṃ trī/rang bzhin rnam dag lhun grub 'dus ma byas//'od gsal stong chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ /rab 'phrul lho phyogs rgyal chen 'phags skyes po//dmag dpon dgra 'dul dbang phyug skur ston pa/ /las byed shan pa gri thogs 'bum sde bcas/ /skad cig glog ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis gshegs/ /'dod 'byung bzang shing sman spos dud sprin dang / /ja chang skyems dang brjid ldan bā ling ta/ /dmigs bya'i gzugs phung skye mched nang khrol bcas //'bul lo rnal 'byor 'dod don yid bzhin sgrubs/ /mi 158

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/mthun rkyen zhi tshe bsod grags 'byor rgyas/ khams gsum dbang bsdus dgra sde thal bar brlog /khyad par phyogs bzhi'i mtha' 'dre 'gong po dang / /hor sogs gdug pa'i dmag sde phyir la bzlog /nad mtshon mu ge'i skal ngan zhi bar mdzod/ /dam chos lung rtogs snang bas phan bde'i srog /mi nub yun du brtan byi/ du/ /tshan spel/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis phun ayo//rdo rje drag rgyal ma'i gsol bsdus bdud dpung g.yul rgyal bkra shis don kun grub pa'i nor bu zhes bya ba/༄7//tsū trī bhyo/zab gsal phra ba ye shes dbyings kyi mkhar//'pho med lhun grub bde chen rol ba'i mdangs/ /'gag med thugs rje'i rtsal las yongs shar ba/ /rgyal kun yum mchog badzra wā ra hi/ /rnam 'phrul bcu drug dga' ster pho nya'i gzugs/ /gnod sbyin nor ster dbang mo'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /'phrin las bzhi bsgrub lha mo rnam bzhi dang / /sring lcam zhe lnga rma sman 'bum dang bcas/ /sna tshogs 'phrul mtshan g.yo bzhin 'dir gshegs la/ /dngos bshams 159

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/yid sprul mchod tshogs ji snyed dang / /'dod 'byung bsang dang brjid ldan bā ling ta/ /ja chang 'o phud sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra/khams gsum lha klu mi yi phywa g.yang nor/ /nyams pa'i dgra bo'i lnga phung khrag zhag bcas/ /'bul lo dgyes par rol la sngon byon gyi//rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa'i tha tshig dang / /khyad par mtsho skyes rgyal bas bka' bsgos ltar/ /rnal 'byor dam ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /rtag tu 'go zhing srung skyob ma g.yel mdzod / /mi mthun kun zhi tshe bsod grags 'byor rgyas/ /rlung sems snang ba dbang 'dus dgra gdon sgrol/ khyad par phyogs bzhi'i mtha' 'dre kla klo'i dpung / /gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i phan bde bshig pa'i dgra/ /mthu stobs rdo rje'i mtshon gyis myur bsgral te/ /rjes shul ming gi lhag mar gyur nas kyang / /bstan 'gro'i dpal yon rdzogs ldan dus ltar smin/ /lung rigs snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sa gsum khyab/ /rim gnyis rtogs pa'i 'bras bzang g.yur za bas/ /bde chen rang byung lhan skyes ye shes dbyings / /las nyon 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor zhig nas kyang / /sku gnyis zung 'jug mchog gi rgyal thabs la/ /dbang 'byor bkra shis mi zad dbyig 'jo ba'i/ /bkra shis dge legs snang bas khyab par shog /ces pa 'di bod skyong brtan ma'i nang tshan rdo rje drag rgyal 160

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/ma 'di sger mchod byas na 'phral du dge zhing phugs brtan la las myur bar dam pa mang pos gsungs shing rang gis kyang de ltar nges pa la bstan 'gro'i dge mtshan rgyas pa'i dpyid du smon te rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje khrag 'thung bdud 'dul rtsal gyis bris pa dge zhing bkra shis so//snga / /kye rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /las mdzad rnam bzhi sring lcam zhe lnga dang / /rma sman 'bum tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /ja chang 'o phud bā ling gtor ma dang / /bzang shing sman spos rol tshogs snyan pa'i sgras/ /gsol lo mchod do gzhis byes dus kun tu/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las g.yel med bsgrub pa dang / /zag med bde chen rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//ces khrag 'thung bde ba'i rdo rjes so//༄ga /mdo smad shar bla sgang gi lho rgyud yul lha chen po 'brong ri mig po'i bsang mchod yid bzhin re skong zhes bya ba/༄gi /de la bsang rdzas dang gtor tshogs gser skyems sogs 'du 'os legs par bsags te/ bzang shing sman spos kyi dud sprin mtha' khyab tu spel bzhin rang nyid lha yi sa mā ti las mchod tshogs sbyangs spel bsgyur ba'i sngags rgya bcas rol tshogs snyan par dkrol bzhin pas/ rdu trī/ rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs pad dkar 'chang / /legs ldan rdo rje srin po tsho/rdo1 kyi

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bdag /bstan srung sems dpa' 'jig rten skyong ba'i mgon/ /dregs pa yongs rje 'brong ri smug po'i mtshan/ /mi nag rta nag ber nag brjid pa gsol/ /phyag g.yas tsandan beng dang lcags phur bsnams/ /'khor du bka' sdod chen po lha rtse dang / /dam can sdong ra stag rtses gtsor byas pa'i/ /sras dang btsun mo blon 'bangs shan pa'i tshogs/ /'khor du 'du 'os ji snyed ma lus kun //bsang mchod gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs gsol na//glog ltar myur ba'i tshul gyis gshegs su gsol/ /badzra sa ma ya dza/hūṃ trī/ dngos su bshams dang zag med ting 'dzin 'phrul/ /zad med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin chen po/ /bzang shing sman spos bsregs pa'i dud sprin dang / /dkar dmar 'o phud ja chang rin chen skyems/ /sman gtor rakta sbyor sgrol gsang mchod rdzas/ /lha klu mi yi bdog dgu'i dngos po'i tshogs/ /nyams pa'i dgra bo'i lnga phung khrag zhag bcas/ /dbang po drug gi spyod yul mnyes byed rdzas / /ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin dbyig chen po/ /smugs 'thibs grib mnol sel ba'i mthu ldan 'di/ /dpal mgon tshogs bdag dngos sprul 'brong ri rje/ /sras btsun bka' sdod blon 'khor dpung bcas la/ /'bul lo dgyes bzhes stobs dpal gzi brjid bskyed/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang 162

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/bcas pa la/ /nyin mtshan dus kun bya ra mi g.yel zhing / /bsam pa'i don grub phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /dgra gdon phyer brlag tshe chos dbang thang spel/ /mi mthun rgyad pa'i g.yang sa las sgrol mdzod/ /khyad par snyigs lngas gdung ba'i 'gro ba la/ /ma ltar brtse ba'i thugs kyis nyer dgongs te/ /nad mug mtshon 'khrug bskal ngan phyogs zhi nas/ /phun tshogs phan bde'i dpal la rtag rol mdzod/ /mkhan slob chos rgyal sprul pa'i lo paṇa gyi/ /thugs bskyed skya rengs shugs kyis nyer drangs ba'i/ /thub bstan nyi zla'i sgron bzang la sdang zhing / /rgyal khams phung la sbyor ba kla klo'i dpung / /dngos dang phyogs su gtogs kun la 'ur du/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med rdo rje'i mdas/ /lnga phung phyer brlag don snying dgyes rol te/ /ming gi lhag ma tsam yang med par mdzod/ /gangs ljongs spyi dang mdo smad nor 'dzin gzhir/ /thub bstan mdo rgyud thos bsam sgom pa'i sde/ /mi nyams 'phel rgyas brtan pa'i dge mtshan gyis/ /'jig rten phan bde'i mdzes pa 'bar bar mdzod/ /ces pa'ang gter srung lha mgon chen po'i gnas 'dabs su rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje khrag 'byung bdud 'dul rtsal lam mji nye badzra bas /stan 'gyu la phan pa'i lhag bsam yang dag pas rtse gcig tu smon te bris pa dge lags /sdu/ hū trī/ dpal mgon tshogs bdag ma hā ka la che/ /163

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/yul skyong zo dor bstan srung tshul 'dzin pa/ /'brong ri mgon po yab yum sras 'khor blon/ /bka' sdod sdong ra lha rtse dam can mched / /stag rtses gtsor gyur 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs la/ /zag med kun bzang bsang gi dud sprin dang / /ja chang gser skyems 'o phud bā ling ta/ /lha mi'i nyer spyod 'dod 'byung zad med sprin/ /kun byed sems kyi rdo rje rab 'phrul ba/ /bde stong ye shes rgyas pa'i dpyid du 'bul/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob gzhis gyes dus kun tu/ /srung skyob mi g.yel rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrubs / ('dir tshig chad)rgyal bstan spyi dang snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srol / /mi nyams yun du rgyas pa'i dge mtshan bskyed/ /dngos dang brgyud nas 'tshe ba'i dgra 'dre'i tshogs/ /da cig ma 'gyang myur du dus mtha' stungs/ /rnam kun khyod bsten khyod gsol khyod mchod na/ /gang brtsam don kun thogs med grub pa dang / /tshe dpal grags 'byor mi nyams gong 'phel mdzod/ /ces pa gser stod 'byong ri'i zhol du dpal yul mchog sprul chos kyi zla bas bris pa dge/164

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/spro/ /gnas bdag chen po ri btsan gyi(lha mdo dgon gyi rgyab ri yin)gsol mchod 'phrin las dbang gi zhags pa zhes bya ba/༄gi /na mo gu ru ye/ de la mchod tshogs spyi ltar bsang sogs dngos gtsang rgya cher 'du byas zhing khyad par du gtor ma dkar dmar 'dod rdzas kyis brgyan pa dang rin chen bdar ba'i ja chang skyems phud bcas bshams la 'bru gsum dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel nas 'di skad do/ /skru trī/ chos dbyings brjod bral spros mtha' bral ba'i klong / /lhun grub mtshan dpe'i ri mo 'bar ba'i dpyid/ /'gag med thugs kyi rdo rje tī la ya'i/ /bstan pa srung byed rdo rje'i tha tshig mchog /ral med snying gi go ru rtag 'chang ba/ /klu btsan mtsho sman ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /ma lus thogs med yud kyis 'dir gshegs la/ /dngos bshams yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /dpag med rab 'byams nam mkha'i khams gang ba/ /byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du / /'dod 'byung ma tshang med pa'i rang bzhin mchog / bzang shing dud sprin brjid ldan bā ling ta/ /ja chang skyems phud bdud rtsi sman phud bcas/ /'bul lo sku gsung thugs kyi dgyes pa bskang —/ /mthu stobs nus rtsal yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas/ /nyams 165

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis snying nas bshags/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor 'bangs mi nor bcas/ /mi mthun rgyad pa'i tshogs rnams nyer zhi zhing / /tshe chos dpal grags rlung rta mnga' thang rgyas/ khams gsum skye 'gro zas nor chos g.yang bsdus/ /nyams pa bstan bshig dgra 'dre mthu yis sgrol/ khyad par nges gsang rdo rje theg pa yi/ /snying khung thugs kyi rdo rje tī la ya'i/ /rim gnyis lam mchog phyogs kyi tha grur bdal/ /de 'dzin skyes bu'i bzhed pa'i don kun 'grub/ /'phrin las mdzad pa bstan 'gro'i dpal du smin/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams nad mug mtshon 'khrugs zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal gyi dga' ston la rol nas/ /sa gsum bde legs snang ba'i mdzes 'bar shog / ces pa skul ba po /rshakā kyi ngor rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje khrag 'byung bdud 'dul rtsal gyis bris pa ༄ri /yul lha chen po brag dkar gyi gsol mchod phan bde'i 'od phreng zhes bya ba/༄gi /na mo padma kā ra ye/ de la gtor ma dkar skum rgyan ldan dang ja chang skyems phud bzang shing gi dud pa sogs mchod tshogs 'du bgyis nas rang nyid lha yi sa mā tis mchod tshogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel la/ rtsu trī/ ka dag 166

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/stong dbyings spros mtha' bral ba'i klong / /lhun grub rig gdangs 'gag med 'char ba'i 'phrul/ /thugs rje'i rtsal snang gzugs su 'phos pa'i gar/ /yul la dbang byed zo dor dregs pa'i tshul/ /lha gnyan chen po brag dkar rdo rje 'bar/ /yab yum blon 'bangs bka' sdod shan pa'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs gdan bzhugs dngos yid sngags rgya yis/ /rab 'phrul lha mi'i 'byor ba gtibs pa yi/ /mchod tshogs 'dod 'byung brjid ldan bā ling ta/ /dkar mngar ja chang rin chen skyems phud dang / /bzang shing dud sprin nam mkha' khyab pa'i dngos/ /byed las dbang po drug po mnyes byed rdzas/ /'bul lo sku gsung thugs kyi dgyes pa bskang / /mthu stobs nus rtsal yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas//bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor 'bangs bcas/ /mi mthun rgyad pa'i tshogs las legs skyob nas/ /tshe chos snyan grags rlung rta yar bskyed la/ khams gsum dbang bsdus dgra 'dre bstan bsheg sgrol/ /mdor na ljongs 'dir dge bcu'i snang bas mdzes / /'byung ba bzhi yang dus kyi char ba snyoms/ /mi phyugs nad zhi lo legs 'bru 'phel zhing / /phan tshun mthun gnas ci bsam 'grub par mdzod/ /rtag tu khyod gsol mchod cing bsten legs na/ /cung zad tsam gyis 'grams 'khrugs ma mdzad par/ /167

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/sngon byon brgyud ldan bla mas bsgos pa ltar/ /phan bde'i 'phrin las sgrubs mdzod sa ma ya/ /zhes pa'ang skul ba po rnams kyi ngo ma ldog tsam du 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes gang dran shar mar bris pa'o/ /('di rnyi brag dkar gyi gsol mchod do//)hphu/ /sgrub brgyud bsam gtan chos gling gi rgyab ri gnas bdag chen po dbu rtse zag nag gi bsang mchod 'dod don bsam 'phel zhes bya ba/༄gi /na mo padma kā ra ye/ de la gtor mchod dkar dmar skyems phud dang 'dod 'byung bsang gi dud srin sogs mchod tshogs mdzes gtsang gya nom par bsang ste rang nyid lta ba lha yi sa mā ti'i ngang nas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ mchod rdzas ma dag pa'i dngos po bsregs gtor sbyangs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod tshogs kyi phung po zag med bde chen rgyas pa'i sprin chen rmad byung bdud rtsi'i skyems phud dang dam rdzas brjid ldan gtor ma 'dod 'byung bsang gi dud sprin sogs zad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin dbang po drug gi spyod yul du ma tshang ba med pa'i mchod sprin chen por gyur/ oṃ lha rdu na ma sarba so/rdo sdus byin gyis brlab cing rol tshogs bcas/ hūṃ/ snang srid rnam dag

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings/ /rtsal snang 'gag med lhun grub longs sku'i zhing / /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje padma kā ra yi/ /bka' nyan gnas bdag bstan srung yul lha'i gtso/ /dbu rtse brag nag yum sras mched 'khor 'bangs/ /yul 'di'i zo dor lha gnyan bdud btsan klu/ /dmu shan gnod sbyin srin po'i rigs tshogs bcas/ /ma lus 'khor bcas mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /ji ltar 'os shing 'tshams pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa sna tshogs dang / /zhim mngar ro bcud ldan pa'i bā ling ta/ /rmad byung zag med bde skyed ja chang skyems/ /'dod 'byung bsang gi dud sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /gzhan yang rang rang yid la mkho dgu'i rdzas/ /dbang po drug gi spyod yul mnyes byed pa / /zag med kun bzang rol pa'i sprin chen po/ /'bul lo thugs dang 'gal 'khrul bzod par gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /srung skyob ma g.yel chos mthun bsam pa sgrubs/ /khyad par rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / /bee ro tsā na brtson 'grus rgya mtsho sogs/ /sngon byon rig 'dzin brgyud pas dam bzhag ltar/ /g.yel med sgrub brgyud bsam gtan chos gling gi/ bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun sde 'phel zhing / /bshad sgrub las kyi 'khor lo cher rgyas te/ /rdo rje 169

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/snying po'i rang lugs dar rgyas nas/ /bstan la 'khu ba'i dgra 'dre rtsad nas sgrol/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams dge bcu'i snang bas mdzes/ /phun tshogs don gnyis dpal gyi mdzes pa 'bar/ /dge legs phan bde'i dga' ston cher 'phel bas/ /sa gsum bkra shis snang bas khyab pa yi/ /'phrin las ma g.yel sgrubs shig sa ma ya/ /zhes bsam gtan chos gling gi khri ba rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma smon lam nas bka' bskul ltar mchog sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'am thub bstan 'jigs med chos kyi zla bas shar mar bris pa dge zhing bkra shis/ ('di rgya rong kho drung ngam khog srung dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i gtor chog go//)༄ga /rdzong rmu sde'i gsol mchod bzhugs/༄tsho/ /oṃ āḥ hūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zag med ting 'dzin las byung mchod pa'i smin/ /rmad byung phan bde'i lang tsho cher skyed rdzas/ /bsang dang gser skyems dkar mngar 'o chol tshogs/ /rdzong nag rdo rje g.yung drung bcas la 'bul/ /'gal 'khrul nyams bshags thugs dam gnyan bskang la/ /chos srid dpal 'byor 'dod don lhun grub mdzod/ /ces pa'ang rdzong nang sprul chung 'jam dpal blo gros nas bskul ngor chos kyi zla bas bris pa dge/17༷༅/ /trī bde stong 'gag med ye shes rol ba'i 'phrul/ /

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/thugs rje'i rtsal ldan rtsa gsum zhi dang khro/ /chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs pad nyi bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang —/ /ja chang 'o phud sman raka bā ling ta/ /nyams pa'i lnga phung khams dbang skye mched bcas/ /'bul lo rnam bzhes 'phrin las thogs med sgrubs/ khyad par gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan / /kun gyi gzhi gcig snga 'gyur gsang chen sde'i/ /rang lugs dri med bka' gter chos mdzod che/ /nam yang mi nub yun du brtan pa yi/ /'phrin las bshad sgrub lung rtogs dpal gyi dbyig /ci dgar 'dzin skyong spel ba'i dge 'dun sde/ /sa chen rab 'gengs bslab gsum nor gyis phyug /don gnyis dge legs snang ba'i mdzes 'bar mdzod/ /bstan la 'khu ba'i nag phyogs bdud kyi sde/ /mi dang mi min mthu rtsal drag pos sgrol/ /yangs pa'i khyon kun phan bde'i 'bras bzang la/ /rtag tu spyod pa'i dga' ston mi nyams par/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dus ston rgyas byed pa'i/ /chos srung rgya mtsho'i rnam mang 'phrin las gzi / /rab 'bar theg chen dpal yul rnam rgyal gling / /yun brtan kun tu rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rtsa gsum chos srung spyi la bstan rgyas gnyer gtad kyi 'phrin bcol nyung ngu khang sprul rin po che'i gsung bskul ltar rdo rje che mchog 'dus pa rtsal lam 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rjes shar mar bris 171

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/pa dge /wa baX rsha/sum rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang //bstan srung rgya mtsho nor lha gter gyi bdag /yul lha gzhi bdag bod skyong brtan mar bcas/ /snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang / /khyad par sa phyogs yul ri 'dir gnas pa'i/ /lha klu bdud btsan gnyan srin gnod sbyin rigs//'khor dang bcas la zag med 'dod 'byung rdzas/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul dgyes bzhes sdong grogs mdzod/ khyad par rnal 'byor chos mthun bsam pa sgrubs/ kha char bu yug 'tshub ma'i nyer 'tshe sol//dam log lha 'dre rang gshed rang la phobs/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma g.yel myur 'grub mdzod//ces dpal sprul dgyes rdor bas so//('di mchog sprul rin po che lha sar byon dus gsungs so//)༄7/ /hūṃ trī/ snang srid rnam dag sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ /'bar ba'i sprin chen zhi khro rtsa gsum lha//kun 'dus rgyal po rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang dpal//snang srid zil gnon padma drag po yi//bka' nyan rdo rje'i dam gnas bka' gter gyi/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho ma lus dang / /dbus gtsang khams kyi sbas gnas brgya rtsa ru/ /zab mo'i gter dang rgyal bstan gnyer gtad pa'i//lha klu btsan bdud gnyan srin gnod sbyin rigs//ji snyed mchis la 'dod don gsol ba ni/ /gang zhig phan bde'i 172

'phrin lasakyi chub chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /yun du gnas shing phyogs dus kun spel ba/ /shākya'i sras po khrims ldan ngang mo'i sde/ /spyi dang khyad par dar thang dge bcu'i tshal/ /lung rtogs dpal gyi lding khang yangs pa'i dbus/ /'khor lo gsum gyi rtsibs rnon 'bar ba la/ /kun rtog sdang mig khrag ltar 'khol ba yi/ /ma rung yid kyi sbyor ba rtsub mo'i mda'/ /rab tu bkang nas rang phyogs dpung bran pa'i/ /rgyal gdon yul 'dre shi gshed dam sri dang / /pho gdon gri btsan mo gdon bsen mo'i rigs/ /zung du bsdebs pa'i 'dre gdon rgyal 'gong sogs/ /gzhug mar gnas dang glo bur yid 'gyu ba'i/ /dpung tshogs phye mar thongs la rgyu lam chod/ /rgyal btsan gza' klu'i gdong grib grib gdon rims / /smyo byed rjed nges smugs 'thibs dran nyams sogs/ /'byung pos gtses pa'i sgo gsum nyes pa'i cha/ /rab zhi chos dpal 'byor bas mdzes par mdzod/ /phan tshun mthun gnas bslab pa'i rgyud bsdam zhing / /phun tshogs lung rtogs dpal gyi mtshon rnon can/ /dge 'dun 'dus sde sa yi khyon gtams te/ /nag po'i rtsa lag 'dre gdon rtsad nas sgrol/ /nam yang rgyal bstan de 'dzin bcas pa'i tshogs/ /srung skyob spel la 'khu byed 'byung po'i rigs/ /'gugs bsgral dmed dang rgyu lam gcod pa 173

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/yi / /'phrin las nam yang ma bsnyil sa ma ya/ /las bcol gta' ru gser skyems 'o phud dang / /bzang shing sman spos dri dang 'bru sna tshogs/ /dkar dmar phye dkar phud sogs 'di bzhes la/ /bskal ba'i mtha' bar las bcol ma g.yel mdzod/ /ces pa'ang /sdu ༵༵ kā tā/sad rshakā la brten nas rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje khrag 'byung bdud 'dul ༄7/ /rtsa gsum bstan srung tshogs la gtad khram phyung khrol gyi 'dod don gsol ba 'dod 'jo'i dga' ston zhes bya ba/༄gi /rtsu bhyo dza/ byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang —/ /dngos grub char 'bebs yi dam zhi khro'i lha/ /'phrin las thogs med dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ /zag med 'dod 'byung dpal gyi gtor ma dang / /ja chang 'o phud bzang shing sman spos dri/ khyad par pha rol byad ma'i sha khrag rus/ /'bul lo dgyes bzhes 'dod don thogs med sgrubs/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /pha rol ban bon bsam sbyor ngan pa yis//mnan bsregs zor sogs drag po'i las brtsams dang / khyad 174

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/par klu chen brgyad dang rigs lnga'i klu/ /stong gsum klu gnyan sa bdag gtod rnams la/ /gtad khram bcol ba phyung khrol 'phrin las mdzod/ /de bzhin stong gsum lha 'dre gdon gyi rigs/ /rgyal gshed dam sri bdud btsan bsen mo la/ /gtad bcol chu brag gangs dang shing gnyan dang / /gtsug lag mchod brten lha 'dre'i lam sung la/ /gtad du bcug pa phyung khrol 'phrin las mdzod / /smyo byed brjed nges smugs 'thibs dran nyams dang / /brgyal nad gdong grib zha grum spang gnyan sogs/ /gtad khram bcug las byung ba'i nad kun sol/ /gnod byed byad mar rang mthu rang la bzlog /rang gshed 'phral smin mthu nus nyams par mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus min 'chi ba sogs/ /nad gdon gegs zhi tshe bsod nyams rtogs rgyas/ /rlung sems dbang 'dus dug lnga dbyings su sgrol/ /phun tshogs phan bde'i dpal yon mi nyams par//bstan 'gro'i don gnyis mthar phyin ཿkra dzishis 465/ /ces nyer mkho'i 'dod gsol 'di nyid khrag 'thung rol ba rtsal sa ga/༄/ / /skru bhyo dza/ bka' gter rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /yul lha gzhi bdag sde brgyad brtan ma bcas/ /snang zhing srid pa'i dkar 175

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/phyogs skyong rnams la/ /zag med 'dod 'byung dpal gyi gtor ma dang / /bsang dang gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul bzhes/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod drag po'i las/ /thogs med myur 'grub 'dod don dge mtshan spel/ khyad par bsil ljongs bstan 'gro'i dpal g.yang la/ /'khu zhing gnod pa'i bsam sbyor log pa yi/ /sde dpung rgyab rten sna 'dren bcas pa'i tshogs/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur log spyod sder gtogs bcas/ /skad cig la 'ur me tog sad khyer bzhin/ /dus mtha' stungs la rjes shul med par mdzod/ /sngon byon rig 'dzin brgyud pas bka' bsgos ltar / /lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi gzhon rab 'bar zhing / /gangs ljongs phan bde'i snang bas yongs khyab nas/ /don gnyis 'bras bzang nam yang nub med pa'i/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la rol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa'ang dpal sprul thig le nyi shar rtsal gyis bris pa 'dis bstan 'gro spyi la phan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/yin /rdo rje'i chos srung spyi'i za ngu gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog mda' zhes bya ba/༄gi /shrī badzra kro dha na ma ye/ de la dmar gtor zan ling sha dum dang khrag dang rakta chang gi skyems sogs 'du byas la/ rang nyid bla ma dbang rgyal padma drag po'am 176

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skoradabang chen te ru ga'i nga rgyal bgyis la dgra bgegs 'gugs gzhug bsgral stabs byas mthar sha chen gyi dud pas bdug /mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud/ dar nag gi g.yab mo 'bod bzhin pas/ hūṃ bhyo dza/ rang bzhin rnam dag sku gsum pho brang na / /bzhugs pa'i brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang / /mchog gsum rgya mtsho yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lha klu gzhi bdag sogs/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul stobs la mnga' brnyes shing —/ /legs nyes drang shan 'byed pa'i mthu ldan rnams/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes bdag gi sdang dgra la/ /chos srung za ngur 'bod pa'i dpang mdzod cig /srid gsum phan bde'i dpal ster 'khor los sgyur/ /che ba'i rig sngags 'chang ba padma rgyal / /gdong 'dzin stobs kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i brgyud/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bka' rtags dbang gi rgya/ /gtsug tu babs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal po la/ /'khu zhing 'gran snang gnod pa'i bsam sbyor can/ /spyi dang khyad par smin grol chos kyi bcud/ /ci tsam mnos kyang phyir zhing 'khu ba yi/ /chos dred ru tra'i rgyur song gang mchis dang / /dngos su mdza' ston lkog tu gshed byed pa/ /bstan la rma 'byin dge 'dun nang dkrug dang / /ma nyes kha yog 'bebs dang mthu gtad gshom/ /dmag sna jag sna rkun sna gtong byed pa/ /phan kha sbyin yang gnod kha tshur ster ba'i/ /nyams pa can dang 'jig rten phan bde'i dgra/ g.yul bshams 177

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/'khrugs bslangs mi dang mi min tshogs/ /kun nas rngam pa'i rgya 'dre 'gong po la/ /chos srung rdo rjes rtag tu za ngu gyis/ /ma ning sde lnga trag shad tshogs kyi bdag /mdung 'dzin brag lha glang sna zhal bzhi ba/ /zhing skyong yab yum rta nag dregs pa che/ /gnod sbyin rnam sras lha chen 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /mgon dkar yab yum gza' bdud rdo rje legs/ /'bar ba spun bdun rol ba skya bdun dang / /bdud btsan klu dang rgyal chen sku lnga mched/ /thang lha mkha' ri rma rgyal mi mgon dkar/ /skyes bu ngom rgyal nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal/ /e ka tsā ti ral gcig spyang bzhin ma/ /rdo rje nge nus chom rkun kha mo che/ /srog sgrub dpal 'bar rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ kha le ma sogs bstan srung rgya mcho1) tshogs/ /dmar gtor sha khrag chang dang rakta'i skyems/ /bzhes la nyams pa'i dgra la za ngu gyis/ /zhing bcu tshang na pha khu yin yang rung / /dam las 'gal na rdo rje'i mched kyang rung / /srog la bsdo na rang gi spun yang rung / /ma byams snang na mdza' bshes gnyen yang rung —/ /rtag tu skul mi dgos par za ngu gyis/ /dam rdzas zos pa dug tu bsgyur/ /srung mdud sngags dang zas spyod 'dres/ /byad du cug la za ngu gyis/ /dgra sha za ba'i za ngu gyis/ /dgra snying 'byin pa'i za ngu gyis/ /dgra khrag 'thung ba'i za ngu gyis/ /dgra 178

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/rus 'cha' ba'i za ngu gyis/ /dgra lpags gyon pa'i za ngu gyis/ /dgra nor brlag pa'i za ngu gyis/ /dbang thang 'phrog pa'i za ngu gyis/ /rlung rta rgyad pa'i za ngu gyis/ /bsod nams zad pa'i za ngu gyis / /tshe srog brlag pa'i za ngu gyis/ /dgra bo bdun rgyud tshun chad ni/ /'dam bur me mched ji bzhin du/ /che nas chung ngur ma thug par/ /za ngu gyis la rdul du rlog /dbang skur chos 'chad dam 'dres na/ /dam tshig nyams pa de yi mod/ /rings bar rtags dang mtshan ma ston/ /zas nor longs spyod ci bsres dang /khang khyim yul grong gang brgyud kyang / /de bzhin za ngu 'thung ngu gyis / /byad du cug la rdul du rlog /mdor na bdag gi mngon shes stobs bral zhing / /ngo srung phyir sogs dgra la byams byed cing —/ /bstod dang snyan par smra sogs ci byas kyang / /chos srung rgya mtshos thogs med gzigs pa yis/ /dgra dang mdza' bo phyes la za ngu gyis/ /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi bka' ma gcog /bar du rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i dam ma bral/ /da lta sngags 'chang nga yi skul ma bul/ /'phrin las drag po gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog /nyams pa'i dgra la ma zhan myur bar phobs/ /rgyal bstan nam mkha'i nor bu rab 'bar zhing / /'jig rten phan bde'i 'od snang gsal bar ston/ /don gnyis dpal gyi lang tsho nub med 179

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/pa'i / /'phrin las ma g.yel sgrubs shig sa ma ya/ /zhes brjod nas gtor skyems dgra phyogs sogs gang bder mchod/ ces pa'ang sngar nas bla ma puḥ bibya dzha ra nas 'di 'dra zhig bris zhes bskul na'ang yal yol du lus pa las phyis me yos smin drug zla bar dpal yul dar thang bla brang mgon khang du zla sgrub cig 'tshogs skabs rang nas kyang 'di 'dra zhig dgos par rtogs nas zla ba de'i tshes nyer dgu la rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje khrag 'byung bdud 'dul rtsal gyis gter chen las rab rdo rje'i zab gter gyi tshig la thog mtha' bsnan nas bris pa'o//sa / /tt+waṃ dgongs shig dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter bdag bcas/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs dgongs/ /bdag ni mi shes gti mug dbang gyur pas/ /mchod pa lo zlar 'gyangs shing sgrub pa g.yel/ /sdom pa gsum dang bcas lhung gang byung ba/ /gtsang spra chung dang dam can bkol nyes pa/ /dam nyams grib dang zas dang yo byad sogs/ /bdag gir bgyis dang chos skyong mchod la sogs/ /tshor dang ma tshor nyes sgrib gang byung ba/ /de kun ye shes spyan ldan lha tshogs la/ /'chags so mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /nyams dang rtogs pa dpal dang grags pa dang / /las rlung dbang thang nyams pa yar bskyed la/ /ji ltar mkha' la rgyu ba'i rgyu skar dbus/ /zla mdzes yid 'ong snod bcud rgyan gyur ltar/ /chos srung rgya mcho1) 'phrin las rab gsal ba/ /bstan 'gro'i pa/8 /de'i ku mud bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /gdul khams rgya mtsho'i

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/mkha' la rtag 'char ba'i/ /bkra shis 'gag med snang ba'i snyidzes 'bar shog / yi ge brgya ba brjod/ ces pa dpal sprul dgyes rdor bas pas/ ༄7/ /kye phyogs dus zhing khams rab 'byams na/ /bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs zhi khro'i tshogs/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gnas ma lus dang / khyad par rtsa gsum kun 'dus rje/ /rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang thod phreng rtsal/ /snang srid zil gnon bden pa'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas/ /bsrung bya mi nor thams cad kyi/ /tshe dpal grags 'byor dbang thang dang / kha rje rlung rta dge mtshan la/ /gnod pa'i 'byung po thams cad kyi/ /sgo gsum rdo rje'i mthu yis bshig /phyin chad phyogs 'dir rgyu ba yi / /lam srang rdo rje'i me yis chod/ /bdag cag yon mchod bsrung bya rnams/ /nyin mtshan kun tu 'go ba dang / /srung zhing skyob pa'i lha srung ma/ /dgra bla'i tshogs kyi dbu 'phang bstod/ /grags snyan srid na ldir byed pa'i/ /dgra bla grags bzang dpang bstod do/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /dgra bla don grub dpang bstod do/ /chab srid lhun po ltar brtan pa'i/ /dgra bla brtan byed dpang bstod do/ /mnga' thang yar zla ltar 'phel ba'i/ /dgra bla rgyas byed dpang bstod do/ /mi rgyud chu bas ring ba 181

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/yi / /dgra bla srid 'phel dpang bstod do/ /longs spyod dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba'i/ /dgra bla 'phel byed dpang bstod do/ /'chi med tshe yi dpyid 'dzin pa'i/ /dgra bla 'chi med dpang bstod do/ /nor 'bru dar zab 'phel byed pa'i/ /dgra bla dbyig 'dzin dpang bstod do/ /phyogs bzhi'i dgra khams chom byed pa'i / /dgra bla rtsal ldan dpang bstod do/ /gang brtsam thogs med grub pa yi/ /nor bu dgra 'dul dbu 'phang bstod/ /dgung la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /gangs la seng ge 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /nags na rgya stag 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /sha rkyang ma bu 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /nya mo chu dang 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /rta mchog dar snas brgyan pa bzhin / /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /rmog la rgod 'phru btsugs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /khrab la khrab sham btags pa bzhin/ /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do//gzhu dang rgyud mo 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /mda' la sgro gsum sgron pa bzhin/ /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /mdung la ba dan btags pa bzhin/ /dgra bla 182

'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong sogs kyi gsol chog gi skor/gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /lus la grib ma 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /bkra shis dpal gyis mngon mtho ba'i/ /dgra bla gnyan po dpang bstod do/ /zhes dpang bstod dang /yang / kye dgung la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /gangs dang seng ge 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /nags na rgya stag 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /sha rkyang ma bu 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /nya mo chu dang 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /rta mchog dar snas brgyan pa bzhin/ /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /rmog la rgod 'phru btsugs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /khyab la khrab sham btags pa bzhin/ /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /gzhu dang rgyud mo 'grogs pa bzhin/ /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /mda' la sgro gsum sgron pa bzhin/ /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /mdung la ba dan btags pa bzhin / /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /lus la grib ma 'grogs pa bzhin / /dgra bla mi dang ma bral cig /bkra shis dpal gyis mngon mtho ba'i/ /dgra bla mi dang ma bral bar/ /gzhis byes kun tu chos ldan gyi/ /bya ba mi nub gong 'phel nas/ /don gnyis dpal gyi lang tsho la/ /'gro rnams rtag tu ngal 'tsho shog /(dgra bla 183
hāpa/ bstod 'di ni skyabs rje mchog sprul rin po che'i gsungs yin par gsungs

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/༄7/ /mo su ste/ spang rtogs mthar phyin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /'gog dang lam gyi rang bzhin dam pa'i chos rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun ste/ /mtshungs med skyabs gsum gtsug gi nor bus mchod/ /'phags yul gtad rabs bdun dang 'dzam bu'i gling / /mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /gangs ljongs bstan pa'i shing rta mkhan slob chos/ /sprul pa'i lo paṇa rnams la'ang gus phyag 'tshal / /mdo rgyud bstan pa rgya mtshor legs bshad kyi/ /gru gzings rnam dpyod ba dan gyis bskyod nas/ /don gnyis yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po la/ /rang dbang bgyis pa'i ded dpon yongs la 'dud/ /bka' gter spyi dang sems klong man ngag sde'i / /gdams bcud snying khu thugs kyi dbyig 'dzin cing / /las ldan gdul bya smin cing grol mdzad pa/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i slob dpon spyi la 'dud/ khyad par bka' gter bstan pa'i 'o mtsho legs bshad thur mas bsrubs pa las/ /gdams pa'i zab bcud gcig tu dril 'dra zla bral kuḥhing bstan pa'i srol / /'dzin cing spel ba'i byed por dus gsum rgyal bas bden tshig me tog char/ /gcig tu bsnyil ba shri zhes grags pa'i mkhas grub gser ri'i phreng bar 'dud//186

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/ces mchod tshig nyung ngus mdun drangs te gang gleng bar bya ba ni/ de'ang ji skad du/ mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/ rgyal bstan chu gter 'phel ba'i gzhi/ /dge 'dun chu bo chen po ste/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'jig rten na gnas pa ni de 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun la rag las shing / de yang dam tshig sdom pa la gces spras mig ltar btsa' ba'i steng sde snod gsum la 'chad nyan dang rim pa gnyis la nyams len ci nus su bgyid pa gzhir bzhag nas bstan pa'i sgrigs lam la tshul mthun du gnas pa zhig ma byung phyin mgo med mjug chad kyi cho ga'i gzugs brnyan bca' rdung 'bud dkrol gar thig dbyangs gyer sogs la 'bad khul dang / bya ba las kyi 'khor los 'du long bral zing gi 'tshub chen dang / ltar snang legs pa'i gzi brjid ci tsam bsgrubs shing rgyas na yang don med tshe 'di'i khol po dang / grong sngags gto chog mkhan gyi zla bo tsam las ci bzhin pa'i bstan gzhi dang chos sde'i grangs su mi 'gro bas/ des na so thar gyi rtsa bzhi chang lngas dag pa gzhir bzung nas bstan pa'i bca' sgrigs la gnas dgos pas de yi tshul brjod pa la/dang po gling spyi'i sgrigs khrims ni/ tshes bcu'i zla ba'i tshes drug nas bcu gsum bar kho na ma gtogs gnang chen zhus te 187

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/gnang ba sbyin pa re zung yod pa las/ bud med kyi rigs mtho dman su yang zhag sdod mi chog pa ma zad gling nang du 'gro sdod tsam yang byed mi chog /gnang chen yang dgon du gtan sdod byed mkhan gyi bla grwa gang rung gnang chen ma thob tshe dgon du sdod rgyu mi 'ong la thob tshe gtan sdod byed nges can gyi ma sring lo brgyad cu la nye ba ma yin tshe dang / de yang 'gro sdod sogs mi nus pa'am mi byed pa'i dam bca' ma nus tshe mi sbyin/ mtshams grwa man dang brag mchu yan/ kho sog mchu le tshun gyi nyin srib dgon pa mthong ba'i phyogs phyi nang gang nas kyang bshas ra 'dzin mi chog /gal te bshas tshe sha rin non pa'i chad pa dang /nyo mi yod tshe sha dang rin rtsa gnyis ka 'phrog nges dgos/ chang nyo tshong byed mi gling nang du byung tshe chang dang chang rin gnyis ka 'phrog dgos/ sgrub pa'i rjes 'cham sbyong skor nas bzung ste tshes bcu 'tshog tshe tshun lan gcig dang tshes bcu grol ma thag nas tshes bco lnga'i bar lan gcig dang gnyis sogs rang skal gyi gling bar ma 'phyag tshe ja rgya ma gsum gsum drug chad pa gcod dgos /lo re bzhin khang ba bdag rtsa zhig gso che chung ci yod zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco lnga tshun sor tshud nges byed dgos/ de tshun la ma 'grub tshe chad pa che chung babs rim ltar gcod dgos/188

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/gling bar du rang gzhan sus kyang rta bzhon/ gri 'dogs/ me mda' 'khur ba sogs mi chog pa ma zad bla sprul bstan bdag che khag rnams ma gtogs sprul chung rnams dang bla khag zur pa rnams nas kyang gling nang du rta mi bcib pa dang / de bzhin gling bar du lang long 'du 'tshog dang gtam nyob bshad pa/ shwa rgyan rtsed mo/ ki zhogs ha bgad/ 'bod sgra cher byed/ sham thabs gnyis dkris/ gzan dril gyon/ zhwa gyon pa/ ras kyis mgo g.yogs pa/ dom rwa gyon pa/ sham thabs steng du chab ril ma gtogs gri ring thung dang glo cha 'dogs pa sogs mi chog /zla ba bcu ba'i tshes lnga tshun 'du khang rnams dang / bla brang nang so/'khor khang / mchod rten/ grwa shag bcas thams cad kyi rgyab mdun dang phyi nang med par dkar rtsi dmar rtsi legs par ma grub tshe sa rtsi dkar dmar gnyis log gi rin chad gcod/ phyi nang mdun rgyab phyes nas hral zol brgyabs pas go mi chod/ de bzhin 'khor khang man chad la zhib cha dgos/ gling nang du khyi kha bskor mkhan dang / gling bar du dri chen 'dor ba byung tshe zhes bsher yig tu dmod bcol byas zin pa kun la nges ltar yin pas don chung nyes ma bsdo/ nang so yar mar gyi gra tshang rnams nas kyang tshogs gral gtan nas mi chod pa ma yin phyin gzan 189

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/sham rgyun gyon dang / zhwa dang rna dkris gyon pa sogs mi chog pa spyi lugs ltar dgos/ gling nang du slog pa gyon pa lan gcig byung tshe dngul srang gang gi chad pa gcod dgos/ rtsa ba bzhi chang dang lnga pos dag cing rab byung zhus phyin nas rtsag gos lta bu khyim pa'i rtags spangs pa dang / gri mda'i sbyor ba byed ma myong ba'i dge tshul slong rnams gso sbyong dang dbyar gnas la 'tshog dgos / tshul ldan yin bzhin mtshams dang gling 'dir med pa ma gtogs gso sbyong la thams cad 'tshog dgos/ gzhan ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyi rgyan dang bral zhing bslab khrims la skyon zhugs pa mthong sa su gyur pa dag ni dbyar gnas dang gso spyong gang la'ang 'du chog /gal ) tha tshodakyis 'dur 'ong daskyodangos 'dzin bcas phyir phud pa las tshogs su mi gzhug /dgun bca'i dbu nas bzung dgu gtor mjug bar la ser grangs 'bug mi chog pas lug zla'i tshes brgyad tshun thams cad slebs dgos/gal te ma slebs tshe dgu gtor grol tshe yang dngul srang lnga chad pa dang / zhag chad de ci babs bshar te gcod dgos/ tshes bcu la tshes gcig nas bcu'i bar gsum ser can gyi ser mo gcig kyang ma 'ong na ja rgya phyed bco brgyad dang / gnyis ma 'ong na ja rgya phyed brgyad/ gcig ma 'ong tshe ja rgya phyed gsum dang /190

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/gnyis ser can gyi ser mo gnyis ka ma 'ong tshe ja rgya bco lnga dang —/ gcig ma 'ong tshe ja rgya lnga dang / gcig ser can gyi gcig po ma 'ong tshe ja rgya bcu'i chad pa gcod nges dgos/ bzhi yan chad can rnams kyang thams cad 'ong dgos/ stabs med kyis 'ong rgyu ma byung yang gsum tsam 'ong yod tshe bzhi ser lnga ser lta bu la chad pa med/ snga ma rnams dang khyad par 'cham pa ba sogs las khur can rnams dang / bla ming thob pa/ rgan ming thob pa rnams ni stabs med ji ltar byung yang gong bla sprul mkhan po dge bskos bcas la gnang ba zhus te byin pa ma gtogs chad pa yod nges dgos pas chad pa la 'cham pa ba dang las khur ba ma 'ong tshe gnyis ser gyi chad pa dang / bla ma dang rgan pa ma 'ong tshe sum ser ma 'ong pa'i chad pa gcod dgos/ 'cham pa ba la rkang nad lta bus mi rtsogs nges pa can re byung na ma gtogs bla ma dge bskos dbu mdzad ci yin yang lo lnga bcu ma rdzogs par gnang mtshams med nges pas 'dzom tshad nas 'gag ring spyi 'grig ltar dang / gos stod/ ther sham/ gan 'jar ram gzan phyi nang / 'cham lham/ gos dar sogs 'cham chas yongs rdzogs dang rtse zhwa bcas thams cad bsgrig dgos/ rkang nad lta bus 'cham mi nus mkhan byung tshe dngul bzhi ru gcig gnang ba zhu 191

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/rten bcas tshes bcu'i skabs mang ja dang snyan zhu 'bul dgos/rang chas mi 'dzom mkhan rnams nas rang la med kyang gzhan nas g.yar ba dang gla rngan sbyin pa sogs ci dgos kyang 'cham chas btsal te 'cham mi bshol nges pa byed dgos/ gal te g.yo zol gyis 'cham chas rtsol sgrub ma byas tshe rgyun chas kyis kyang byed bcol ba las rang dgar 'jog mi chog /'cham pa ba ma gtogs pa'i bla grwa spyi nas 'dzom tshad kyis spyir tshar 'gag dang de min yang lpags 'gag legs po gong 'dabs phrug shan can/rgya ther gzan nam phrug gzan/ ther sham/ sgrigs lham/ rtse zhwa rnams tshags su tshud dgos/ de ltar mi 'dzom mkhan gyi bla grwa yongs rdzogs nas gzan sham legs pa/ 'gag ring gong 'dabs shan can sgrigs lham rtse zhwa rnams ni nges par med thabs med pas ngo len 'pher ba dgos/ tshes bcu dang dgun bca' / tshogs res rnams la grwa tshang 'ong ma 'ong / zhag chad mang nyung sogs dge bskos la tsho ser so so nas rogs byas te zhen cha g.yo zol med par rang skal so sor byas te chad pa lo re bzhin tshes bcu'i dus su chod nges dgos/ dus nam yang gling gi phyi rol lta bu ma yin par tshogs yod med gang ltar yang stod skya thog sbyar med pa dang / 'gag skya stod mtha' shan med pa can 192

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/sogs bgo mi chog /khang ba'i thigs sa 'khur ba dang / dkar rtsi 'gyed pa/ zhal ba byed pa lta bu grwa tshang rang rang nas dgos tshe las gang yin de gcig pu'i tshe gzan sham la gnang mtshams yod kyang chu len dang / thal pho/ khang pa bcag rdung / kha ba 'phyag pa lta bu rgyun spyod gang la'ang gnang ba med nges/ de ma zad mtshams la sdod pa sogs gzhan la gtugs 'brel med skabs ma gtogs rang bzhin gyis nang du sdod kyang gzhan dang gdong 'phrad skabs lta bu la gzan sham nges par dkri dgos/ser gral nas bud de khyim 'dzin pa dang / mi bsad pa/ rgyu brgyabs pa sogs jag khram gyi las byas pa/ gzhan yang de mtshungs kyi khyim thabs rtsod sdog byas pa sogs gzhan gyis 'phya smod gshe ba'i rigs rnams slar tshogs su zhugs tshe sngon 'gro nas chos thun la rim zhugs bcas sgrigs bshags byas ma zin par tshogs la mi gzhug /gal te tshogs su gzhug skabs kyang gral smad las mtho sar rab byung ma zhus par sdod mi chog /tshogs la gzhug phyin bya ngan snga ma rnams las ldog dgos/ ma ldog tshe tshogs gral nas phyir phud de gang 'tsham gyi nyes chad gcod pa ma gtogs rang dgar mi 'jog pa nges dgos/ de rigs rnams tshogs la gzhug kyang bla ma dang dbu mdzad 'cham 193

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/dpon lta bu'i go sar dbyung du med/ lar phan chad nas lo re bzhin dam sdom la gtsang dag zhib cha bgyid nges pas bla sprul man mtho dman gang nas ma dag pa byung tshe tshogs chen du mi tshud nges la/ ma dag pa tshab che chung dang mang nyung la dpag nas tshogs gral la gtan nas mi dbang ba dang / zur tshogs tsam la dbang ba bcas rjes bcad/ dbyar ru rdzogs nas bzung dgun du slebs pa'i bar der skor ba byed mkhan skyabs gnas pa ra lug tsam yang med pa lta bu yin na ma gtogs dgon gyi nye 'khor thad dang yan man gang la yang khyim ngan gcig tsam 'jog mi chog pas srib brag rdzong man dang brag mchu man gang bder 'bud dgos/ dgun yang dgon thad tshal shing man dang mchod rten nye 'khor mtshams khang dang dgon gyi bar gzhung du sdod pa dang mchod rten gyi nye 'khor du bcar ba sogs dang /'khor khang la bcar che ste lam klad du 'bud nas sdod pa sogs zhag shas las mi sdod pa'i skor ba byed mkhan lta bu yin yang mi chog na gzhan tshong pa dang ru ba lta bu ga la chog ste mi chog nges so/ /gling nang du sdod pa'i tshong pa sogs mgron po su yin bcar yul des go brda sprad nas 'gro shul du rdul dang thal ba rwa dang rus pa rta zog gi lud sogs med thabs mgron 194

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/po'i mgron bdag sus byas kyang gtsang dag byed dgos/ ma byas tshe las 'dzin rnams nas rtsad gcod gang babs kyi chad pa chod nges dgos/ phyogs nas 'ong ba'i bla grwa rigs la dgon pa'i grwa che chung mtho dman sus kyang brnyas bcos ming 'dogs 'phya smod sogs yid sun du 'jug mi chog /lha gnyer rnams nas kyang lha khang rnams la wa kha thigs tshags byas yod med dang / gra kha dang gra rdo yod med dang / thigs chu sogs 'ong ma 'ong dang las tshags zhan tshe las de sogs dang / rol khang lha rgan lha gnyer dang / thab chen steng gi spyi ba gnyis bcas nas bdag rtsa dgos pa la de bzhin gnad smin dang / 'khor khang rnams dang mchod rten bcas grwa mang nas las tshags zhig gso byed dgos/lha khang rnams bla brang che chung so sor sngar bkod pa bzhag ltar zhig gso dang lha gnyer la gla ster rgyu sogs thams cad so so nas gang babs ltar mdzad dgos/ gling 'dir bzhugs kyi grwa tshang spyi nas dam sri'i gnyen po dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i bsnyen pa rgyun khyer yi dam du bzung nas rab dri med bshags rgyud/'bring brjod med don bshags/ tha na'ang dus gsum bde gshegs ma dang yig brgya nyer gcig bcas rang gi kha 'don dang dge sbyor gang byed kyi khar nyin bzhin mi gcod pa'i dam 195

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bca' dang / rnam pa kun tu sgo gsum chos dang ci mthun gyi dran shes bcas lung rtogs bshad sgrub kyi bya ba la ci nus su brtson pa gal che/ bsrung bya'i bslab sdom la ci mi snyam par spyod pa ci byung chol rnyog tu song ba khyim pa rgan po dag las ches thal ba re zung sngar nas yod pa tshos rang tshod ngos zungs la bslab ldan dge 'dun gzhan dag las dman sa 'dzin pa ma gtogs lta log phal cher ltar ngag nas zab mo'i rtogs pa yod rlom gyis kha pho dang nga rgyal bskyed pa de 'dra mi byed rang nyams la phan tshod kyi dge sbyor gang drag re la brtson nas thams cad la dag snang mos gus zhe thag pa nas bskyed pa gal che/gnyis pa tshogs kyi sgrigs lam la nar ma'i rgyun tshogs kyi sgrigs lam gzhir bzhag gi steng du dus mchod rnams de las zab pa dang / de las kyang rgyas pa tsam ma gtogs gzhi gcig pas rgyun gyi tshogs sgrigs kyi tshul zur gsal ltar la/ kha skong thor bu'i rigs ni/ 'don bcol che chung ci 'ong dge bskos dang spyi ba bcas nas mnyam por lta rtog dgos/ dbang dang bsnyungs gnas dung yon rnams ma yin pa'i ngo thog sha bgo rnams la mtshan tho bris nas 'don mi rang rang la 'bab dgos/tshong zog nang phan tshun du spus 'jog byed mkhan yod kyang rin 196

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/rtsa lag thog der sbyin pa ma gtogs kha phar skor tshur skor byed mi chog /dung yon ci yin yang dung yon gsung mkhan rang rang la 'bul skal dung yon phyed dang / dgon spyi'i phud sgor dbang dgos rgyu yin pas mkhan po dang dge bskos bcas thams cad nas gzigs te dung yon phyed 'jog /'on kyang dgon klad kyi sku don du gong rim nas zhal bkod gnang ba ma gtogs dge bskos dang spyi ba nas gang bsam la spyad mi chog /rjes nas bla sprul grwa tshang dang bcas pa la snyan zhu dgos/ dung yon nyin bdun ring mi gcod par 'tshog dgos/ /dkor spyi la yar zhu ba dang dbyar gnas skabs zhal ta mi 'pher ba'i rigs 'jog mi chog dkor spyi rnams nas lo re bzhin sngar srol ltar phrug gi gdan ring legs nges re 'jog dgos/ mi 'jog mkhan byung tshe rgyu mtshan zhi drag gis rtsad gcod dgos/ 'bag gnyer gyi za sgo tshes bcu la dngul srang do/ dgu gtor la ja rgya lnga/ bsang brngan la ja rgya do/ zhing sgrub la ja rgya do/ 'das mchod la ja rgya do / dbyar gnas la ja rgya do rnams yod pas de dag gis ca ka sprod len zhib tshags kyis bcag pa dang bor ba sogs la ngo 'dzug bcas rang sor tshud nges dang / rgyun par yang thigs pa sogs kyis nyams nyes 'gro min la blta rtog byed pa gal che 197
