dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/zhing 'bag khang lde mig ci byung gzhan la gtod pa sogs mi chog /mkhar rnga ba la 'bul ja zla re la ja rgya gang / dge phrug rnams la glog bslab pa'i dge gon la dbyar gnas ma gtogs pa'i 'don bya gzhan ci 'ong gi skal ba tshogs la ma zhugs kyang yod /dge phrug rnams 'don pa shes rim bzhin yig rgyugs blang ste 'bul skal rdzogs par thob min dpyad de zhib cha bya/ 'di sogs 'bul skal yod med bcas thams cad zhib par dge bskos kyi lag 'dzin zur gsal ltar byed dgos/ sgrub pa sgrub chen lta bu'i tshogs chang dang thod chang sogs gsang ba'i rdzas med thabs med skabs la der mkho nges kyi chang thod phor lnga man chad phab chog kyang de las mang ba dang a rag gtan nas mi chog /gzhan mgon bla dang / dbu chos/ dbang bla/ lha gnyer/dkor spyi/ nor rdzi sogs za thang skal lhag don thob them yig nang 'khod phyag tham 'byar ba can ltar gzhi bzhag la/ rang bzhin za 'dod bzang ngor dar gcig kyang sbyin mi chog /deng phan dge bskos nas grwa tshang nang 'khon pa lta bu byung na dang /spyi khag che chung rnams kyi don ma yin pa'i phyi nang gi gyod che phra gang la yang gzigs mi dgos/ bstan pa'i bca' khrims phyi nang thams cad la nan tan gzigs pa mtha' 'khyongs nges dgos 198

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/pas gzhan mtho dman sus kyang gyod 'khon bar bzhugs bcol mi chog /de ltar sgrigs lam gang bzhag la bla grwa yongs nas rang rang gi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'phel ba'i rgyu dang bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan du mthong ba'i lhag bsam khur du bzhes te spang blang 'dzol med mdzad pa bka' drin mi lhod pa dang de dag gi klad gzigs mkhan po dang do khur dge bskos nas mdzad dgos pas thugs khur yal yol du ma song ba sgrigs yig 'di'i nang 'khod tshad mkhan po dang dge bskos gnyis kyi khur thang yin la/ khyad par dge bskos nas nga bzang gi khog yangs dang mdo med kyi yal yol dang / khyod bzang gi ngo la mi 'jog par thad kur gang babs kyi zhal nag bkyon pa rdeg rdung bcas tshab che chung ji 'dra dgos pa dang / gong smos ltar gyi chad pa rnams bcas lag len la dus mi 'dzol bar thebs nges gal che/mdor na sgrigs yod dang med/ dam dang lhod kyi dge mtshang mkhan po dang dge bskos gnyis la yod cing / gzhan su la'ang med pas bstan pa dang mi ngo / bla ma dang bstan bshig mi brje bar zla re bzhin sgrigs yig 'di tshar re bton nas khur ba pos ma 'khur na bstan bshig zer ba re zung yod kyang gnon pa pos ma mnan na bstan bshig zer ba med pa gal che bas de 199

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/bzhin gnon pa po dang khur ba po yongs rdzogs kyi thugs la nan du bzung nas spang blang mi 'dzol par tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa gal che gal che/ de ltar bca' sgrigs kyi rnam bzhag chos dang mthun par cung zad brjod pa 'di rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che 'jig rten na yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir dang —/ bstan pa la zhugs par rlom kyang bstan pa'i rnam bzhag mi shes pa'i bstan pa dang bya spyod rgyab 'gal du gyur pas bstan pa'i nyams rkyen du song ba rnams la snying brtse bas log pa'i bya spyod rgyun chad de tshul mthun bsod nams kyi tshogs sdud cing 'phel ba'i lhag bsam kho na las rang 'dod kyi bsam pa ci yang med pa mkhyen ldan ye shes kyi spyan can rnams la mngon sum du gyur pa lags na/ de bzhin brjod pa'i tshul dang mthun par rang don du ngo shes nas bstan pa'i bca' sgrigs dang mi 'gal bar legs par spyod cing gnas pa dang / de bzhin mi byed par chos dang bla ma la dbang za zhing khyad du gsod pas dge 'dun gyi nang dkrug cing dam sdom rtswa ltar bor nas sgrigs 'gal gtong zhing bka' blo mi bde ba dang / dngos dang brgyud nas bstan pa la ci gnod byed pa bcas dam nyams khrims 'gal gyi rigs so sor stangs phyes te tshul ldan la srung skyob 200

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/dang —/ dam 'gal la bka' chad 'bebs par rdo rje'i chos srung spyi dang yul lha gzhi bdag bcas la dpang du gsol ba lags na de bzhin gyi 'phrin las g.yel med rtag tu mdzad nas gsang chen snying po'i rang lugs nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/dge'o//༄ga/dbyar gnas par bstsal pa'i bka' slob/༄7/rig pa dang grol ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu la mnga' dbang 'byor ba'i 'dul 'dzin 'dus pa'i sde rin po cher tshul mthun gyi zhu 'os cung zad zhu na/ deng sang dus ches snyigs mar gyur pas phyogs mtha' dbus kun tu bstan pa la gnod pa'i 'dre rgod ma rung ba kha dar zhing / de dag gi mthu las nag phyogs gdug pa'i dmag sde'i dpung gis phyogs kun khyab cing /bstan 'dzin 'dus pa'i sde phal cher yang rang dbang mi thob gzhan dbang du shor ba'i rkyen bstan pa la tshul mthun kyi mdzad pa rgyun 'khyongs su gyur ba shin tu dkon mod/de lta na'ang da lta dbyar tshul la bzhugs ste bstan pa'i gzhi ma 'dul ba so thar gyi phyag bzhes gtsang dag bstan nas rang rgyud legs par sdom pa ni/ dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ ji ltar lo tog rnams ni sa la 201

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/ni / /brten nas skyon med pa ni skyes gyur ltar/ /de bzhin tshul khrims la brten chos dkar mchog /snying rje'i chus brlan pas ni rnam par skye/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rang rgyud la rnam grol gyi yon tan gong 'phel dang skye ba'i gzhi dang / slob dpon dpa' bos/rkang ba'i bkra shis gyur ba'i rdul dag kyang / /spyi gtsug dam pas blangs shing lha dang mis/ /phyag 'tshal mgo gtugs 'thob pa kun tu khyer/ /de phyir tshul khrims dang ldan rig mchog yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha mi'i mchod gnas byed cing thar ba'i sa bon thebs pa dang / so thar las/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen sgron/ /'bar ba'i snod ni dka' thub can/ /gsungs pa'i dngos bstan ltar lags pas shin tu dga' dad kyis rang la de lta bu'i tshul mthun gyi tshe mthar phyin pa'i thugs dam mi g.yel zhing 'chal tshul gyi dri mas ma gos ngos slad nas kyang gzhi gsum gyi las la 'du bar snying thag pa nas thal mo sbyar de zhu'o//de ltar ma yin par/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ khyim pa skya bo'i gos gyon la/ /ngas ni bslab pa gang brjod pa/ /de tshe dge slong de dag la/ /bslab pa de yang med par 'gyur/ /zhes dge bsnyen khyim pa'i gos can gyis bslab pa'i gzhi tsam yang med pa'i dge slong dang / dge tshul de rab byung dge 'dun gyi las la 'dus 202

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/nas dad pa'i sbyin pa la lhan gcig bgo skal du spyod pa ni/ tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa'i mdo las/ lcags kong me lce 'bar ba dag /zos par gyur ba ches sla yi/ /tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pas/ /yul 'khor bsod snyoms za ba min/ /gsungs pa'i don ltar dang / lung rnam 'byed las/ gang zhig ston pa thugs rje'i bstan pa la/ /yang bar sems shing cung zad 'da' byed pa/ /de ni de las sdug bsngal gzhan dbang thob/ /snyig tshal bregs pas a mra'i tshal nyams bzhin/ /zhes dang /'di na gang zhig rgyal po'i tshig chen las/ /'das nas lan 'ga' chad pa thob mi 'gyur/ /thub pa'i bka' lung tshul min 'das byas na/ /dud 'gror 'gro gyur e le'i 'dab klu bzhin/ /gsungs pa'i don ltar rang rgyud brlag par gyur pa dang / dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/ la las tshul khrims bde ba yin / /la las tshul khrims sdugs bsngal yin/ /tshul khrims ldan pa bde ba yin/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba sdugs bsngal lo/ /zhes gsungs pas gal te kho bo ni sngags kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'o snyam pa dang rab byung yin yang sngags la spyod pa'ang ltung pas mi gos snyam na'ang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ skye ba 'di la tshul khrims nyams/ /de la grub 203

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/pa mchog med cing / /grub pa 'bring bo yod min te/ /grub pa tha ma yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / legs grub las/ tshul khrims 'chal la thub dbang gis/ /sngags 'grub par ni ma gsungs te/ /mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba yi/ /yul dang phyogs kyang ma yin no/ /byis pa ngan pa 'di la ni/ /sngags bsgrub par ni ga la yod/ /sogs mang du gsungs pa'i don ltar yin pas re ba dang 'bad pa don med pa las 'os ma mchis so/ /de lta bas na tshul khrims yang dag pa'i mdo las/ dge slong dag srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni sla yi/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni de lta ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni skye ba 'di nyid kyi tshe zad par 'gyur gyi/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni skye ba 'bum phrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde ba spangs te rnam par lhung ba chen po nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa rgyas par gsungs pa'i don ma srung pa'i nyes dmigs dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ bskal ba bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /dang pa'i sems kyis zas dang skom rnams dang —/ /gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i phreng pa yis/ /sangs rgyas bye ba phrag khrig rim gro byas/ /gang gis dam chos rab tu 'dzin pa dang / /bde gshegs bstan pa 'gags par 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /204

pha na bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa/ /bsod nams 'di ni de las ches khyad 'phags/ /zhes bslab pa la gnas nas srung ba'i phan yon la bsam pa'i sgo nas tshul 'chal gyi dri ma'i cha tsam gyis ma gos pa la 'bad pa ni rab tu byung ba rnams kyis brtson pa'i gzhi yin pas de ltar thams cad nas spang blang tshul ldan du mdzad par cis kyang lan brgyar zhu'o/ /des na skabs kyi grub don bstan pa la rab tu byung bas tshul khrims kyi bslab gzhi yang dag par blangs kyang rang nyid dran pa rnal du mi gnas pa'i lhung ba byung ba'i sgo bzhi las lhung ba byung ba dang /gzhan rkyen gyis ltung ba che rigs byung ba phal cher mchis srid pas de dag nas de 'dra yin par rang blo lkog tu ma gyur bas shes nges bzhin du de mtshungs gzhan la mngon te rgyal khams nas thams cad kha zer ba yod pa'i rigs dang / de ltar min yang chu skyar las ni chur shes dang / /du ba las ni mer shes ltar / /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan ni/ /rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ /gsungs pa ltar mtshan ma las shes pa'i phyis su de 'dra gcig kyang dbyar gnas dang gso sbyong la mi 'du ba gal che/ de bzhin rab tu byung nas skya bo'i gos gyon pa dang /bo'u 'khur ba dang / phub mda' 'dzin pa dang / bshas tshong 205

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/byed mkhan rnams ni de phan dge tshul slong gi gral du mi 'gro la gral du mi tshud nges can yin/ ma zad rab byung ma zhus par mthang sham dang / chos gos dang / snam sbyar gyon pa dang / sngar rab byung yin yang tshul khrims nyams zhig gyur rjes gos mthang sham dkri ba sogs rang rgyud nyams shing bstan pa'i che ba nyams pas las de 'dra byed mi chog /de mkhan po nas kyang ma brtag ma dpyad par zhus tshad la rab byung gi bslab gzhi 'bogs pa sogs ma mdzad na legs so/ /(zhes pa'ang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na skyabs rje mchog sprul rin po che rdo rje 'chang thub bstan 'jigs med chos kyi zla ba bshad sgrub 'phrin las rab brtan dpal bzang po'am 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje gang gi zhal gsung ngo//)ayo /sku mdun yid bzhin nor bu'i 'grig yig zur bkod du gnang ba bzhugs so/༄7/ /dbyar gnas bca' yig dkyus ma'i nang du ma 'thus pa'i phra rim gsar bkod la/ tshogs gral du zhugs nas phyin chad mkhan po dang / dbyar bdag /zhal ta ba bcas nas kyang do gal che nges kyis don rtsa can dbyar gnas kyi rnam bzhag la phan pa lta bu sogs re zung yin na ma gtogs rang 206

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/gzhan gyi gtam brjod la tshogs mang bcas thams cad nas shub bu tsam gyis sgo nas kyang mi byed par ngag mtshams shin tu dam par bcad dgos/ mchod pa sogs gang gi tshe yang rdor dril dgos rigs la'ang / rdor bsor dang / rdor yol/ rdo rje nang 'dren/ rdor sgril/ rdor skor bcas/ phyag rgya/ dril 'dzin/dril 'khrol/ dril pang/ dril gdan du 'jog pa dang / maṇḍal dang shis brjod lta bu sogs nas 'thor dgos rigs thams cad dang / phyag thal mo sbyar ba dang / 'dud rgya bcas thams cad gcig la gcig ltos kyis 'grig dgos pa las snga phyi dang gang byung du 'jog mi chog /de mtshungs rol tshogs thams cad kyang rnga log dang / dung log /gling bu la tsir sgra/ rdor dril 'grem sdud kyi tshe thams cad la sgra 'khrol ba sogs/ tha na bsnyen bzlas kyi tshe phreng ba bgrang ba la'ang gzan zhabs nas dal bus sgra med par 'dren pa las sgra bcas mngon tshan can mi chog na gzhan mchod cha sogs sgra cher sgrog mi rung ba lta ga la zhig /ja mchod skabs kyang thams cad nas phyag gnyis kyis zhal bu 'degs pa las sar 'jog pa sogs mdor na rang rgyud dran shes kyis bsdam nas bstan pa'i sgrigs lam la nan tan mdzad dgos / gal te de dag las 'gal ba dper na nas 'thor ba snga 207

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/phyi can dang / lag ha cang g.yob ches pa/ ngag mtshams lhod pa/rdor bsor skabs rdor yol/ nang 'dren skabs rdor skor/ thal sbyar 'dud rgya/ thal sbyar skabs thal sbyar mi byed pa lta bu dang /ja mchod kyi tshe rang gral du slebs nas zhal bu mi 'degs mi len pa dang / gzan rgyab nas 'dor ba dang / 'don pa'i skabs dpe lta byed pa sogs gong smos kyi dgag bya thams cad dang rdor dril 'grem sdud kyis sgra 'khrol na 'khrol mkhan len pa po dang/ gtad pa po gang yin na de ma thag gral mjug nas phyag gsum re 'tshal dgos pa sogs chad las sgrigs 'gal thams cad la rigs 'gre yin pas rang bca' mdzad rogs dgos/'on te shes bzhin du sgrigs phyag mi phul bar rgod 'dug byed mi yod tshe mkhan po dang dbyar bdag gnyis bcas nas chad las tshul bzhin byed bcol dgos pa las rang dbang der 'jog mi chog /ma zad bza' btung dang spyod lam gang gi tshe'ang dal bus sgra bskyung ba la nan tan du bslab pa las tsham tshom ma brtags pas sgra cher mi mdzad pa bcas dgag bya che long de tsam dang / sgrub bya thos bsam sgom pa'i bya bas dus 'da' ba'i thugs rtsol g.yel med ngos bshad rgyugs la tshogs rgyugs babs rim bzhin dang 'don rgyu'i blo rgyugs sogs do 208

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/nan mdzad dgos pa'i de lugs thugs 'dzin zhu/ slar smras pa/lhag bsam dpyid kyi rgyal mos bos pa'i mgron/ /legs bshad sprin gyi glang po'i sgra dbyangs 'dis/ /tshul gnas blo ldan rma bya'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /spyod lam dag pa'i gar phreng g.yo bar shog /des mthus chos 'dul rin chen nyin mo'i mgon/ /zhing 'di'i mkha' la mi nub rtag 'bar zhing / /skye rgya'i tshogs kun snang ba der 'jug nas/ /zas gtsang sras po'i rjes su snyegs gyur cig /rgyal ba nyi ma mchog ni mtshan dpe'i 'od stong zer gyis legs par spras/ /dam chos nyi ma mchog ni sdug kun mun pa'i srog shing snyel la dpa'/ /dge 'dun nyi ma mchog ni bslab gsum dpal gyis kun nas mngon par mtho/ /mchog gsum nyi ma dam pas phyogs kyi mu mthar rtag tu mdzes 'bar shog /ces rab tshes sa pho rta lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi la bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag khang thub bstan chos snang 'khyil ba ru thub bstan 'jigs med chos kyi zla ba bshad sgrub 'phrin las rab brtan dpal bzang pos legs par sbyar ba 'dis kyang legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba rin po che'i bstan pa 'di phyogs kyi khongs su khyab pa'i rgyur gyur cig/༄7/ /oṃ su ste/ bde legs su gyur cig rmad byung thugs bskyed mchog gis zhi mtha' las grol phan bde'i dpal sbyin zhing —/ /mtha' yas mkhyen pa mchog gis srid pa kun la spros pa mi mnga'i thugs/ /yongs bsngo'i smon lam mchog gis 'bad 209

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/brtson nyer zhi'i rtag khyab 'phrin las can/ /snyigs ma'i 'dren pa mchog gyur lha mi'i bla ma shākya'i sras la 'dud/ /phul byung mdzad pa dpag med 'od phreng can/ /bde ldan zhing mgon rgyal ba tshe mtha' yas//rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mchog gyur rig pa 'dzin//dpal ldan padma kā ra dus 'dir dran/ /brtan g.yo'i chos kun bde chen mchog gi dngos/ /'khor 'das bzang ngan spang blang ma grub pa'i/ /lhun mnyam dag chen rol ba'i shes rab can/ /kun bzang bla ma'i zhabs sen gtsug na mdzes/ /zab zhi spros bral thugs ni mkha' ltar khyab cing bsam brjod bral/ /'gro la rjes brtse'i mkhyen pa nyi ltar dag cing gsal 'grib med/ /rmad byung mdzad pa'i char rgyun bstan 'gro'i srog sbyin kun la snyoms//gdod ma'i mgon po mi yi zol can bla ma mchog des shis pa stsol—/ /mnyam med drang srong mchog gi rjes zhugs shing / /drang po'i lam la bsam rgyud drang ba yi/ /lha mi'i yon gnas mchog gi tshul lugs ni/ /mdor bsdus brjod la snyan dbang gtod par zhu / /de la 'o cag mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes 'jug zhig yin phyin tshe 'di'i steng sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnas dgos te/ chos dang mthun pa'i don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bstan pa yang mdor bsdu na/ ji skad du/ sdig 210

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par bya/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /gzhan gyi sems ni dkrug mi bya/ /zhes pa ltar sdig spang dge bsgrub kyi sgo nas rang sems 'dul zhing gzhan sems mi dkrug cing phan pa bsgrub pa kho na la 'dus pa yin la/ bstan pa de la 'jug pa'i go rim yang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi zhal snga nas/ ston pa'i bstan pa rnam gnyis ni/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin pa ni smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'jug dgos pas rang 'khos la ci yod kyis spong klog la brtson pa ni rgyal bstan spyi yi sgrigs lam yin la/ bstan pa de yang brgyud pa'i babs srol 'phags yul du grub mtha'i 'dod lugs kyis grub mtha' smra ba bzhi dang / mkhan po'i phyag bzhes kyi khyad par las nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad sogs yod la/ bod 'dir gsang sngags 'gyur snga phyi'i dbang gis gsar rnying gnyis dang / nyams len phyag bzhes kyi sgo nas sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad yod pa las/ rang re gangs can pa'i bstan pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas gsang chen rnying ma ba'i sgrigs lam gyi dbang du byas na yang / dpal chos kyi rgyal po padma sam bha wa bod du sku 211

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs nas lho nub srin yul du byon par bzhed pa na/ bstan pa spyi yi bcad yig tu bzhag pa ni/ zhal them rin po che gser gyi phreng ba las/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma 'dul ba la/ /ji ltar nus bzhin tshul bzhin srungs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom dang don sems pa'i/ /bstan pa'i bya ra ched du 'khur/ kha chos ne tsor ma song bar/ /zhe chos rang rgyud dul bar mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gnas dgos pa yin la/ yang sgos su dgon gzhi sa cha'i bye brag las bod yul 'dir yang dbus khams gnyis su grags pa las/ khams lugs pa ni/ mdo khams gnas chen nyer lnga'i ya gyal 'phrin las gnas lnga'i gtso bo naḥthog rdo rje gdan zhes tshe lus gcig gis 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku mngon du byas pa 'bum phrag tu brgal ba byon pa'i sa la spyod pa'i 'og min gnyis par grags shing mdo khams phyogs kyi bstan gzhi thams cad kyi yang mes su gyur pa'i bstan pa'i 'byung gnas chen po de nyid kyi bstan 'dzin rim par byon pa ni / dam gtsang byams gsum dang / bla rabs bcu gsum/ drung rabs bcu gsum du grags pa rnams kyi khrod nas drung rabs bcu gsum pa drung pa chos nyid rgya mtsho'i dngos slob/ lang lab rgyal ba'i byang chub dngos snang rje rig 'dzin kun bzang shes 212

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/rab kyi gdan sa chos gzhi dpal yul rnam rgyal byang chub gling gi bstan pa'i sgrigs lam phyag bzhes kyi dbang du byas na yang /bstan pa'i bdag po de nyid kyi sdom gsum bstan pa'i sgron me las / sdom gsum gru gzings rim gnyis ba dan rtser/ /sgo gsum yengs med brtson pa'i rlung shugs kyis/ /rang gzhan 'khor ba'i srid mtsho las bsgral zhing / /thar lam rin chen gling du son byed yin //zhes pa ltar gzhi sdom pa gsum la gnas shing lam rim pa gnyis la nyams len gyis don gnyis bsgrub dgos par gsungs pa'i zhugs tshul gyi go rim yang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam pa dang / /sgom pa'i don la yang dag sbyor/ /zhes dang / rgyal tshab ma pham pas/ dang po 'di la tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / /tshul bzhin('di the tshom)yid la byed las yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / /zhes pa ltar/ dang por tshul khrims yang dag pas rang rgyud legs par bsdams nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen las bstan pa yongs rdzogs la thos pa 'tshol zhing / thos don bsam pas gtan la dbab nas nges pa 'drongs pa na/ de nyid sems rgyud dang 'dres par byas nas dam pa'i chos kyi don sems kyi bdag nyid du rim gyis pa dang cig char du skyes par gyur pa las yang dag 213

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/pa'i yul can gyi rnam mkhyen 'byung par gsungs/ de ltar na dang po rig pa'i gnas lnga spyi dang khyad par nang don rig pa gsang chen rnying ma'i bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa dang / mngon pa gong 'og /byams chos sde lnga/ rgyan nyi bden gsum/ bslab spyod / sa sde/ tshad ma mdo dang sde bdun sogs rgya 'grel dang /sdom gsum/mdzod bdun/gsang snying la sogs la gsan bsam dang —/ yang sgos su sngon 'gro chos bcu dang / gnam chos rtsa gsum / ratna'i thugs sgrub zhi drag tsam gyi bskyed rim dmigs khrid sgrub pa'i lag len dang bcas pa dang / gnam chos gtum mo /gegs sel/ thig le'i 'phrul 'khor sogs kyi go ba lag khrid dang bcas pa dang / khyad par du rdzogs chen sangs rgyas lag 'chang gi khrid yig 'bring bo ltar sngon dngos rgyab chos/ sgra mi/khra mun/ zhing khams lnga stong sogs kyi go ba lag khrid dang bcas pa la gsan bsam mdzad pa dang gcig /spyir sor byang sngags gsum dang / khyad par du so thar gyi dge bsnyen dang / dge tshul /dge slong sogs rang gis gang blangs pa'i sdom pa'i bcas mtshams las mi 'da' zhing / khyad par rab tu byung ba'i rtags phu rung can ma yin pa'i gos sham thabs dang gzan sogs dus rgyun du rang lus la bgo bar bya ba dang gnyis/ gzhi byes grwa sa 214

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/la bzhugs tshad kyi ser mo ba rnams nas chos thun gsum gyi go ba rgyugs 'phrod nges dang / sbyang bca' 'bum lnga dang / 'pho ba/ro za'i bsnyen pa dang 'phrul 'khor/ 'bru gsum rdo rje'i zlas pa nas rnal dbab yan zhag tshad dang bstun pa'i sbyang bca' gnad smin dang / dngos gzhi'i sems don la rgyun du zhun mthar chod nges dang / sgra sbyong dang rmi lam gnyis kyi sgo nas bogs dbyung zhing / khra mun gnyis kyis mngon sum don gyi 'od gsal gtan la dbab/ zhing khams lnga sbyong gis 'phro thub nges su byed pa sogs chos thun thams cad gnad smin du 'gro bar bya ba dang gsum po 'di chos rgyud 'dir zhugs rigs rnams kyis mi bsgrub thabs med yin nges so/ /khyad par du dgun bca'i tshogs sgo rnams la yang thog mar dgun bca' mgo zla ba ste hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad la bca' zhugs thams cad zhal 'dzom pa dang de nyin bla grwa rags bsdus kyis zhi bsang btang ste rgyal tho 'dzug cing tho mtshams mthong rgyud ltar dang —/ 'dus spyi nas rgyal bka' rin po che gsung sgrog sogs kyis mtshon sna sel gyi rim gro rnams bsgrubs nas de phyin bca' sgrigs tshul mthun yong dgos pa'i bkod pa dge bskos dang tsho ban rnams nas zhib gzigs kyis btang snyoms le shor du ma 215

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/song ba dang / bca' zhugs pa rnams nas kyang rnal 'byor rang bca' mdzad de bla mgo'i rigs rnams nas bsang gsol chu sbyin gsur bcas dang / 'dus spyi nas rnga dung ḍa dril ting shag sogs zhib par rtsis bzhes 'pher ba mdzad do/ /de nas nyin bstar chags su tho rengs thun dpon gyis dung brdas bskul ba na 'dus pa thams cad nas dung 'bud de gos tshags grub pa dang —/ gti mug gnyid skyog dang / nus pa stobs 'byin/ rnam 'joms / lo gyon ma/ skya rengs 'phrin gdab/ nyi ma bcas gtong —/ de nas thun dpon gyis rnga brdas bskul ba dang thams cad kyis dkon mchog spyi 'dus rnga rdung gis gsung / bsnyen pa tshe sham bcas grub nas 'od chog dang / sman chog /gnam chos rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang yang 'dus bcas bton grub nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang thun la 'jug /skya rengs tha ma 'char dus gnam chos chab gtor dang 'dzam dkar chu sbyin gtong / de nas lag ris mthong ba dang thun grol te rnga brdung gis dgongs 'dus skyabs 'gro dang yan lag bdun pa/ maṇḍal so bdun ma bcas pa'i mtshams der me gtong / lhung bshags tshar gsum dang —/ thub bstod/ sku gsum gsol 'debs/ spros bral bde chen/tshes bcu'i gsol 'debs/ mi 'gyur rdo rje nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i 216

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/bar gyi gsol 'debs rnams dang / dgongs zangs dang phyag chen skye med ma bcas 'don/ de nas rnga brdung gis bsang bsdus tsam dang gur drag me 'khyil 'don tshe spyan 'dren byas te ḍa dril dkrol/ bsnyen bstod grub pa dang nyi mas de'u mgo dros dus snga thun bsdam/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dbyangs bcas dad mos kyis yid 'gul bar bya/ de nas thun bcad/ snga thun grol dus rnga brdung gis tshig bdun spyan 'dren dang bzang spyod yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal bcas dang / bsam lhun/ bar chad lam sel/rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ bde stong spros bral/ gnam chos thugs chen bcas 'don/ de mtshams nas me gtong / phud mchod bcas gung tshigs bzhes/ phyi thun sdom dus bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang thun bskyang / thun grol dus yang 'dus kyi yan lag bdun pa mchod bstod bcas mthar lho nub rnga yab ma dang / bag chags rang grol/ rtsa tshig /btags grol/ bshags chung / sgrol bstod/zab mdo tshar gsum bdud bzlog bcas bya/ de nas rnga brdung gis gtor bsngo gtong / seng gdong yang ḍa dril gyis 'don/bar 'dir bde smon dang / bzang spyod/ byams smon/ smon lam rkang gnyis ma yan grub par bya/ nyi ma thal zin dus gtor bsngo bdud rtsi kun khyab rnga brdung de bya/ de nas gsur gtong / nyi ma 217

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/dmar thag chod dus gcod dung skabs thams cad bzhengs la ma ṇi pad dbyangs tshar bcu dang / dgongs gsol bzhes/ dung 'bud skabs thal deb bcas/ rnga sgra dang bstun nas gtor bsngo dang —/bskang thung / mchod bstod/ mtha' bsdu byas mthar bdag gzhan ma gtong / nub ba chung dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus tsam dang / thun bskyang / srod la thun grol dus ḍa dril bcas gnam chos kyi gcod gtong / sangs rgyas bstan pa dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ ro za 'don/ rlung dang 'phrul 'khor ma grub kyang dmigs pa rgyun khyer bskyang / rlung bum chen ci rigs dang rdor bzlas bya/ gzim brda'i rjes su rmi lam gsol 'debs gdab/rdor bzlas/ mi lam bzung ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas 'od gsal gyi ngang la nyal/ de ltar nyin mtshan khor yug tu sgo gsum g.yengs lam du ma song bar dge sbyor gyi 'phrang la gcun te dal 'byor don yod bya ba dang / gzhan yang zer gnyis kyi dus su sku gsum bzhugs stangs gang rigs kyis thod rgal la sbyong ba dang —/ chos sgor thog mar zhugs pa rnams nas kyang bskyed rdzogs la blo ma 'byong yang dus rgyun bsam pa bzang pos chos spyod rigs dang / phyag skor/ maṇḍal/ yig brgya/ yig drug bgrang ba dang / dge ba gzhan don du bsngo bar mdzad pa dang / nyin 218

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/gong thun grol nas rnga dang dung gi brda dang bstun te thams cad kyis grwa chas gsar ba spus legs ma 'dzom kyang rnying ba hrul po phyag dar khrod kyi gos las med kyang rung btsun chas dang ma bral na rang nyid dge 'dun pa'i nang du zhugs pa'i rtags dang / dge sbyong gi dran pa gso zhing dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa sogs dgos pa mang zhing / khyad par du gos ngur smrig gi tshal bu tsam 'chang ba'i phan yon sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs dang mdo sde rnams nas gsungs pa ltar thugs la bcag nas gzan sham gang 'dzom legs par bgos nas spyod lam zhi dul gyis dran shes dang ma bral bar 'du khang du phebs te gral phyag bcas tshogs gral du drang por bzhugs shing zhal 'don gyi rigs ngag 'khyal sogs kyis ma sbags par sgrigs 'don mdzad / thun skabs rnams su grwa gsar rigs nas rang lugs kyi sgrub chog sogs kyi dbyangs rol dang / gar thig gang dgos sbyang dgos shing / 'di dag gsang sngags thabs kyis che ba yin pas sbyang ba'i blo kha phyogs pa tsam la'ang so thar gyi khrims srung ba las phan yon don gyis che ba lung rigs kyis grub pa yin na bla bgres bsam shes rnams nas kyang sbyang brtson la skul dgos/bca' thun dang phyogs kyi ched gtugs su 'ong ba'i mi rnams tho 219

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/nang du mi tshud cing thun ma grol bar 'phrad mi chog /thun nang nag 'bur/ dgag thug /rgyu 'grul/ dung gtong ba sogs mdzad mi rung / dgon du ku co 'bod pa sogs 'ur zing mi gtong /'thab 'dzing lta zhog bskal bar bsags pa'i dge rtsa 'joms par byed pa'i khong khro yin pas shin tu zhi bar gnas/ bla ser rnams dgon nang bzhugs dus gzan sham cha tshang dang / khyad par tshogs kyi dus su na bza' cha tshang med par 'tshog mi chog /tshogs de'i ring phyag 'tshal ba las gral nang du zhugs mi chog /dgun bca'i skabs mang ja gtong dgos/ gsar zhugs sngon 'gro ba yin dus gzan sham 'gag ring med rigs sgo shub nang bzhugs dgos/ dgun bca'i thog las tshan dang / nang chos/ bla rgan dgongs zhus 'dra med tshe su ma 'tshog na brgya phyag re chad pa yin/ bsnyungs gnas rdor dril gdan bcas dang / thos grol skabs ḍa dril med par gral du mi tshud/ tshogs ja yod skabs sgrigs zhal dang tshogs khug yod dgos/ bca' ba'i skabs su thun nang skya ser su yin rung rgyu 'grul byed tshe las tshan rnams nas rdo 'ded dang rdung rdeg byed dgos/ dgon nang brda ma btang bar grong nag lta bur 'bod rgyang bya mi rung / gal te ki 'bod byed mkhan yod tshe de la skad lan sbyin mi chog /skya bo gri 220

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/drangs mkhan yod tshe skad brda sprad nas ma nyan na gri 'phrog /grwa gsar lo gzhon rigs nas 'don rgyugs dgos/ rnga dung bsang khang sogs rtsis bzhes 'phrod nges dang / khyad par du grwa khang la dkar rtsi byug pa de bstan pa'i mig rgyan yin pas khang bdag grwa ba de shi song ba zhig yin na ma gtogs kun nas lo nar mar byug dgos pas las 'dzin dge bskos kyis de yi ngo tshags mdzad de gzigs 'bul sprod dgos/ de ltar ma byung tshe rgan 'dus 'tshog nas rgyu mtshan gsung dgos pa las rang dgar mi bskyur / dus nam yang bud med dang chang gi bca' khrims 'di shin tu dam pas ma dang sring mo jo mo sogs su bsnyad pa'i bud med rigs las bkol lta ci tho nang tshun la mi tshud/ 'di rigs tshul bzhin 'ong ba'i kha dan rgan pa dge bskos tsho ban las tshan so so nas gnon pa pos ma mnan na bstan bshig dang /khur ba pos ma 'khur na bstan bshig yin pas chos las rnams nas blta nyul khrims 'gal byung na nyes tshab che chung dang bstun pa'i chad pa 'bul srol mchis kyang 'dir rnal 'byor rang bcas khyab pa'i dbang du byas/ de ltar dgun bca' zla ba phyed bzhi'i dbang du byas te hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gsum la rgyal tho gtang rag gshegs gsol gyis bsdu zhing bca' ba grol/221

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/dbyar bca' sa ga zla ba ste hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes brgyad la tho 'dzug /hor zla bdun pa'i nyer gsum la grol ba sogs las gzhan dgun bca' ltar la/ bca' nang du phyogs su mi 'gro ka med byung tshe dgongs zhu 'bul/ dgongs zhu de zhu mi yis mi zhu gnang mi yis mi gnang thabs med yin na ma gtogs gnyis ka 'gal tshab can yin no/ /de bzhin du dgon pa zhig gi grwa tshang yin phyin dus rgyun du grong gto la mi 'grim par dgon du bag pheb ngang bzhugs pa ni shin tu gal che/ gzhan yang tshes bcu dgu gtor sgrub mchod sogs dang / khyad par rang re rnying ma pa rnams kyi nang gses kyi chos lugs ni/ rgyal bstan spyi dang snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi gzhung rnams la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis zhugs dgos pa khyad med na'ang gter chos 'don cha mi 'dra ba re dang brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes kyi dbang gis maḥdapal zhe rdzogs sogs su bzhag pa'i phyir na bla grwa gsar ba rnams nas rang rgyud sbyong phyir phyogs med du thos bsam mdzad mtha' ma bkag mod/ gzhan du na gsar nges dang dbang yod kyi sgo nas chos lugs bsgyur ba dang / phyag bzhes brje ba/ thugs dam dkrug pa/ tha na na bza'i bzhes lugs tshun chad rang lugs dang 'gal bar byed mi chog nges can dang / gal te de ltar byed 222

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/mkhan byung na rang thad nas bla slob kyi 'brel 'dun med nges steng slob ma dam log de rtsa gsum chos skyong dang bcas pa'i 'phrin las drag po'i yul du bgyid nges pa dang / gzhan yang bslab pa nas 'babs pa dang nyams pa sogs ni bstan pa'i rma 'byin che bas spyi srol gyis chad gcod sogs tshab gang che gtong / bstan pa spyi yi sgrigs srol ltar gar thig dbyangs rol gyi las tshan ci zhig bsko bzhag phyin dang len gyis rang gi rnam dpyod dang bstun pas lhod med bsgrub pa las ngan mgo 'khur ba sogs mdzad tshe 'di phyi'i chos dam las 'gal ba gzhir bcas nas 'di rigs la rang phyogs bsam shes dge rgan dang bla bgres kun nas rang bca' rang khrims mdzad dgos pa sogs mdo khams dbus gtsang gsum gyi chos sde chen po'i grwa sa bya mig gyen bltas rnams la bzang nges yar 'dren mdzad na rang rang la'ang 'di dang phyi ma la gtan gyi bde ba thams cad 'bad med 'grub cing / khyad par du phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur 'gyur la/ de ltar min par ngan pa 'dus nas bzang po sun phyungs ma rabs thams cad kyi ngan des mar 'dren khyi thog khar bzhag pa lta bu byas tshe rang yang 'di phyi phung 223

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/la sbyor zhing rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rma 'byin pa'i 'jig rten gyi bde legs thams cad myur du 'grib par 'gyur bas na de ltar gyi khe nyen bsam nas blang dor ma nor ba mdzad na rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'phel zhing / de'i mthus spyir mkha' khyab sems can thams cad dang sgos su phyogs 'dir bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis 'tsho zhing / mthar thug rnam mkhyen bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob par nges na de ltar mdzad par kun nas dgongs dbyings su zhugs par zhu zhu/smras pa/ lhag bsam zla gzhon bzhus pa'i lang cho'i rgyun/ /legs bshad 'di yis phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i khyon/ /cher snyigs mun pa'i phung po drungs phyung nas/ /rdzogs ldan dpal gyi snang bas mdzes gyur cig /khyad par 'khor lo gsum gyi dpal yon can//dge 'dun 'dus pa'i chos kyi 'dun sa rnams/ /bslab gsum rin chen mchog gi bstan pa'i sgrigs/ /lhod med snying la 'chang bar lan brgyar smon/ /bstan pa gcig tu sems pa'i lhag bsam dang / /chos la 'dun cing bla mar brtsi ba rnams/ /mthu ldan srung mas bya ra mi g.yel zhing / /chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa'i dpal stsol cig /gzhan du bstan la 'khu ba'i glang snying can / /chos dang bla mar sdang ba'i dam log la/ /chos skyong rnams 224

phan bde'i rtsa ba bca' yig gi skor/kyis 'phrin las drag po'i dpal/ /'beb par gsol na brgyud pa'i tha tshig dgongs/ /bkra shis gang zhig lhar bcas 'gro ba'i dpal / /bkra shis phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bkra shis rin chen gsum gyi nyin mo'i mgon/ /bkra shis snang ba'i dge mtshan 'bar gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang rgyal ba'i lung gis bsngags pa'i gnyan chen rmu bdud rtse dgu zhes dpal chen sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi pho brang gi nub phyogs/ dpal chos kyi rgyal po padma sam bha wa'i chos skyong pa'i dge bsnyen mu le sha med kyi yul gru/ lo tsā ba bai ro tsā na dang lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas kyi cha shas dpal dar thang mdo sngags chos kyi dga' tshal nas rgyal ba dpal yul ba'i chos khri'i khur 'dzin bcu gsum pa chos smra'i gzugs skyes dpal sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rol mo zhes bgyi bas rang lo nyer gnyis pa bskal pa shing yos lo'i stag zla'i tā// hā/sdu //dri shā ṭī / // /pal mos 'khyud pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'grub sbyor la 225

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/de yang mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad las/ rma rol dang / smar rol/ rdo rol/ zla rol sogs su gtso bor chags pa'i lcags mo mgo log pa 'di dag yongs grags ltar na phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i mjug ste bod rab byung bdun pa tshugs ma thag tsam la khams 'gu kho lung nas gnas spo byas te/ da lta'i mgo log padma rdzong gi sa cha gtso bor gyur ba'i rdo 'dzi smar gsum gyi yul gru bdag gir byas nas ring du ma song ba na/ mgo log phag thar gyi sras su maḥthog bla ma byang chub seng ge'i thugs zin gyi slob bu mkhas shing grub pa'i bdag nyid chen po mgo log bla ma chos 'bum bya ba 'khrungs pas dbu bzung / rim bzhin gar rnying bstan pa'i sgron me kurma yongs 'dzin chen po dang / zhwa nag sku phreng bcu ba mchog sprul chos dbyings rdo rje/ bcu gcig pa chen po ye shes rdo rje/ zhwa dmar bdun pa ye shes snying po/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i yang sprul de ma thag pa mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje/ zhe chen rab 'byams lnga ba kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs gangs can bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag chen por gyur ba dag dang / gzhan yang 226

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho/ grub pa'i dbang po gtsang ba byams pa chos 'dzin/ smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi nyin byed phyag mdzod byams pa gsung rab/ sman rgyal g.yu thog gnyis pa lha rje stag bla nor bu/ lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po gyi lung sras po sku mched / rtsod rigs smra ba'i seng chen 'gya ba a lags mdo sngags/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po khra dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas/ yongs 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros/bstan pa'i nyin byed a rig dge bshes chen mo/ gsang chen bka' babs shar yod grags pa bzang po/ mdo rgyud smra ba gyang sprul don yod rdo rje/ nges pa don gyi paṇḍi ta sku phyogs shing bza' sku phreng / rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa/ rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba'i mkhan chen a skong blo bzang rdo rje/ theg mchog smra ba'i bka' babs kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo sogs mkhas dbang nor bu'i phreng ba zam ma chad par yul 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'am dus yun ring por bzhugs te mdzad phrin rgya cher bskyangs pa dang / dgon gnas dang dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde dag smra ma dgos/ khyim pa sbra nag pa dag gi khrod du'ang yig 227

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/tshang lo rgyus gleng ba'i dge thon cing / dpe gtam sgrung rgyud 'chad la mnga' brnyes pa/ dkar nag rtsis kyi 'phrul la thogs pa med cing / gso byed sman gyi lugs la dbang 'byor ba/ ri mo dang yi ge'i bzo rtsal la mdzes byang gi cha khyad du thon pa sogs mang du byung 'dug par brten de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rig gnas kyi shul bzhag tu gyur ba par ma dang bris ma'i glegs bam du byas pa'ang da lta'i bar mi nyung ba zhig bzhugs yod pa la/ spyir grub mtha'i dbang du byas na yul 'dir snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge ldan pa/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba sogs bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha' che rigs phal cher zhig mnyam gnas su bzhugs shing / sa bab kyi dbang du byas tshe'ang mdo khams lho byang 'brel mtshams su chags yod pa sogs kyi dbang gis yul 'di'i rig gnas spyi dang dmangs khrod kyi rig gnas tshun chad la mdo khams rig gnas ma lag gnyis ka 'dres pa las byung ba'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod par brten/ myur skyob dang zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi'i rin thang 'gangs che ba zhig yod par gdon mi za/de'i phyir spyir bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi 228

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/bya bzhag la rang ngos kyi nus shugs 'bul ba dang / sgos thun min rang khyad thon pa'i sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag myur skyob dang dar spel byed pa'i kun slong gis bskul te/ nged las khungs nas 'tshol bsdu sgrig gsum gyi bya ba yun ring spel mthar dpe rnying mi nyung ba zhig lag son byung ba las bdams pa brgyud/ (mgo log sa khul mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs〉zhes pa zhig bsgrigs nas rim par dpe deb skor zhig par du skrun par rgya che'i klog pa po dag gi gdeng 'jog legs po dang 'brel yod sde khag gi gzengs bstod thob/ rting skul de dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng krung go'i grangs nyung mi rig gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun te nga tshos rim pa sngar las spags te/ slar yang mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉kyi par skrun jus gzhi gsar ba zhig bzos nas khul srid gzhung dang 'brel yod mgo khrid la yar zhu byas pas rgyab skyor dang khas len legs par thob par brten da lta jus gzhi dngos su lag ltar byed pa'i skal ba legs po thob/de la 'dir dpe tshogs〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig rtsom sgrig par skrun bcas kyi skor gsal bshad du 'os pa 229

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/'ga' zhig zhu ba 'di lta ste/1 nga tshos bya ba 'di spel ba la mgo log khul u dang /khul dmangs chen/ khul srid gzhung / khul srid gros bcas 'go khrid tshan skor che bzhi dang 'brel yod sde khag gi 'gan 'khur ba las grub pa'i ched don 'go khrid tshan chung btsugs thog 'brel yod don bya gang ci'i thad bka' skor snyan seng zhus pa'i dgongs don ltar bsgrubs pa yin la/ ched dmigs bya ba'i jus gzhi yig thog nas khul mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan thob cing brgyud spel gnang ba dang bstun pa sha stag yin/ dus mtshungs su ma phyi'i yig rnying yod tshad so so'i 'brel yod gnyer bdag dang chos bdag dgon bdag sogs brgyud de tshul ldan lugs mthun sgos 'tshol sdud byas shing / khong tshor gros zhu byas te par skrun byed par thugs mthun yid 'thad byung ba yin la/ rgyun srol lam gsang ba sngags dang 'brel ba sogs kyi dbang gis bka' dog dgos min dag kyang khong tsho'i dgongs 'dod bka' 'khrol dang bstun pa ma gtogs nged cag gi lag tu gang son ltar gzu lum sger gcod byas pa gcig kyang med/na mthun rkyen 'byor ba'i gnas bab 'og gsung 'bum 230

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/gcig la'ang bris ma dang par ma'i ma phyi ci rnyed cig nye bar bsdus te phan tshun bsdur gshib sgos gang rgyas shos kyi rmang gzhi'i steng gzhan las kha bskangs shing / dmangs khrod du kha 'thor du bzhugs pa'i thor bu dag kyang lag tu ci 'ong gis gsab snon byas yod pas/ so so'i gsung 'bum gang la mtshon na'ang mig snga ltar na da lta'i dpe tshogs〉'dir 'khod pa kho na kha tshang shos dang rgyas shos su brtsi chog snyam/3 gsung chos go rim sgrig stangs skor la sngon gyi ma phyi gang legs shos su snang ba de'i sgrig stangs gzhir bzhag gi rmang gzhi'i steng gcig 'gyur dang dgos dbang sogs la gzhigs te rtsom sgrig pa nas las babs kyi 'gan dbang spyad de 'os 'tsham gyi skyar sgrig dang slar sdeb kyang byas yod/4 ma phyi phal cher la dpe chod yang yang bgyis la tshad ldan gyi par gzhi med pa sogs kyi dbang gis yi ge mi dag cing /chad lhag shor ba/ go rim 'chol ba/ ma yig mi gsal ba sogs cung mang ba la rang blos rtsigs pa 'khrul med du snyam pa dag legs par bcos shing dag par bsgrigs la/ dogs gzhir mthong ba du ma zhig gzigs pa yangs shing de phyogs su nang rgyus che ba'i mkhas pa du mar drung bcar bka' 'dri yang yang 231

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/byas te dogs pa chod pa dag de bzhin du bcos/ re zhig khungs lung mi gsal zhing dpog par dka' ba re zung 'dug pa phyis kyi dpyad gzhir zin bris su bgyis thog 'ol tshod kyis ma bcos shing dpyad yams la ma 'jus par ma phyi sor 'jog byas shing —/ 'ga' zhig la yin shas che bar 'dod pa'i yi ge de zur gyi zla khyim du bkod yod/5 klog bde bar gzhigs te gsung chos bye brag pa phal mo cher mdzad byang sogs las dras te kha byang bkod cing / sa bcad blangs la/ ldeb byang yang bye brag tu bkod yod/6 ba zur 'dogs min lta bu sogs yi ge skor zhig gi bkol stangs da lta'i dag yig 'ga' zhig dang gcig tu mthun min yod kyang mkhas pa tshad ldan gyi phyag rgyun la thar chags su yod phyin khungs lung re yod srid la phyis su dag yig zhib dpyod pa dag gi dpyad gzhir nye bar mkho yang srid snyam nas ji bzhin sor 'jog byas/ gzhan yang ma yig tu skabs 'gar mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung thung ngu tsam re yongs su drangs 'dug pa zhib par dpyad tshe gong 'og gi gsung gang rung re de'i zur rgyan nam gsal 'don ci rigs su song ba sogs 'brel shin tu che bas dgos dbang la gzhigs nas 'dir yang ma yig ltar 232

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/bkod pa lags/bye brag da reb kyi dpal yul mchog sprul rin po che tshang gi gsung la mtshon na/ spyir khong nyid gsar nying grub mtha' spyi'am mdo rgyud rig gnas dang bcas pa la gsan bsam rgya che bas gsung chos kyang pod mang du mdzad 'dug par bshad mod skor zhig dus dbang gis med brlag tu shor ba shin tu phangs che la/shul du lhag yod pa dag dgon sde'i bla mkhan du mas 'bad pas bsdu rub gnang pa da reb kyi deb 'dir lhag lus med par bkod yod/ de yang mchog sprul rin po che gar dbang nyin byed mtha' yas lags nas thugs khur bla lhag bzhes shing khong gi zhal bkod bzhin mkhan o rgyan brtson 'grus tshang nas bsdu sgrig dang / 'phrul yig tu 'bebs pa/ zhu dag bcas kyi 'gan gcig chog gi tshul du bzhes pas sku tshags chen po bgyis shing /dag sdeb kyi chu tshad legs pa gzhan las gzengs su thon par mdzad pas 'dir nged gzhung las khang gis khong rnam par ched du bka' drin zhus pa lags/ zhar du mkhan o brtson tshang gi zhus mchan du khyad par du sngags yig phal mo che ma dpe rang sar bzhag pa las sngags don la zhib bsdur byed thabs med pa dang ma byung ba mang bas zhes pa dang /6 kho bos the tshom che ba'i 233

dpal yul mchog sprul gyi gsung 'bum/rigs rnams ma bcos rang sor bzhag yod mod/ rje 'di nyid kyi gsung chos phal che ba'i ma phyi nyung phyir dpe dag pa zhig lag son ma byung bas dpe ma dag pa de'i nor ba brgya phrag du ma zhig bdag gis bcas yod pas phyin chad 'di phyogs kyi ban de rgan gzhon dag gis ma phyi dang ma mthun pa tsam gyis 'dis gzu lum gis bcos so zhes gya tshom du mi bsgrag par don la nor ba dang nor bcos kyi tshul ji ltar byung zhib mos blos dpyad par gyis zhes re ba zhus pa lags zhes ba'ang 'dir zur gsal du bkod pa lags la/ de bzhen nged rtsom sgrig khang gis kyang dpe tshogs spyi'i gcig 'gyur la gzhigs te yi ge 'ga' zhig dang dkar chag sogs la'ang sgyur sgrig shas tsam byas pa dang / dpe tshogs rtsom sgrig gi rtsa don ltar mi byed thabs med kyi stangs 'dzin phran bu bgyis pa la dgongs dwangs ched du zhu na 'brel yod mi sna dang gzigs pa po rnam pas thugs khrel mi mdzad par snying nas zhu/ zhu/zhes mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang nas/2003lo'i zla10tshes8la/234

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/ bkra shis/ padma tshul khrims/mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ kurma tshe ring /dpal yul mchog sprul 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum/mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gzhung las khang gis bsdu sgrig byas/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa dang /si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun nas bkram/si khron ca khrong par 'debs 'gan 'khri tshad yod kung sis dpar/2008lo'i zla2par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2008lo'i zla2par par thengs dang po dpar/dpe rtags/1520978—7—5409—3784—3dpe rin sgor/ 15 00

(mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dag sgrig dpe dzin bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gi ming tho/tshan gtso/ pad ma rnam rgyal/tshan gco gzhon pa/ byis tshe ring / dkon mchogaskal bzang tshe ring / bstan chos/ 'jigs med/gces ma/ klu skyabs/ nor sde/khongs mi ming rim bod yig ka mad ltar bsgrigs pa)dkon mchog skal bzang tshe ring / klu skyabs/dge legs/ mgon lha/ gces ma/'ju skal bzang / 'jigs med/ bstan chos/thub bzang / dung gces/ nor sde/pad ma rnam rgyal/ byis tshe ring /
